16.36.s:
.. devyuvāca ..
yadetadbhavatā proktaṃ prācī sarvatra durllabhā ..
viśeṣeṇa kurukṣetre prabhāse puṣkare tathā .. 1 ..
16.36.d:
.. देव्युवाच ..
यदेतद्भवता प्रोक्तं प्राची सर्वत्र दुर्ल्लभा ..
विशेषेण कुरुक्षेत्रे प्रभासे पुष्करे तथा .. 1 ..
16.36.m: The goddess said: / That which was spoken by you—that the eastward-flowing river is everywhere difficult to reach, / Especially at Kurukṣetra, at Prabhāsa, and likewise at Puṣkara—

16.36.s:
kathaṃ prabhāsamāsādya saṃsthitā pāpanāśinī ..
māhātmyamakhilaṃ tasyāḥ prācyāḥ pātakanāśanam ..
kathayasva maheśāna yadyahaṃ te priyā vibho .. 2 ..
16.36.d:
कथं प्रभासमासाद्य संस्थिता पापनाशिनी ..
माहात्म्यमखिलं तस्याः प्राच्याः पातकनाशनम् ..
कथयस्व महेशान यद्यहं ते प्रिया विभो .. 2 ..
16.36.m: How did she, who destroys sins, come to Prabhāsa and remain established there? / Relate the entire sin-destroying māhātmya of that eastward-flowing river, / O great lord, if I am dear to you, O all-pervading one!

16.36.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
sādhu proktaṃ tvayā bhadre prācī sarvatra durlabhā ..
kurukṣetre puṣkare ca tasmātprābhāsike'dhikā .. 3 ..
16.36.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
साधु प्रोक्तं त्वया भद्रे प्राची सर्वत्र दुर्लभा ..
कुरुक्षेत्रे पुष्करे च तस्मात्प्राभासिकेऽधिका .. 3 ..
16.36.m: Īśvara said: / Well spoken by you, auspicious lady! The eastward-flowing river is everywhere difficult to reach, / At Kurukṣetra and at Puṣkara, and more so than those at Prabhāsa.

16.36.s:
prabhāse tu mahādevī prācīṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm ..
nāpuṇyo veda deveśi karmanirmūlanakṣamām .. 4 ..
16.36.d:
प्रभासे तु महादेवी प्राचीं पापप्रणाशिनीम् ..
नापुण्यो वेद देवेशि कर्मनिर्मूलनक्षमाम् .. 4 ..
16.36.m: At Prabhāsa, however, O great goddess, O ruler of gods, one devoid of merit / Does not know the sin-destroying eastward-flowing river, capable of uprooting karma.

16.36.s:
ye pibaṃti narāḥ puṇyāṃ prācīṃ devīṃ sarasvatīm ..
na te manuṣyā vijñeyāḥ satyaṃsatyaṃ varānane .. 5 ..
16.36.d:
ये पिबंति नराः पुण्यां प्राचीं देवीं सरस्वतीम् ..
न ते मनुष्या विज्ञेयाः सत्यंसत्यं वरानने .. 5 ..
16.36.m: Those men who drink the holy, eastward-flowing goddess Sarasvatī / Are not to be regarded as mere mortals; truly, truly, O fair-faced lady!

16.36.s:
dhanyāste munayaste ca puṇyāste ca tapasvinaḥ ..
ye ca sārasvataṃ toyaṃ pibaṃtyaharahaḥ sadā .. 6 ..
16.36.d:
धन्यास्ते मुनयस्ते च पुण्यास्ते च तपस्विनः ..
ये च सारस्वतं तोयं पिबंत्यहरहः सदा .. 6 ..
16.36.m: Blessed are they, sages are they, and holy ascetics are they, / Who continually drink the water of Sarasvatī day after day.

16.36.s:
devāste na manuṣyāste nadīstisra pibaṃti ye ..
caṃdrabhāgāṃ ca gaṃgāṃ ca tathā devīṃ sassvatīm .. 7 ..
16.36.d:
देवास्ते न मनुष्यास्ते नदीस्तिस्र पिबंति ये ..
चंद्रभागां च गंगां च तथा देवीं सस्स्वतीम् .. 7 ..
16.36.m: They are gods, not mortals, who drink the three rivers: / The Candrabhāgā, the Gaṅgā, and likewise the goddess Sarasvatī.

16.36.s:
bhuktvā vā yadi vā'bhuktvā divā vā yadi vā niśi ..
na kālaniyamastatra yatra prācī sarasvatī .. 8 ..
16.36.d:
भुक्त्वा वा यदि वाऽभुक्त्वा दिवा वा यदि वा निशि ..
न कालनियमस्तत्र यत्र प्राची सरस्वती .. 8 ..
16.36.m: Whether after eating or before eating, by day or by night, / There is no restriction of time where the eastward-flowing Sarasvatī is present.

16.36.s:
prācīṃ sarasvatīṃ ye tu pibaṃti satataṃ mṛgāḥ ..
te'pi svargaṃ gamiṣyaṃti yajñairdvijavarā yathā .. 9 ..
16.36.d:
प्राचीं सरस्वतीं ये तु पिबंति सततं मृगाः ..
तेऽपि स्वर्गं गमिष्यंति यज्ञैर्द्विजवरा यथा .. 9 ..
16.36.m: Even the deer who continually drink the eastward-flowing Sarasvatī / Will go to heaven, just as the best of brahmins do through sacrifices.

16.36.s:
sarvakāmaprapūrtyarthaṃ nṛṇāṃ tatkṣetramuttamam ..
ciṃtāmaṇisamā devī yatra prācī sarasvatī .. 7.1.36.10 ..
16.36.d:
सर्वकामप्रपूर्त्यर्थं नृणां तत्क्षेत्रमुत्तमम् ..
चिंतामणिसमा देवी यत्र प्राची सरस्वती .. 7.1.36.10 ..
16.36.m: That excellent sacred field is for the fulfillment of all desires for human beings / Where the goddess, the eastward-flowing Sarasvatī, is like a wish-fulfilling jewel.

16.36.s:
yathā kāmadughā gāvaḥ sarvakāmaphalapradāḥ ..
tathā svargāpavargābhyāṃ prācī devī sarasvatī .. 11 ..
16.36.d:
यथा कामदुघा गावः सर्वकामफलप्रदाः ..
तथा स्वर्गापवर्गाभ्यां प्राची देवी सरस्वती .. 11 ..
16.36.m: Just as wish-granting cows grant the fruits of all desires, / So does the goddess, the eastward-flowing Sarasvatī, through [bestowing] heaven and liberation.

16.36.s:
aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi munīnāmūrdhvaretasām ..
yatra sthitāni saṃnyāsaṃ tasmātkimadhikaṃ smṛtam .. 12 ..
16.36.d:
अष्टाशीतिसहस्राणि मुनीनामूर्ध्वरेतसाम् ..
यत्र स्थितानि संन्यासं तस्मात्किमधिकं स्मृतम् .. 12 ..
16.36.m: Eighty-eight thousand sages of celibate vows / Have maintained their renunciation there; what is remembered as higher than that?

16.36.s:
yatra maṃkaṇakaḥ siddhaḥ prācīne niyatātmavān ..
brahmahatyāvrataṃ cīrṇaṃ mayā yatra varānane .. 13 ..
16.36.d:
यत्र मंकणकः सिद्धः प्राचीने नियतात्मवान् ..
ब्रह्महत्याव्रतं चीर्णं मया यत्र वरानने .. 13 ..
16.36.m: Where the self-controlled Maṅkaṇaka attained perfection on the eastward-flowing river, / And where the observance for the slaying of a brahmin was performed by me, O fair-faced lady.

16.36.s:
vṛṣatīrthe mahāpuṇye prācīkūlasamāśrite ..
nivṛtte bhārate yuddhe tasmiṃstīrthe kirīṭinā ..
prāyaścittaṃ purā cīrṇaṃ viṣṇunā preritātmanā ..14..
16.36.d:
वृषतीर्थे महापुण्ये प्राचीकूलसमाश्रिते ..
निवृत्ते भारते युद्धे तस्मिंस्तीर्थे किरीटिना ..
प्रायश्चित्तं पुरा चीर्णं विष्णुना प्रेरितात्मना ..14..
16.36.m: At the extremely holy Vṛṣatīrtha situated on the bank of the eastward-flowing river, / When the Bhārata war had ceased, an expiation was performed in ancient times at that sacred ford / By the diadem-wearer [Arjuna], whose self was prompted by Viṣṇu.

16.36.s:
trailokye sarvatīrthānāṃ tattīrthaṃ pravaraṃ smṛtam ..
pāpaghnaṃ puṇyajananaṃ prāṇināṃ puṇyakīrttida .. 15 ..
16.36.d:
त्रैलोक्ये सर्वतीर्थानां तत्तीर्थं प्रवरं स्मृतम् ..
पापघ्नं पुण्यजननं प्राणिनां पुण्यकीर्त्तिद .. 15 ..
16.36.m: Among all the sacred fords in the three worlds, that sacred ford is remembered as supreme; / It destroys sins, generates merit, and grants holy renown to living beings.

16.36.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
āhaivamukte sā devī śaṃkaraṃ loka śaṃkaram..
prāyaścittaṃ kathaṃ prāptaḥ pārthaḥ parapuraṃjayaḥ ..
jñātikṣayodbhavaṃ pāpaṃ kathaṃ nāśamagātprabho ..16..
16.36.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
आहैवमुक्ते सा देवी शंकरं लोक शंकरम्..
प्रायश्चित्तं कथं प्राप्तः पार्थः परपुरंजयः ..
ज्ञातिक्षयोद्भवं पापं कथं नाशमगात्प्रभो ..16..
16.36.m: Sūta said: / When this had been said, the goddess spoke to Śaṃkara, who brings welfare to the world: / "How did Pārtha, conqueror of enemies' cities, come to [need] expiation? / How did the sin arising from the destruction of kinsmen go to destruction, O Lord?"

16.36.s:
evamuktaḥ punaḥ prāha viśveśo nīlalohitaḥ ..
prāyaścittasya saṃprāptaḥ kāraṇaṃ tadyathā sthitam ..17..
16.36.d:
एवमुक्तः पुनः प्राह विश्वेशो नीललोहितः ..
प्रायश्चित्तस्य संप्राप्तः कारणं तद्यथा स्थितम् ..17..
16.36.m: Addressed thus, the lord of the universe, the blue-and-red one [Śiva], spoke again, / Explaining the cause for which he underwent expiation, as it happened.

16.36.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
śṛṇuṣvāvahitā bhadre kathāṃ pātakanāśinīm ..
yāṃ śrutvā mānavo bhaktyā pavitrātmā prajāyate ..18..
16.36.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
शृणुष्वावहिता भद्रे कथां पातकनाशिनीम् ..
यां श्रुत्वा मानवो भक्त्या पवित्रात्मा प्रजायते ..18..
16.36.m: Īśvara said: / Listen attentively, auspicious lady, to the narrative that destroys sin, / Hearing which with devotion, a mortal becomes purified in soul.

16.36.s:
yo'sau devi samākhyātaḥ kirīṭī śvetavāhanaḥ..
sa jitvā kauravānsarvānsaṃhṛtya hayakuñjarān .. 19 ..
16.36.d:
योऽसौ देवि समाख्यातः किरीटी श्वेतवाहनः..
स जित्वा कौरवान्सर्वान्संहृत्य हयकुञ्जरान् .. 19 ..
16.36.m: He who is celebrated, O goddess, as the diadem-wearer with white horses— / Having defeated all the Kauravas and slaughtered their horses and elephants,

16.36.s:
paścātsuyodhanaṃ hatvā bhīmena prayayau gṛhān..
nārāyaṇena sahito naro'sau prasthito raṇāt.. 7.1.36.20 ..
16.36.d:
पश्चात्सुयोधनं हत्वा भीमेन प्रययौ गृहान्..
नारायणेन सहितो नरोऽसौ प्रस्थितो रणात्.. 7.1.36.20 ..
16.36.m: And after Suyodhana had been slain by Bhīma—went toward the tents; / Together with Nārāyaṇa, that Nara set out from the battle,

16.36.s:
draṣṭuṃ dharmasutaṃ dṛṣṭaḥ praṇataḥ prāṃjaliḥ sthitaḥ..
sa vijñāya tadā''yāntau naranārāyaṇāvubhau .. 21 ..
16.36.d:
द्रष्टुं धर्मसुतं दृष्टः प्रणतः प्रांजलिः स्थितः..
स विज्ञाय तदा'ऽयान्तौ नरनारायणावुभौ .. 21 ..
16.36.m: To see the son of Dharma [Yudhiṣṭhira]. Seen [approaching], he stood bowing with folded hands. / Having learned that both Nara and Nārāyaṇa were arriving,

16.36.s:
rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ prāha dvārasthāndvārapālakān ..
bhavadbhiretāvāyāṃtau niṣedhyau dvārasaṃsthitau .. 22 ..
16.36.d:
राजा युधिष्ठिरः प्राह द्वारस्थान्द्वारपालकान् ..
भवद्भिरेतावायांतौ निषेध्यौ द्वारसंस्थितौ .. 22 ..
16.36.m: King Yudhiṣṭhira said to the doorkeepers standing at the door: / "You must bar both of these men as they arrive and stand at the door!

16.36.s:
nara nārāyaṇau krūrau pāpapaṃkānulepinau ..
evametaditi proktau tau tadā dvāramāgatau .. 23 ..
16.36.d:
नर नारायणौ क्रूरौ पापपंकानुलेपिनौ ..
एवमेतदिति प्रोक्तौ तौ तदा द्वारमागतौ .. 23 ..
16.36.m: Nara and Nārāyaṇa are cruel, smeared with the mire of sin." / Having been told thus, "So be it," the two then arrived at the door.

16.36.s:
bhavantau necchati draṣṭuṃ rājā durnayakāriṇau ..
tatrasthaḥ pṛṣṭavānbhūyaḥ pratīhāraṃ naraḥ svayam .. 24 ..
16.36.d:
भवन्तौ नेच्छति द्रष्टुं राजा दुर्नयकारिणौ ..
तत्रस्थः पृष्टवान्भूयः प्रतीहारं नरः स्वयम् .. 24 ..
16.36.m: "The king does not wish to see you two, who have committed bad conduct." / Standing there, Nara himself asked the doorkeeper again:

16.36.s:
āvāṃ kiṃ kāraṇaṃ rājā nekṣate vaśavartinau ..
provāca praṇato rājā tato dvāḥsthaṃ puraḥsthitam .. 25 ..
16.36.d:
आवां किं कारणं राजा नेक्षते वशवर्तिनौ ..
प्रोवाच प्रणतो राजा ततो द्वाःस्थं पुरःस्थितम् .. 25 ..
16.36.m: "For what reason does the king not look upon us two, who are obedient to his will?" / Thereupon the king, having bowed, spoke to the doorkeeper standing before him:

16.36.s:
nārāyaṇena sahitaṃ naraṃ narakanirbhayam ..
duryodhanena sahitā bāṃdhavāste yato hatāḥ ..
pitṛtulyāśca rājānastena vai pāpabhājanam .. 26 ..
16.36.d:
नारायणेन सहितं नरं नरकनिर्भयम् ..
दुर्योधनेन सहिता बांधवास्ते यतो हताः ..
पितृतुल्याश्च राजानस्तेन वै पापभाजनम् .. 26 ..
16.36.m: "Nara, accompanied by Nārāyaṇa, has no fear of hell. / Because those kinsmen, along with Duryodhana, were slain, / As well as kings who were like fathers; therefore he is truly a receptacle of sin."

16.36.s:
evamukte tu tenātha mukhamālokitaṃ hareḥ ..
tena proktamidaṃ tathyaṃ yatte rājñā prabhāṣitam .. 27 ..
16.36.d:
एवमुक्ते तु तेनाथ मुखमालोकितं हरेः ..
तेन प्रोक्तमिदं तथ्यं यत्ते राज्ञा प्रभाषितम् .. 27 ..
16.36.m: When this was said by him, he looked at the face of Hari. / By him [Hari] this was said: "What was spoken to you by the king is true."

16.36.s:
evamukte naraḥ prāha punareva janārddanam ..
kathayasva kathaṃ pāpātkṛṣṇa śuddhyāmahe vayam .. 28 ..
16.36.d:
एवमुक्ते नरः प्राह पुनरेव जनार्द्दनम् ..
कथयस्व कथं पापात्कृष्ण शुद्ध्यामहे वयम् .. 28 ..
16.36.m: When this was said, Nara spoke once again to Janārdana: / "Tell me, O Kṛṣṇa, how can we be cleansed from sin?

16.36.s:
tīrthasnānena me śuddhiryathā syāttadvada sphuṭam ..
tacca gaṃgādikaṃ kṛṣṇa yathā'syāghasya nāśanam .. 29 .. ..
16.36.d:
तीर्थस्नानेन मे शुद्धिर्यथा स्यात्तद्वद स्फुटम् ..
तच्च गंगादिकं कृष्ण यथाऽस्याघस्य नाशनम् .. 29 .. ..
16.36.m: Tell me clearly how my purification may be accomplished through bathing in a sacred ford, / and how the Gaṅgā and others [may bring about] the destruction of this sin, O Kṛṣṇa."

16.36.s:
.. kṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
mā gayāṃ gaccha kauṃteya mā gaṃgāṃ mā ca puṣkaram ..
tatra gaccha kuruśreṣṭha yatra prācī sarasvatī .. 7.1.36.30 ..
16.36.d:
.. कृष्ण उवाच .. ..
मा गयां गच्छ कौंतेय मा गंगां मा च पुष्करम् ..
तत्र गच्छ कुरुश्रेष्ठ यत्र प्राची सरस्वती .. 7.1.36.30 ..
16.36.m: Kṛṣṇa said: / "Do not go to Gayā, O son of Kuntī, nor to Gaṅgā, nor to Puṣkara. / Go there, O best of Kurus, where the eastward-flowing Sarasvatī is.

16.36.s:
brahmaghnāśca surā pāśca ye cānye pāpakāriṇaḥ ..
tatra snātvā vimucyaṃte yatra prācī sarasvatī .. 31 ..
16.36.d:
ब्रह्मघ्नाश्च सुरा पाश्च ये चान्ये पापकारिणः ..
तत्र स्नात्वा विमुच्यंते यत्र प्राची सरस्वती .. 31 ..
16.36.m: Slayers of brahmins, drinkers of liquor, and whatever other evildoers there are, / are freed upon bathing there where the eastward-flowing Sarasvatī is."

16.36.s:
nārāyaṇena prokto'sau narastadvacanāddrutam ..
sahitastena saṃprāptaḥ prācīnaṃ tīrthamuttamam .. 32 ..
16.36.d:
नारायणेन प्रोक्तोऽसौ नरस्तद्वचनाद्द्रुतम् ..
सहितस्तेन संप्राप्तः प्राचीनं तीर्थमुत्तमम् .. 32 ..
16.36.m: Thus addressed by Nārāyaṇa, Nara, in accordance with his word, / quickly went accompanied by him to that excellent eastern sacred ford.

16.36.s:
trirātropoṣitaḥ snātastrikālaṃ niyatātmavān ..
tena tasmādvinirmuktaḥ pātakātpūrvasaṃcitāt .. 33 ...
16.36.d:
त्रिरात्रोपोषितः स्नातस्त्रिकालं नियतात्मवान् ..
तेन तस्माद्विनिर्मुक्तः पातकात्पूर्वसंचितात् .. 33 ...
16.36.m: Having fasted for three nights, self-restrained, he bathed at the three junctures of the day; / through that, he was completely freed from that previously accumulated evil deed.

16.36.s:
vijñāya śuddhamenaṃ tu rājā dharmasuto drutam ..
bhrātṛbhiḥ sahitaḥ prāptastaṃ draṣṭuṃ narapuṃgavam .. 34 ..
16.36.d:
विज्ञाय शुद्धमेनं तु राजा धर्मसुतो द्रुतम् ..
भ्रातृभिः सहितः प्राप्तस्तं द्रष्टुं नरपुंगवम् .. 34 ..
16.36.m: Having learned that he was purified, the king, the son of Dharma, / quickly arrived with his brothers to see that bull among men.

16.36.s:
tatastaṃ praṇataṃ dṛṣṭvā dharmaputraḥ puraḥsthitam ..
āliliṃga prahṛṣṭātmā pṛṣṭavāṃścāpyanāmayam .. 35 ..
16.36.d:
ततस्तं प्रणतं दृष्ट्वा धर्मपुत्रः पुरःस्थितम् ..
आलिलिंग प्रहृष्टात्मा पृष्टवांश्चाप्यनामयम् .. 35 ..
16.36.m: Then, seeing him bowing down and standing before him, / the son of Dharma, delighted in heart, embraced him and inquired about his welfare.

16.36.s:
bhīmādibhirbhrātṛbhiśca tadā gurugaṇairvṛtaḥ ..
āliṃgitaḥ prahṛṣṭaistu naro guṇagaṇairvṛtaḥ .. 36 ..
16.36.d:
भीमादिभिर्भ्रातृभिश्च तदा गुरुगणैर्वृतः ..
आलिंगितः प्रहृष्टैस्तु नरो गुणगणैर्वृतः .. 36 ..
16.36.m: Surrounded then by his brothers, Bhīma and the others, and by groups of elders, / Nara, endowed with a host of virtues, was joyfully embraced.

16.36.s:
etaddhi tanmahātīrthaṃ prācīneti ca śabditam ..
snānakrameṇa marttyānāmanyeṣāmapi pāvakam .. 37 ..
16.36.d:
एतद्धि तन्महातीर्थं प्राचीनेति च शब्दितम् ..
स्नानक्रमेण मर्त्त्यानामन्येषामपि पावकम् .. 37 ..
16.36.m: For this is that great sacred ford called Prācīna; / it purifies other mortals as well through the performance of ritual ablution.

16.36.s:
trirātropoṣitaḥ snātastīrthe'sminbrahmahā'pi yaḥ ..
vimuktaḥ pātakāttasmānmodate divi rudravat .. 38 ..
16.36.d:
त्रिरात्रोपोषितः स्नातस्तीर्थेऽस्मिन्ब्रह्महाऽपि यः ..
विमुक्तः पातकात्तस्मान्मोदते दिवि रुद्रवत् .. 38 ..
16.36.m: Even a brahmin-slayer who has fasted for three nights and bathed in this sacred ford, / freed from that evil deed, rejoices in heaven like Rudra.

16.36.s:
prācīne devyahaṃ nityaṃ vasāmi sahitastvayā ..
prabhāse tu mahākṣetre viśeṣāttatra bhāmini .. .. 39 ..
16.36.d:
प्राचीने देव्यहं नित्यं वसामि सहितस्त्वया ..
प्रभासे तु महाक्षेत्रे विशेषात्तत्र भामिनि .. .. 39 ..
16.36.m: O Goddess, I dwell constantly in Prācīna accompanied by you, / and particularly so in the great sacred field of Prabhāsa, O passionate woman.

16.36.s:
sarasvatyuttare tīre yastyajedātmanastanum ..
prācīne tu varārohe na cehāgacchate punaḥ .. 7.1.36.40 ..
16.36.d:
सरस्वत्युत्तरे तीरे यस्त्यजेदात्मनस्तनुम् ..
प्राचीने तु वरारोहे न चेहागच्छते पुनः .. 7.1.36.40 ..
16.36.m: Whoever abandons their body on the northern bank of Sarasvatī / in Prācīna, O woman of lovely hips, does not return here again.

16.36.s:
āpluto vājimedhasya phalaṃ prāpsyati puṣkalam ..
niyamaiścopavāsaiśca śoṣayeddehamātmanaḥ .. 41 ..
16.36.d:
आप्लुतो वाजिमेधस्य फलं प्राप्स्यति पुष्कलम् ..
नियमैश्चोपवासैश्च शोषयेद्देहमात्मनः .. 41 ..
16.36.m: Having bathed, one shall obtain the abundant fruit of a horse sacrifice. / One should emaciate one's body with observances and fasts.

16.36.s:
jalāhārā vāyubhakṣāḥ parṇāhārāśca tāpasāḥ ..
yathā sthaṃḍilagā nityaṃ ye cānyaniyamāḥ pṛthak .. 42 ..
16.36.d:
जलाहारा वायुभक्षाः पर्णाहाराश्च तापसाः ..
यथा स्थंडिलगा नित्यं ये चान्यनियमाः पृथक् .. 42 ..
16.36.m: Living on water, feeding on air, living on dry leaves—such are the ascetics / who constantly sleep on the bare ground, along with whatever other distinct observances [they keep].

16.36.s:
evaṃ maṃkyāśrame yeṣāṃ vasatāṃ mṛtyurāgataḥ ..
na te manuṣyā devāste satyametadbravīmi te .. 43 ..
16.36.d:
एवं मंक्याश्रमे येषां वसतां मृत्युरागतः ..
न ते मनुष्या देवास्ते सत्यमेतद्ब्रवीमि ते .. 43 ..
16.36.m: To those whose death comes while residing in this manner in Maṅki's hermitage— / they are not humans, they are gods; this I tell you truly.

16.36.s:
asmiṃstīrthe tu yo dadyāttruṭimātraṃ tu kāṃcanam..
śraddhayā dvijamukhyāya merutulyaṃ phalaṃ labhet .. 44 ..
16.36.d:
अस्मिंस्तीर्थे तु यो दद्यात्त्रुटिमात्रं तु कांचनम्..
श्रद्धया द्विजमुख्याय मेरुतुल्यं फलं लभेत् .. 44 ..
16.36.m: Whoever gives even a truṭi-measure of gold in this sacred ford / with faith to an eminent twice-born man, shall obtain a fruit equal to Mount Meru.

16.36.s:
asmiṃstīrthe tu ye śrāddhaṃ kariṣyaṃti ca mānavāḥ ..
ekaviṃśatkulopetāḥ svargaṃ yāsyaṃti te dhruvam .. 45 ..
16.36.d:
अस्मिंस्तीर्थे तु ये श्राद्धं करिष्यंति च मानवाः ..
एकविंशत्कुलोपेताः स्वर्गं यास्यंति ते ध्रुवम् .. 45 ..
16.36.m: And whatever human beings shall perform a śrāddha in this sacred ford, / they, accompanied by twenty-one generations of their family, shall surely go to heaven.

16.36.s:
pitṝṇāṃ vallabhe tīrthe piṇḍenaikena tarppitāḥ ..
brahmalokaṃ gamiṣyaṃti gayāśrāddhakṛto yathā .. .. 46 ..
16.36.d:
पितॄणां वल्लभे तीर्थे पिण्डेनैकेन तर्प्पिताः ..
ब्रह्मलोकं गमिष्यंति गयाश्राद्धकृतो यथा .. .. 46 ..
16.36.m: Gratified with a single funeral ball in this sacred ford beloved of the ancestors, / they shall go to the world of Brahmā, just like one who has performed the śrāddha at Gayā.

16.36.s:
kṛṣṇapakṣe caturddaśyāṃ snānaṃ ca vihitaṃ sadā ..
piṇyākaiṃgudakenāpi piṃḍaṃ tatra dadāti yaḥ ..
pitṝṇāmakṣayā tṛptiḥ pitṛlokaṃ sa gacchati .. 47 ..
16.36.d:
कृष्णपक्षे चतुर्द्दश्यां स्नानं च विहितं सदा ..
पिण्याकैंगुदकेनापि पिंडं तत्र ददाति यः ..
पितॄणामक्षया तृप्तिः पितृलोकं स गच्छति .. 47 ..
16.36.m: Ritual ablution is always prescribed on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight. / Whoever gives a funeral ball there, even with oil-cake and inguda seeds, / brings imperishable satisfaction to the ancestors, and he goes to the world of the ancestors.

16.36.s: bhūyaścānnaṃ prayacchaṃti mokṣamārgaṃ vrajaṃti te .. 48 ..
16.36.d: भूयश्चान्नं प्रयच्छंति मोक्षमार्गं व्रजंति ते .. 48 ..
16.36.m: And furthermore, those who bestow food attain the path to liberation.

16.36.s:
dadhi dadyādyo'pi tatra brāhmaṇāya manoramam ..
so'gnilokaṃ samāsādya bhuṃkte bhogānsuśobhanān.. 49 ..
16.36.d:
दधि दद्याद्योऽपि तत्र ब्राह्मणाय मनोरमम् ..
सोऽग्निलोकं समासाद्य भुंक्ते भोगान्सुशोभनान्.. 49 ..
16.36.m: Whoever also gives delightful curds there to a brahmin / attains the world of Agni and enjoys exceedingly splendid pleasures.

16.36.s:
ūrṇāṃ prāvaraṇaṃ yo'pi bhaktyā dadyāddvijottame ..
so'pi yāti parāṃ siddhiṃ martyairanyaiḥ sudurllabhām .. 7.1.36.50 ..
16.36.d:
ऊर्णां प्रावरणं योऽपि भक्त्या दद्याद्द्विजोत्तमे ..
सोऽपि याति परां सिद्धिं मर्त्यैरन्यैः सुदुर्ल्लभाम् .. 7.1.36.50 ..
16.36.m: Whoever also gives a woollen garment with devotion to an excellent twice-born man / also attains the supreme siddhi, very difficult to attain by other mortals.

16.36.s:
ye cātra malanāśāya viśeyurmānavā jalam..
gopradānasamaṃ teṣāṃ sukhena phalamādiśet .. 51 ..
16.36.d:
ये चात्र मलनाशाय विशेयुर्मानवा जलम्..
गोप्रदानसमं तेषां सुखेन फलमादिशेत् .. 51 ..
16.36.m: And whatever humans enter the water here to destroy impurity, / to them one may easily assign a fruit equal to the gift of a cow.

16.36.s:
bhāvena yo narastatra kaścitsnānaṃ samācaret ..
sarvapāpavinirmukto brahmaloke mahīyate .. 52 ..
16.36.d:
भावेन यो नरस्तत्र कश्चित्स्नानं समाचरेत् ..
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो ब्रह्मलोके महीयते .. 52 ..
16.36.m: Whatever man performs ritual ablution there with sincere disposition, / freed from all sins, is glorified in the world of Brahmā.

16.36.s:
tarpaṇātpiṃḍadānācca narakeṣvapi saṃsthitāḥ ..
svargaṃ prayāṃti pitaraḥ suputreṇa hi tāritāḥ .. 53 ..
16.36.d:
तर्पणात्पिंडदानाच्च नरकेष्वपि संस्थिताः ..
स्वर्गं प्रयांति पितरः सुपुत्रेण हि तारिताः .. 53 ..
16.36.m: Through libations and the offering of funeral balls, ancestors even residing in hells / go to heaven, having been rescued by a noble son.

16.36.s:
prācīṃ sarasvatīṃ prāpya yāti tīrthaṃ himālayam..
sa karasthaṃ samutsṛjya kūrpareṇa samālihet .. 54 ..
16.36.d:
प्राचीं सरस्वतीं प्राप्य याति तीर्थं हिमालयम्..
स करस्थं समुत्सृज्य कूर्परेण समालिहेत् .. 54 ..
16.36.m: Having reached the eastward-flowing Sarasvatī, one goes to the sacred ford of Himālaya; / dropping what is in his hand, he would lick with his elbow.

16.36.s:
yaṃyaṃ kāmamabhidhyāya tasminprāṇānparityajet ..
taṃtaṃ sakalamāpnoti tīrthamāhātmyayogataḥ .. 55 ..
16.36.d:
यंयं काममभिध्याय तस्मिन्प्राणान्परित्यजेत् ..
तंतं सकलमाप्नोति तीर्थमाहात्म्ययोगतः .. 55 ..
16.36.m: Whatever desire one contemplates as one gives up life's breaths in it, / all of that one attains through the conjunction of the sacred ford's māhātmya.

16.36.s:
anyaddevi purā gītaṃ gāṃgeyena yudhiṣṭhire ..
satyameva hi gaṃgāyāṃ vayaṃ jātā yudhiṣṭhira .. 56 ..
16.36.d:
अन्यद्देवि पुरा गीतं गांगेयेन युधिष्ठिरे ..
सत्यमेव हि गंगायां वयं जाता युधिष्ठिर .. 56 ..
16.36.m: Another thing, O Goddess, was sung of old by the son of Gaṅgā to Yudhiṣṭhira: / 'In truth, O Yudhiṣṭhira, we were born of the Gaṅgā;

16.36.s:
yāḥ kāścitsarito loke tāsāṃ puṇyā sarasvatī .. 97 ..
sarasvatī sarvanadīṣu puṇyā sarasvatī lokasukhāvahā sadā ..
sarasvatīṃ prāpya suduḥkhitā narāḥ sadā na śocanti paratra ceha ca ..58 ..
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye prācīsarasvatīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭtriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 36 ..
16.36.d:
याः काश्चित्सरितो लोके तासां पुण्या सरस्वती .. 97 ..
सरस्वती सर्वनदीषु पुण्या सरस्वती लोकसुखावहा सदा ..
सरस्वतीं प्राप्य सुदुःखिता नराः सदा न शोचन्ति परत्र चेह च ..58 ..
इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये प्राचीसरस्वतीमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षट्त्रिंशोऽध्यायः .. 36 ..
16.36.m:
yet of whatever rivers there are in the world, the Sarasvatī is holy.'
Sarasvatī is holy among all rivers; Sarasvatī always brings joy to the world. / Having reached Sarasvatī, exceedingly distressed men never grieve, both in the other world and in this one.
Thus ends the thirty-sixth chapter, named "Description of the Māhātmya of the Eastward-flowing Sarasvatī," in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh [book], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.37.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
kimarthaṃ kaṃkaṇaṃ deva kṣipyate lavaṇāṃbhasi ..
tasyā puṇyaṃ na pūrvoktaṃ yathāvadvaktumarhasi .. 1 ..
16.37.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
किमर्थं कंकणं देव क्षिप्यते लवणांभसि ..
तस्या पुण्यं न पूर्वोक्तं यथावद्वक्तुमर्हसि .. 1 ..
16.37.m: The Goddess said: / "For what purpose, O God, is a bracelet cast into the salt water? / Its merit was not told before; please explain it properly.

16.37.s:
ke maṃtrāḥ kiṃ vidhānaṃ tatkasminkāle mahatphalam ..
kiṃ purābhūcca tadvṛttaṃ bhagavankaṃkaṇāśritam .. 2 .. ..
16.37.d:
के मंत्राः किं विधानं तत्कस्मिन्काले महत्फलम् ..
किं पुराभूच्च तद्वृत्तं भगवन्कंकणाश्रितम् .. 2 .. ..
16.37.m: What are the mantras? What is that ritual procedure? At what time is there great fruit? / And what happened in the past, O Lord, concerning this bracelet?"

16.37.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
āsītpurā mahīpālo bṛhadratha iti śrutaḥ ..
tasya bhāryā'bhavatsādhvī nāmnā ceṃdumatī priyā .. 3 ..
16.37.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
आसीत्पुरा महीपालो बृहद्रथ इति श्रुतः ..
तस्य भार्याऽभवत्साध्वी नाम्ना चेंदुमती प्रिया .. 3 ..
16.37.m: Īśvara said: / "Formerly there was a king known as Bṛhadratha; / his wife was a virtuous and beloved woman named Indumatī.

16.37.s:
na devī na ca gandharvī nāsurī na ca kiṃnarī ..
tādṛgrūpā mahādevi yādṛśī sā sumadhyamā .. 4 ..
16.37.d:
न देवी न च गन्धर्वी नासुरी न च किंनरी ..
तादृग्रूपा महादेवि यादृशी सा सुमध्यमा .. 4 ..
16.37.m: Neither a goddess, nor a gandharva woman, nor an asura woman, nor a kinnara woman / was of such form, O great Goddess, as that slender-waisted lady was.

16.37.s:
śīlarūpaguṇopetā nityaṃ sā tu pativatā ..
sarvayoṣidguṇairyuktā yathā sādhvī hyarundhatī .. 5 ..
16.37.d:
शीलरूपगुणोपेता नित्यं सा तु पतिवता ..
सर्वयोषिद्गुणैर्युक्ता यथा साध्वी ह्यरुन्धती .. 5 ..
16.37.m: Endowed with good character, beauty, and virtues, she was always devoted to her husband, / equipped with all the virtues of women, just like the virtuous Arundhatī.

16.37.s:
pradhāna (?)hasrasya saubhāgyamadagarvitā ..
na vinā sa tayā reme muhūrttamapi pārthivaḥ .. 6 ..
16.37.d:
प्रधान (?)हस्रस्य सौभाग्यमदगर्विता ..
न विना स तया रेमे मुहूर्त्तमपि पार्थिवः .. 6 ..
16.37.m: [...] proud with the pride of good fortune; / without her, the ruler of the earth did not find delight even for a moment.

16.37.s:
ekadā tasyarājarṣerarddhāsanagatā satī..
yāvattiṣṭhati rājeṃdramṛṣistāvadupāgataḥ..
kaṇvo nāma mahātejāstapasvī vedapāragaḥ..7..
16.37.d:
एकदा तस्यराजर्षेरर्द्धासनगता सती..
यावत्तिष्ठति राजेंद्रमृषिस्तावदुपागतः..
कण्वो नाम महातेजास्तपस्वी वेदपारगः..7..
16.37.m: Once, while that virtuous woman was sharing half the seat of that royal seer, / O king of kings, a seer arrived— / Kanva by name, of great splendour, an ascetic who had mastered the Vedas.

16.37.s:
tamāgatamatho dṛṣṭvā sahasotthāya pārthivaḥ..
pūjāṃ kṛtvā yathānyāyaṃ dattvā cārghyamanuttamam..8..
16.37.d:
तमागतमथो दृष्ट्वा सहसोत्थाय पार्थिवः..
पूजां कृत्वा यथान्यायं दत्त्वा चार्घ्यमनुत्तमम्..8..
16.37.m: Seeing him arrived, the ruler of the earth immediately arose, / performed worship according to rule, and offered excellent water of guest-offering.

16.37.s:
sukhāsīnaṃ tato matvā viśrāṃtaṃ munipuṃgavam..
āpṛcchatkuśalaṃ rājā sa sarvaṃ cānvamodayat .. 9 ..
16.37.d:
सुखासीनं ततो मत्वा विश्रांतं मुनिपुंगवम्..
आपृच्छत्कुशलं राजा स सर्वं चान्वमोदयत् .. 9 ..
16.37.m: Then, knowing that bull among sages to be comfortably seated and rested, / the king inquired about his welfare, and he approved of everything.

16.37.s: tato dharmakathāṃ cakre sa ṛṣirnṛpasannidhau .. 7.1.37.10 ..
16.37.d: ततो धर्मकथां चक्रे स ऋषिर्नृपसन्निधौ .. 7.1.37.10 ..
16.37.m: Then that seer delivered a discourse on dharma in the presence of the king.

16.37.s:
tataḥ kathāvasāne sā bhāryā tasya mahīpateḥ ..
abravīdamṛtaṃ vākyaṃ kṛtāṃjalipuṭā satī .. 11 ..
16.37.d:
ततः कथावसाने सा भार्या तस्य महीपतेः ..
अब्रवीदमृतं वाक्यं कृतांजलिपुटा सती .. 11 ..
16.37.m: Then, at the conclusion of the discourse, the chaste wife of that king, / with folded hands, spoke nectar-like words:

16.37.s:
.. indumatyuvāca .. ..
tvaṃ vetsi bhagavansarvamatītānāgataṃ vibho ..
pṛcche tvāṃ kautukāviṣṭā tasmāttvaṃ kṣaṃtumarhasi .. .. 12 ..
16.37.d:
.. इन्दुमत्युवाच .. ..
त्वं वेत्सि भगवन्सर्वमतीतानागतं विभो ..
पृच्छे त्वां कौतुकाविष्टा तस्मात्त्वं क्षंतुमर्हसि .. .. 12 ..
16.37.m: Indumatī said: / You know everything, O blessed lord, past and future, O all-pervading one. / Filled with curiosity, I ask you; therefore you ought to forgive me.

16.37.s:
anyadehodbhavaṃ karma mama sarvaṃ prakīrttaya ..
īdṛśaṃ mama saubhāgyaṃ patirdevasutopamaḥ .. 13 ..
16.37.d:
अन्यदेहोद्भवं कर्म मम सर्वं प्रकीर्त्तय ..
ईदृशं मम सौभाग्यं पतिर्देवसुतोपमः .. 13 ..
16.37.m: Tell me all the karma born of my other body [in a previous birth], / [which caused] such good fortune of mine, and a husband comparable to the son of a god.

16.37.s:
saubhāgyaṃ patidevatvaṃ śīlaṃ trailokyaviśrutam..
kiṃ prabhāvo vratasyaiṣa utāhopoṣitasya vā .. 14 ..
16.37.d:
सौभाग्यं पतिदेवत्वं शीलं त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम्..
किं प्रभावो व्रतस्यैष उताहोपोषितस्य वा .. 14 ..
16.37.m: Good fortune, devotion to my husband, and conduct renowned throughout the three worlds: / is this the power of an observance, or perhaps of fasting,

16.37.s:
dānasya vā muniśreṣṭha yanme saubhāgyamuttamam..
vaśo rājā mahābāhurmama vākyānugaḥ sadā .. .. 15 ..
16.37.d:
दानस्य वा मुनिश्रेष्ठ यन्मे सौभाग्यमुत्तमम्..
वशो राजा महाबाहुर्मम वाक्यानुगः सदा .. .. 15 ..
16.37.m: or of giving, O best of sages, that gives me such supreme good fortune? / The mighty-armed king is subject to me, ever obedient to my word.

16.37.s: etanme sarvamācakṣva paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me .. 16 ..
16.37.d: एतन्मे सर्वमाचक्ष्व परं कौतूहलं हि मे .. 16 ..
16.37.m: Tell me all this, for my curiosity is great.

16.37.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā dhyātvā ca suciraṃ muniḥ ..
abravītprahasanvākyaṃ kaṇvo vedavidāṃ varaḥ .. 17 ..
16.37.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा ध्यात्वा च सुचिरं मुनिः ..
अब्रवीत्प्रहसन्वाक्यं कण्वो वेदविदां वरः .. 17 ..
16.37.m: Sūta said: / Having heard her word and meditated for a long time, the sage / Kaṇva, the best of the knowers of the Veda, smiled and spoke these words.

16.37.s:
.. kaṇva uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu rājñi pravakṣyāmi anyadehodbhavaṃ tava ..
na roṣaśca tvayā kāryo lajjā vāpi sumadhyame .. 18 ..
16.37.d:
.. कण्व उवाच .. ..
शृणु राज्ञि प्रवक्ष्यामि अन्यदेहोद्भवं तव ..
न रोषश्च त्वया कार्यो लज्जा वापि सुमध्यमे .. 18 ..
16.37.m: Kaṇva said: / Listen, O queen, I shall tell you what arose in your other body. / You should not feel anger, nor indeed shame, O slender-waisted lady.

16.37.s:
tvamāsīdanyadehe tu ābhīrī paṃcabhartṛkā ..
saurāṣṭraviṣaye hīnā devaṃ someśvaraṃ gatā .. 19 ..
16.37.d:
त्वमासीदन्यदेहे तु आभीरी पंचभर्तृका ..
सौराष्ट्रविषये हीना देवं सोमेश्वरं गता .. 19 ..
16.37.m: In another body you were a cowherd woman (ābhīrī) having five husbands; / of low birth in the land of Saurāṣṭra, you went to the god Someśvara.

16.37.s:
tataḥ snātuṃ praviṣṭā ca sāgare lavaṇāṃbhasi ..
hatā kallolamālābhirvihvalatvamupāgatā .. 7.1.37.20 ..
16.37.d:
ततः स्नातुं प्रविष्टा च सागरे लवणांभसि ..
हता कल्लोलमालाभिर्विह्वलत्वमुपागता .. 7.1.37.20 ..
16.37.m: Then, having entered the salty waters of the ocean to bathe, / struck by rows of large waves, you were overcome with distress.

16.37.s:
tava hastāccyutaṃ tatra haimaṃ kaṃkaṇameva ca ..
naṣṭaṃ samudrasalile paścāttāpastu te sthitaḥ .. 21 ..
16.37.d:
तव हस्ताच्च्युतं तत्र हैमं कंकणमेव च ..
नष्टं समुद्रसलिले पश्चात्तापस्तु ते स्थितः .. 21 ..
16.37.m: There, a golden bangle slipped from your hand / and was lost in the water of the ocean; but remorse remained within you.

16.37.s:
atha kālena mahatā paṃcatvaṃ tvamupāgatā ..
daśārṇādhipatergehe tato jātāsi sundari .. 22 ..
16.37.d:
अथ कालेन महता पंचत्वं त्वमुपागता ..
दशार्णाधिपतेर्गेहे ततो जातासि सुन्दरि .. 22 ..
16.37.m: Then after a long time you met your death. / Thereupon you were born in the house of the lord of Daśārṇa, O lovely lady.

16.37.s:
bṛhadrathena coḍhāsi kaṃkaṇasya prabhā vataḥ..
na vrataṃ na tapo dānaṃ tvayā cīrṇaṃ purā śubhe .. 23 ..
16.37.d:
बृहद्रथेन चोढासि कंकणस्य प्रभा वतः..
न व्रतं न तपो दानं त्वया चीर्णं पुरा शुभे .. 23 ..
16.37.m: And you were wedded by Bṛhadratha, through the power of the bangle. / Neither observance, nor austerity, nor gift was performed by you formerly, O auspicious lady.

16.37.s:
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi ..
tacchrutvā sā viśālākṣī trapayā'dho mukhī tathā ..
āsīttūṣṇīṃ tadā devī śrutvā vākyaṃ ca tādṛśam .. 24 ..
16.37.d:
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा सा विशालाक्षी त्रपयाऽधो मुखी तथा ..
आसीत्तूष्णीं तदा देवी श्रुत्वा वाक्यं च तादृशम् .. 24 ..
16.37.m: All this has been related to you, which you asked me. / Having heard that, the large-eyed lady cast her face downward in modesty; / the queen then remained silent having heard such words.

16.37.s:
evaṃ nivedya sa munī rājapatnīṃ varānane ..
jagāma bhavanaṃ svaṃ ca āmaṃtrya vasudhādhipam .. 25 ..
16.37.d:
एवं निवेद्य स मुनी राजपत्नीं वरानने ..
जगाम भवनं स्वं च आमंत्र्य वसुधाधिपम् .. 25 ..
16.37.m: Having thus informed the king's wife, O fair-faced one, / that sage took leave of the lord of the earth and went to his own abode.

16.37.s:
jñātvā phalaṃ kaṃkaṇasya munestasya prabhāvataḥ ..
gatvā someśvaraṃ devaṃ snātvā ca lavaṇāṃbhasi .. 26 ..
16.37.d:
ज्ञात्वा फलं कंकणस्य मुनेस्तस्य प्रभावतः ..
गत्वा सोमेश्वरं देवं स्नात्वा च लवणांभसि .. 26 ..
16.37.m: Knowing the fruit of the bangle through the power of that sage, / she went to the god Someśvara, bathed in the salt water,

16.37.s:
prākṣipatkaṃkaṇaṃ tatra prativarṣaṃ(?) mahāprabhe ..
tato devatvamāpannā prabhāvāttasya bhāmini .. 27 ..
16.37.d:
प्राक्षिपत्कंकणं तत्र प्रतिवर्षं(?) महाप्रभे ..
ततो देवत्वमापन्ना प्रभावात्तस्य भामिनि .. 27 ..
16.37.m: and cast a bangle there every year, O greatly radiant one; / thereupon she attained godhood through the power of that, O passionate lady.

16.37.s:
īśvara uvāca .. ..
eṣa prabhāvaḥ sumahānkaṃkaṇasya prakīrtitaḥ ..
sarvakāmaprado devi sarvapāpapraṇāśanaḥ .. 28 ..
16.37.d:
ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
एष प्रभावः सुमहान्कंकणस्य प्रकीर्तितः ..
सर्वकामप्रदो देवि सर्वपापप्रणाशनः .. 28 ..
16.37.m: Īśvara said: / This great power of the bangle has been proclaimed, / which grants all desires, O goddess, and destroys all sins.

16.37.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye someśvaramāhātmye kaṃkaṇamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 37 .. .. ..
16.37.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभास खण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये सोमेश्वरमाहात्म्ये कंकणमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम सप्तत्रिंशोऽध्यायः .. 37 .. .. ..
16.37.m: Thus ends the thirty-seventh chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of the Bangle' in the Glory of Someśvara, in the Glory of the Prabhāsa Sacred Field, in the First [Part of] the Prabhāsa Section, in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.38.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
yadetadbhavatā proktaṃ paśyetpūrvaṃ kaparddinam ..
bhagavansaṃśayaṃ hyenaṃ yathāvadvaktumarhasi .. 1 ..
16.38.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
यदेतद्भवता प्रोक्तं पश्येत्पूर्वं कपर्द्दिनम् ..
भगवन्संशयं ह्येनं यथावद्वक्तुमर्हसि .. 1 ..
16.38.m: The goddess said: / As to what was said by you, that one should first see Kapardin: / O blessed lord, you ought to explain this doubt properly.

16.38.s:
sa bhṛtyaḥ kila deveśa tava śambho mahāprabhaḥ ..
prabhoranantaraṃ bhṛtya eṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ .. 2 ..
16.38.d:
स भृत्यः किल देवेश तव शम्भो महाप्रभः ..
प्रभोरनन्तरं भृत्य एष धर्मः सनातनः .. 2 ..
16.38.m: He is indeed your servant, O lord of the gods, O Śambhu of great splendor; / the servant comes after the master: this is the eternal law.

16.38.s:
īśvara uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi yathā pūjyatamo hi saḥ ..
kaparddī sarvadevānāmādyo vighneśvaraḥ prabhuḥ .. 3 ..
16.38.d:
ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि यथा पूज्यतमो हि सः ..
कपर्द्दी सर्वदेवानामाद्यो विघ्नेश्वरः प्रभुः .. 3 ..
16.38.m: Īśvara said: / Listen, O goddess, I shall explain how he is most worthy of worship: / Kapardī is the lord Vighneśvara, foremost among all the gods.

16.38.s:
yo'sāvatīṃdriyagrāhyaḥ prabhāsakṣetrasaṃsthitaḥ ..
someśvaro mahādevi liṃgarūpī sadāśivaḥ .. 4 ...
16.38.d:
योऽसावतींद्रियग्राह्यः प्रभासक्षेत्रसंस्थितः ..
सोमेश्वरो महादेवि लिंगरूपी सदाशिवः .. 4 ...
16.38.m: He who is beyond the grasp of the senses, residing in the Prabhāsa sacred field, / is Someśvara, O great goddess, Sadāśiva in the form of a liṅga.

16.38.s:
tasya vāme sthito viṣṇurvarāha iti yaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
tasya dakṣiṇabhāge tu sthito brahmā prajāpatiḥ ..
kaparddirūpamāsthāya sāvitryāḥ kopakāraṇāt .. 5 ..
16.38.d:
तस्य वामे स्थितो विष्णुर्वराह इति यः स्मृतः ..
तस्य दक्षिणभागे तु स्थितो ब्रह्मा प्रजापतिः ..
कपर्द्दिरूपमास्थाय सावित्र्याः कोपकारणात् .. 5 ..
16.38.m: On his left stands Viṣṇu, who is remembered as Varāha; / and on his right side stands Brahmā Prajāpati, / having assumed the form of Kapardin on account of Sāvitrī's anger.

16.38.s:
kṛte heraṃbanāmā tu tretāyāṃ vighnamarddanaḥ ..
laṃbodaro dvāpare tu kaparddī tu kalau smṛtaḥ .. 6 ..
16.38.d:
कृते हेरंबनामा तु त्रेतायां विघ्नमर्द्दनः ..
लंबोदरो द्वापरे तु कपर्द्दी तु कलौ स्मृतः .. 6 ..
16.38.m: Named Heramba in the Kṛta age, crusher of obstacles (Vighnamardana) in the Tretā, / Lambodara in the Dvāpara, but remembered as Kapardin in the Kali age.

16.38.s:
evaṃ yugeyuge tasya avatāraḥ pṛthakpṛthak ..
yathākāryānurūpeṇa jāyate ca punaḥpunaḥ .. 7 ..
16.38.d:
एवं युगेयुगे तस्य अवतारः पृथक्पृथक् ..
यथाकार्यानुरूपेण जायते च पुनःपुनः .. 7 ..
16.38.m: Thus in every yuga his incarnation is distinct; / he is born again and again in accordance with the task to be done.

16.38.s:
aṣṭāviṃśatime tatra devi prāpte caturyuge ..
kāraṇātmā yathotpannaḥ kaparddī tatra me śṛṇu .. 8 ..
16.38.d:
अष्टाविंशतिमे तत्र देवि प्राप्ते चतुर्युगे ..
कारणात्मा यथोत्पन्नः कपर्द्दी तत्र मे शृणु .. 8 ..
16.38.m: When the twenty-eighth four-age cycle (caturyuga) had arrived, O goddess, / hear from me how Kapardin, the causal self, was born there.

16.38.s:
purā dvāparasaṃdhau tu saṃprāpte ca kalau yuge ..
striyo mlecchāśca śūdrāśca ye cānye pāpakāriṇaḥ ..
prayāṃti svargamevāśu dṛṣṭvā someśvaraṃ prabhum .. 9 ..
16.38.d:
पुरा द्वापरसंधौ तु संप्राप्ते च कलौ युगे ..
स्त्रियो म्लेच्छाश्च शूद्राश्च ये चान्ये पापकारिणः ..
प्रयांति स्वर्गमेवाशु दृष्ट्वा सोमेश्वरं प्रभुम् .. 9 ..
16.38.m: Formerly, at the junction of the Dvāpara and the arrival of the Kali age, / women, barbarians, and Śūdras, and whatever other evildoers there were, / quickly went to heaven merely upon seeing the lord Someśvara.

16.38.s:
na yajñā na tapo dānaṃ na svādhpāyo vrataṃ na ca ..
kurvatopi narā devi sarve yāṃti śivālayam .. 7.1.38.10 ..
16.38.d:
न यज्ञा न तपो दानं न स्वाध्पायो व्रतं न च ..
कुर्वतोपि नरा देवि सर्वे यांति शिवालयम् .. 7.1.38.10 ..
16.38.m: No sacrifices, no austerity, no giving, no Vedic study, and no observances; / yet men, though doing [none of these], O goddess, all went to Śiva's abode.

16.38.s:
taṃ prabhāvaṃ viditvaivaṃ someśvarasamudbhavam ..
agniṣṭomādikāḥ sarvāḥ kriyā naṣṭāḥ sureśvari .. 11 ..
16.38.d:
तं प्रभावं विदित्वैवं सोमेश्वरसमुद्भवम् ..
अग्निष्टोमादिकाः सर्वाः क्रिया नष्टाः सुरेश्वरि .. 11 ..
16.38.m: Knowing such power arising from Someśvara, / all rites beginning with the Agniṣṭoma were destroyed, O ruler of the gods.

16.38.s:
tato bālāśca vṛddhāśca ṛṣayo vedapāragāḥ ..
śūdrāḥ striyo'pi taṃ dṛṣṭvā prayāṃti paramāṃ gatim .. 12 ..
16.38.d:
ततो बालाश्च वृद्धाश्च ऋषयो वेदपारगाः ..
शूद्राः स्त्रियोऽपि तं दृष्ट्वा प्रयांति परमां गतिम् .. 12 ..
16.38.m: Then children and the elderly, seers who have mastered the Vedas, / even Śūdras and women, having seen him, attained the highest state.

16.38.s:
naṣṭayajñotsave kāle śūnye ca vasudhātale ..
ūrddhvabāhubhirākrāṃtaṃ paripūrṇaṃ triviṣṭapam .. 13 ..
16.38.d:
नष्टयज्ञोत्सवे काले शून्ये च वसुधातले ..
ऊर्द्ध्वबाहुभिराक्रांतं परिपूर्णं त्रिविष्टपम् .. 13 ..
16.38.m: When sacrificial festivals were destroyed and the surface of the earth was deserted, / heaven was filled and overrun by those with upraised arms.

16.38.s:
tato devā maheṃdrādyā duḥkhenaiva samanvitāḥ ..
paribhūtā manuṣyaiste śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ .. 14 ..
16.38.d:
ततो देवा महेंद्राद्या दुःखेनैव समन्विताः ..
परिभूता मनुष्यैस्ते शंकरं शरणं गताः .. 14 ..
16.38.m: Then the gods, Mahendra and the others, filled with sorrow, / overcome by those mortals, went to Śaṃkara for refuge.

16.38.s:
ūcuḥ prāṃjalayaḥ sarva indrādyāḥ surasattamāḥ ..
vyāptoyaṃ mānuṣaiḥ svargaḥ prasādāttava śaṃkara .. 15 ..
16.38.d:
ऊचुः प्रांजलयः सर्व इन्द्राद्याः सुरसत्तमाः ..
व्याप्तोयं मानुषैः स्वर्गः प्रसादात्तव शंकर .. 15 ..
16.38.m: With folded hands, all the best of the gods, Indra and the others, said: / 'By your grace, O Śaṃkara, this heaven has been overrun by mortals.

16.38.s:
nivāsāya prabho'smākaṃ sthānaṃ kiṃcitsamādiśa ..
ahaṃ śreṣṭho hyahaṃ śreṣṭha ityevaṃ te parasparam..
jalpaṃtaḥ sarvato deva paryaṭaṃti yathecchayā .. 16 ..
16.38.d:
निवासाय प्रभोऽस्माकं स्थानं किंचित्समादिश ..
अहं श्रेष्ठो ह्यहं श्रेष्ठ इत्येवं ते परस्परम्..
जल्पंतः सर्वतो देव पर्यटंति यथेच्छया .. 16 ..
16.38.m: Assign some place for our dwelling, O lord! / Boasting mutually, "I am the best! I am the best!", / they wander about in every direction at will, O god.

16.38.s:
dharmarājaḥ sudharmātmā teṣāṃ karma śubhāśubham..
svayaṃ likhitamālokya tūṣṇīmāste suvismitaḥ ..17..
16.38.d:
धर्मराजः सुधर्मात्मा तेषां कर्म शुभाशुभम्..
स्वयं लिखितमालोक्य तूष्णीमास्ते सुविस्मितः ..17..
16.38.m: Dharmarāja, the very soul of righteousness, seeing their good and bad karma / recorded by himself, sits silent in great bewilderment.

16.38.s:
yeṣāmatha kṛtaṃ sajjaṃ kumbhīpākaṃ sudāruṇam ..
rauravaḥ śālmalirdeva dṛṣṭvā tāndivi saṃsthitān ..
vailakṣyaṃ paramaṃ gatvā vyāpāraṃ tyaktavānasau .. .. 18 ..
16.38.d:
येषामथ कृतं सज्जं कुम्भीपाकं सुदारुणम् ..
रौरवः शाल्मलिर्देव दृष्ट्वा तान्दिवि संस्थितान् ..
वैलक्ष्यं परमं गत्वा व्यापारं त्यक्तवानसौ .. .. 18 ..
16.38.m: Seeing those for whom the dreadful Kumbhīpāka, / Raurava, and Śālmali [hells] were made ready, now staying in heaven, O god, / he fell into supreme embarrassment and abandoned his duties.'

16.38.s:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
pratijñātaṃ mayā sarvaṃ bhaktyā tuṣṭena vai surāḥ ..
somāya mama sāṃnidhyamasminkṣetre bhaviṣyati .. 19 ..
16.38.d:
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
प्रतिज्ञातं मया सर्वं भक्त्या तुष्टेन वै सुराः ..
सोमाय मम सांनिध्यमस्मिन्क्षेत्रे भविष्यति .. 19 ..
16.38.m: The Blessed Lord said: / 'Everything was promised by me, pleased by the devotion of Soma, O gods: / "My presence shall be in this sacred field."

16.38.s:
na śakyamanyathākartumātmano yadudīritam..
evaṃ yāsyaṃti te svargaṃ ye māṃ drakṣyaṃti tatra vai .. 7.1.38.20 ..
16.38.d:
न शक्यमन्यथाकर्तुमात्मनो यदुदीरितम्..
एवं यास्यंति ते स्वर्गं ये मां द्रक्ष्यंति तत्र वै .. 7.1.38.20 ..
16.38.m: What has been uttered by oneself cannot be undone; / thus they who see me there shall indeed go to heaven.'

16.38.s:
bhayodvignāstato devāḥ pārvatīṃ prekṣya viśvataḥ ..
ūcuḥ prāṃjalayaḥ sarve tvamasmākaṃ gatirbhava .. 21 ..
16.38.d:
भयोद्विग्नास्ततो देवाः पार्वतीं प्रेक्ष्य विश्वतः ..
ऊचुः प्रांजलयः सर्वे त्वमस्माकं गतिर्भव .. 21 ..
16.38.m: Agitated with fear, the gods, looking on all sides toward Pārvatī, / all said with folded hands: 'Be our refuge!'

16.38.s:
evamuktvā'stuvandevāḥ stotreṇānena sattama ..
jānubhyāṃ dharaṇīṃ gatvā śirasyādhāya cāṃjalim .. .. 22 ..
16.38.d:
एवमुक्त्वाऽस्तुवन्देवाः स्तोत्रेणानेन सत्तम ..
जानुभ्यां धरणीं गत्वा शिरस्याधाय चांजलिम् .. .. 22 ..
16.38.m: Having spoken thus, O best of beings, the gods praised [her] with this hymn, / going down upon their knees on the earth and placing their folded hands upon their heads:

16.38.s:
.. devā ūcuḥ .. ..
namaste devadeveśi namaste viśvadhātrike ..
namaste padmapatrākṣi namaste kāṃcanadyute ..23 ..
16.38.d:
.. देवा ऊचुः .. ..
नमस्ते देवदेवेशि नमस्ते विश्वधात्रिके ..
नमस्ते पद्मपत्राक्षि नमस्ते कांचनद्युते ..23 ..
16.38.m: The gods said: / 'Salutations to you, O ruler of the gods! Salutations to you, O supporter of the universe! / Salutations to you, whose eyes are like lotus petals! Salutations to you, radiant as gold!

16.38.s:
namaste saṃhartri kartri namaste śaṃkarapriye ..
kālarātri namastubhyaṃ namaste giriputrike..24..
16.38.d:
नमस्ते संहर्त्रि कर्त्रि नमस्ते शंकरप्रिये ..
कालरात्रि नमस्तुभ्यं नमस्ते गिरिपुत्रिके..24..
16.38.m: Salutations to you, destroyer and creator! Salutations to you, beloved of Śaṃkara! / Salutations to you, O Kālarātri! Salutations to you, daughter of the mountain!

16.38.s:
ārye bhadre viśālākṣi namaste lokasundari..
tvaṃ ratistvaṃ dhṛtistvaṃ śrīstvaṃ svāhā tvaṃ sudhā satī .. 25 ..
16.38.d:
आर्ये भद्रे विशालाक्षि नमस्ते लोकसुन्दरि..
त्वं रतिस्त्वं धृतिस्त्वं श्रीस्त्वं स्वाहा त्वं सुधा सती .. 25 ..
16.38.m: O noble lady, auspicious one, wide-eyed one, salutations to you, beauty of the world! / You are Rati, you are Dhṛti, you are Śrī, you are Svāhā, you are nectar, the faithful wife.

16.38.s:
tvaṃ durgā tvaṃ manirmedhā tvaṃ sarvaṃ tvaṃ vasundharā ..
tvayā sarvamidaṃ vyāptaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram .. 26 ..
16.38.d:
त्वं दुर्गा त्वं मनिर्मेधा त्वं सर्वं त्वं वसुन्धरा ..
त्वया सर्वमिदं व्याप्तं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् .. 26 ..
16.38.m: You are Durgā, you are thought and intellect, you are all, you are the earth. / By you this entire threefold world, moving and unmoving, is pervaded.

16.38.s:
nadīṣu parvatāgreṣu sāgareṣu guhāsu ca ..
araṇyeṣu ca caityeṣu saṃgrāmeṣvāśrameṣu ca .. 27 ..
16.38.d:
नदीषु पर्वताग्रेषु सागरेषु गुहासु च ..
अरण्येषु च चैत्येषु संग्रामेष्वाश्रमेषु च .. 27 ..
16.38.m: In rivers, on mountain peaks, in oceans and in caves, / in forests and sacred sanctuaries, in battles and in hermitages,

16.38.s:
trailokye tatra paśyāmo yatra tvaṃ devi na sthitā ..
etajjñātvā viśālākṣi trāhi no mahato bhayāt ..28..
16.38.d:
त्रैलोक्ये तत्र पश्यामो यत्र त्वं देवि न स्थिता ..
एतज्ज्ञात्वा विशालाक्षि त्राहि नो महतो भयात् ..28..
16.38.m: in the threefold world, where can we see where you, O goddess, are not present? / Knowing this, O wide-eyed lady, save us from great peril!'

16.38.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
evamuktā tu sā devī devairiṃdrapurogamaiḥ ..
kāruṇyānnijadehaṃ tvaṃ tadā mardditavatyasi .. 29 ..
16.38.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
एवमुक्ता तु सा देवी देवैरिंद्रपुरोगमैः ..
कारुण्यान्निजदेहं त्वं तदा मर्द्दितवत्यसि .. 29 ..
16.38.m: Īśvara said: / Thus addressed by the gods led by Indra, / you, O goddess, out of compassion rubbed your own body at that time.

16.38.s:
mardayaṃtyāstava tadā saṃjātaṃ ca mahanmalam ..
tatra jajñe gajeṃdrāsyaścaturbāhurmanoharaḥ .. 7.1.38.30 ..
16.38.d:
मर्दयंत्यास्तव तदा संजातं च महन्मलम् ..
तत्र जज्ञे गजेंद्रास्यश्चतुर्बाहुर्मनोहरः .. 7.1.38.30 ..
16.38.m: As you were rubbing it, a great mass of dirt arose; / from it was born a handsome four-armed [figure] with the face of a lordly elephant.

16.38.s:
tatobravītsurānsarvānbhavatī karuṇātmikā ..
eṣa eva mayā sṛṣṭo yuṣmākaṃ hitakāmyayā .. 31 ..
16.38.d:
ततोब्रवीत्सुरान्सर्वान्भवती करुणात्मिका ..
एष एव मया सृष्टो युष्माकं हितकाम्यया .. 31 ..
16.38.m: Then you, full of compassion, said to all the gods: / 'This very one has been created by me wishing your welfare.

16.38.s: eṣa vighnāni sarvāṇi prāṇināṃ saṃvidhāsyati ..32 ..
16.38.d: एष विघ्नानि सर्वाणि प्राणिनां संविधास्यति ..32 ..
16.38.m: He will arrange all obstacles for living beings.

16.38.s:
mohena mahatā''viṣṭāḥ kāmopahatabuddhayaḥ ..
somanāthamapaśyaṃto yāsyaṃti narakaṃ narāḥ ..33..
16.38.d:
मोहेन महता'ऽविष्टाः कामोपहतबुद्धयः ..
सोमनाथमपश्यंतो यास्यंति नरकं नराः ..33..
16.38.m: Afflicted with great delusion, their intellects impaired by desire, / men will go to hell, not beholding Somanātha.'

16.38.s:
evaṃ te vacanaṃ śrutvā sarve te hṛṣṭamānasāḥ ..
svasthānaṃ bhejire devāstyaktvā mānuṣajaṃ bhayam ..34..
16.38.d:
एवं ते वचनं श्रुत्वा सर्वे ते हृष्टमानसाः ..
स्वस्थानं भेजिरे देवास्त्यक्त्वा मानुषजं भयम् ..34..
16.38.m: Having heard your words thus, all the gods, gladdened in mind, / went to their own abode, casting off their fear born of mortals.

16.38.s:
athe bhavadanaḥ prāha tvāṃ devi vinayānvitaḥ ..
kiṃ karomi viśālākṣi ādeśo dīyatāṃ mama .. 35 ..
16.38.d:
अथे भवदनः प्राह त्वां देवि विनयान्वितः ..
किं करोमि विशालाक्षि आदेशो दीयतां मम .. 35 ..
16.38.m: Then the elephant-faced one, endowed with modesty, said to you, O goddess: / 'What shall I do, O wide-eyed lady? Let a command be given to me.'

16.38.s:
.. śrībhagavatyuvāca .. ..
gaccha prābhāsikaṃ kṣetraṃ yatra saṃnihito haraḥ ..
tadrakṣa mānuṣāṇāṃ ca yathā nāyāti gocaram ..36..
16.38.d:
.. श्रीभगवत्युवाच .. ..
गच्छ प्राभासिकं क्षेत्रं यत्र संनिहितो हरः ..
तद्रक्ष मानुषाणां च यथा नायाति गोचरम् ..36..
16.38.m: The holy Goddess said: / 'Go to the sacred field of Prabhāsa, where Hara is present; / protect it so that it does not come within the sight of mortals.

16.38.s:
liṃgaṃ tu devadevasya sthāpitaṃ śaśinā svayam ..
bhavatyā''deśito nityaṃ nṛṇāṃ vighnaṃ karoti yaḥ .. 37 ..
16.38.d:
लिंगं तु देवदेवस्य स्थापितं शशिना स्वयम् ..
भवत्या'ऽदेशितो नित्यं नृणां विघ्नं करोति यः .. 37 ..
16.38.m: The liṅga of the god of gods was established by the Moon himself. / Commanded by you, he who continually creates obstacles for men,

16.38.s:
prasthitaṃ puruṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā somanāthaṃ prati prabhum..
sa karoti mahāvighnaṃ kapardī lokapūjitaḥ .. 38 ..
16.38.d:
प्रस्थितं पुरुषं दृष्ट्वा सोमनाथं प्रति प्रभुम्..
स करोति महाविघ्नं कपर्दी लोकपूजितः .. 38 ..
16.38.m: seeing a man set out toward the lord Somanātha, / that Kapardin, worshipped by the world, creates great obstacles.

16.38.s:
putradāragṛhakṣetra dhanadhānyasamudbhavam ..
janayetsa mahāmohaṃ tataḥ paśyati no haram .. 39 ..
16.38.d:
पुत्रदारगृहक्षेत्र धनधान्यसमुद्भवम् ..
जनयेत्स महामोहं ततः पश्यति नो हरम् .. 39 ..
16.38.m: He produces great delusion arising from sons, wives, houses, fields, / wealth, and grain; thereafter, [the man] does not see Hara.

16.38.s:
athavā gaḍugaṃḍādi vyādhiṃ caiva samutsṛjet ..
tairgrastaḥ puruṣo mohānna paśyati tato haram.. 7.1.38.40 ..
16.38.d:
अथवा गडुगंडादि व्याधिं चैव समुत्सृजेत् ..
तैर्ग्रस्तः पुरुषो मोहान्न पश्यति ततो हरम्.. 7.1.38.40 ..
16.38.m: Or else he may cast forth diseases such as tumours and swellings; / seized by them, out of delusion the man does not see Hara thereafter.

16.38.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena someśvaraparīpsayā ..
sa nityaṃ pūjanīyastu smartavyastu divāniśam .. 41 ..
16.38.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन सोमेश्वरपरीप्सया ..
स नित्यं पूजनीयस्तु स्मर्तव्यस्तु दिवानिशम् .. 41 ..
16.38.m: Therefore, by every effort, with the desire to reach Someśvara, / he should indeed be worshipped constantly and remembered day and night.

16.38.s:
stotreṇānena deveśi sarvavighnāṃtakena vai..
samārādhya gaṇādhyakṣaḥ prabhāsakṣetrarakṣakaḥ ..42..
16.38.d:
स्तोत्रेणानेन देवेशि सर्वविघ्नांतकेन वै..
समाराध्य गणाध्यक्षः प्रभासक्षेत्ररक्षकः ..42..
16.38.m: By this hymn that ends all obstacles, O ruler of the gods, / the guardian of the sacred field of Prabhāsa, the lord of the gaṇas, is to be propitiated.

16.38.s:
tatte'haṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi stotraṃ tadvighramardanam..
kapardino mahādevi sāvadhānāvadhāraya .. ..43..
16.38.d:
तत्तेऽहं संप्रवक्ष्यामि स्तोत्रं तद्विघ्रमर्दनम्..
कपर्दिनो महादेवि सावधानावधारय .. ..43..
16.38.m: I shall declare to you that obstacle-crushing hymn / of Kapardin, O great goddess; listen attentively:

16.38.s:
oṃ namo vighnarājāya namaste'stu kapardine..
namo mahogradaṃṣṭrāya prabhāsakṣetravāsine..44..
16.38.d:
ओं नमो विघ्नराजाय नमस्तेऽस्तु कपर्दिने..
नमो महोग्रदंष्ट्राय प्रभासक्षेत्रवासिने..44..
16.38.m: Om! Salutations to the king of obstacles! Salutations be to Kapardin! / Salutations to the one with fierce large tusks, dwelling in the sacred field of Prabhāsa!

16.38.s:
kapardinaṃ namaskṛtya yātrānirvighrahetave..
stoṣye'haṃ vighnarājānaṃ siddhibuddhipriyaṃ śubham ..45..
16.38.d:
कपर्दिनं नमस्कृत्य यात्रानिर्विघ्रहेतवे..
स्तोष्येऽहं विघ्नराजानं सिद्धिबुद्धिप्रियं शुभम् ..45..
16.38.m: Having bowed to Kapardin for the sake of a journey free from obstacles, / I shall praise the king of obstacles, dear to Siddhi and Buddhi, the auspicious one,

16.38.s:
mahāgaṇapatiṃ śūramajitaṃ jayavarddhanam..
ekadaṃtaṃ ca dvidaṃtaṃ caturdaṃtaṃ caturbhujam..46..
16.38.d:
महागणपतिं शूरमजितं जयवर्द्धनम्..
एकदंतं च द्विदंतं चतुर्दंतं चतुर्भुजम्..46..
16.38.m: the great Gaṇapati, the valiant, the unconquered, the increaser of victory, / single-tusked, two-tusked, four-tusked, and four-armed,

16.38.s:
tryakṣaṃ ca śūlahastaṃ ca rakta netraṃ varapradam ..
ajeyaṃ śaṃkukarṇaṃ ca pracaṇḍaṃ daṃḍanāyakam..
āyaskadaṃḍinaṃ caiva hutavaktraṃ hutapriyam .. 47..
16.38.d:
त्र्यक्षं च शूलहस्तं च रक्त नेत्रं वरप्रदम् ..
अजेयं शंकुकर्णं च प्रचण्डं दंडनायकम्..
आयस्कदंडिनं चैव हुतवक्त्रं हुतप्रियम् .. 47..
16.38.m: three-eyed, holding a trident, red-eyed, the granter of boons, / invincible, with conch-shaped ears, the fierce leader of punishment, / holding an iron staff, fire-mouthed, and fond of oblations.

16.38.s:
anarcito vighnakaraḥ sarvakāryeṣu yo nṛṇām ..
taṃ namāmi gaṇādhyakṣaṃ bhīmamugramumāsutam .. 48 ..
16.38.d:
अनर्चितो विघ्नकरः सर्वकार्येषु यो नृणाम् ..
तं नमामि गणाध्यक्षं भीममुग्रमुमासुतम् .. 48 ..
16.38.m: Who, when unhonoured, causes obstacles in all the undertakings of men, / to that lord of gaṇas, terrible, fierce, the son of Umā, I bow;

16.38.s:
madavataṃ virūpākṣamibhavaktrasamaprabham ..
dhruvaṃ ca niścalaṃ śāṃtaṃ taṃ namāmi vināyakam ..49..
16.38.d:
मदवतं विरूपाक्षमिभवक्त्रसमप्रभम् ..
ध्रुवं च निश्चलं शांतं तं नमामि विनायकम् ..49..
16.38.m: exuding rut, diverse-eyed, radiant as an elephant's face, / firm, unmoving, peaceful—to that Vināyaka I bow.

16.38.s:
tvayā pūrveṇa vapuṣā devānāṃ kāryasiddhaye ..
gajarūpaṃ samāsthāya trāsitāḥ sarvadānavāḥ .. 7.1.38.50 ..
16.38.d:
त्वया पूर्वेण वपुषा देवानां कार्यसिद्धये ..
गजरूपं समास्थाय त्रासिताः सर्वदानवाः .. 7.1.38.50 ..
16.38.m: By you, in your previous form, for the accomplishment of the purpose of the gods, / having assumed an elephant's shape, all the Dānavas were terrified,

16.38.s: ṛṣīṇāṃ devatānāṃ ca nāyakatvaṃ prakāśitam .. 51 ..
16.38.d: ऋषीणां देवतानां च नायकत्वं प्रकाशितम् .. 51 ..
16.38.m: and your leadership over the seers and deities was revealed.

16.38.s:
iti stutaḥ surairagre pūjyase tvaṃ bhavātmaja ..
tvāmārādhya gaṇādhyakṣamibhavaktrasamaprabham.. 52 ..
16.38.d:
इति स्तुतः सुरैरग्रे पूज्यसे त्वं भवात्मज ..
त्वामाराध्य गणाध्यक्षमिभवक्त्रसमप्रभम्.. 52 ..
16.38.m: Thus praised before by the gods, you are worshipped, O son of Bhava! / Having worshipped you, the lord of gaṇas, radiant as an elephant's face,

16.38.s:
dhruvaṃ ca niścalaṃ śāṃtaṃ parītaṃ vi jayaśriyā ..
kāryārthaṃ raktakusumai raktacaṃdanavāribhiḥ .. 53 ..
16.38.d:
ध्रुवं च निश्चलं शांतं परीतं वि जयश्रिया ..
कार्यार्थं रक्तकुसुमै रक्तचंदनवारिभिः .. 53 ..
16.38.m: firm, unmoving, peaceful, surrounded by the fortune of victory, / for the sake of accomplishing [one's] task, with red flowers and red sandalwood water,

16.38.s:
raktāṃbaradharo bhūtvā caturthyāmarcayettu yaḥ ..
ekakālaṃ dvikālaṃ vā niyato niyatāśanaḥ .. 54 ..
16.38.d:
रक्तांबरधरो भूत्वा चतुर्थ्यामर्चयेत्तु यः ..
एककालं द्विकालं वा नियतो नियताशनः .. 54 ..
16.38.m: wearing red garments, on the fourth day, he who should worship [him], / once or twice a day, restrained and eating measured food,

16.38.s:
rājānaṃ rājaputraṃ vā rājamaṃtriṇameva ca ..
rājyaṃ vā sarvavighneśo vaśīkuryātsarāṣṭrakam .. 55 ..
16.38.d:
राजानं राजपुत्रं वा राजमंत्रिणमेव च ..
राज्यं वा सर्वविघ्नेशो वशीकुर्यात्सराष्ट्रकम् .. 55 ..
16.38.m: the lord of all obstacles would bring under his control a king, a prince, / a royal minister, or the whole kingdom along with its realm.

16.38.s:
yatphalaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu sarvayajñeṣu yatphalam..
sa tatphalamavāpnoti smṛtvā devaṃ vināyakam .. 56 ..
16.38.d:
यत्फलं सर्वतीर्थेषु सर्वयज्ञेषु यत्फलम्..
स तत्फलमवाप्नोति स्मृत्वा देवं विनायकम् .. 56 ..
16.38.m: Whatever fruit is attained at all sacred fords, whatever fruit in all sacrifices, / that fruit he obtains by remembering the divine Vināyaka.

16.38.s:
viṣamaṃ na bhavettasya na sa gacchetparābhavam ..
na ca vighnaṃ bhavettasya jano jātismaro bhavet .. 57 ..
16.38.d:
विषमं न भवेत्तस्य न स गच्छेत्पराभवम् ..
न च विघ्नं भवेत्तस्य जनो जातिस्मरो भवेत् .. 57 ..
16.38.m: No adversity will befall him, nor will he suffer defeat, / nor will there be any obstacle for him; a person will remember their past lives.

16.38.s:
ya idaṃ paṭhati stotraṃ ṣaḍbhirmāsairvaraṃ labhet ..
saṃvatsareṇa siddhiṃ ca labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 58 ..
16.38.d:
य इदं पठति स्तोत्रं षड्भिर्मासैर्वरं लभेत् ..
संवत्सरेण सिद्धिं च लभते नात्र संशयः .. 58 ..
16.38.m: Whoever recites this hymn obtains a boon within six months; / and in a year he obtains perfection, there is no doubt about this.

16.38.s:
prasādāddarśanaṃ yāti tasya someśvaraḥ prabhuḥ..
kapardākāramudaraṃ yato'sya samudāhṛtam..
tato'sya nāma jānīhi kaparddīti mahātmanaḥ .. 59 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kapardivināyakamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭātriṃśodhyāyaḥ .. 38 ..
16.38.d:
प्रसादाद्दर्शनं याति तस्य सोमेश्वरः प्रभुः..
कपर्दाकारमुदरं यतोऽस्य समुदाहृतम्..
ततोऽस्य नाम जानीहि कपर्द्दीति महात्मनः .. 59 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये कपर्दिविनायकमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामाष्टात्रिंशोध्यायः .. 38 ..
16.38.m:
Through his grace, the lord Someśvara grants darśana. / Because his belly is said to resemble a cowrie-shell, / therefore know the name of this great-souled one to be Kapardin.'
Thus ends the thirty-eighth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Glory of Kapardivināyaka,' in the first [sub-section], the Māhātmya of the Prabhāsakṣetra, in the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.39.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
atha saṃpūjya vidhinā devadevaṃ kaparddinam ..
tato gacchenmahādevi ligaṃ kedārasaṃsthitam .. 1 ..
16.39.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
अथ संपूज्य विधिना देवदेवं कपर्द्दिनम् ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि लिगं केदारसंस्थितम् .. 1 ..
16.39.m: Īśvara said: / 'Then, having properly worshipped the god of gods, Kapardin, / one should go, O great goddess, to the liṅga situated at Kedāra.

16.39.s:
tasyaivāgneyabhāgasthaṃ bhīmeśvarasamīpagam..
svayaṃbhūtaṃ mahādevi kalpaliṃgaṃ mama priyam .. 2 ..
16.39.d:
तस्यैवाग्नेयभागस्थं भीमेश्वरसमीपगम्..
स्वयंभूतं महादेवि कल्पलिंगं मम प्रियम् .. 2 ..
16.39.m: Situated in its south-eastern direction, near Bhīmeśvara, / is the self-manifest Kalpaliṅga, dear to me, O great goddess.

16.39.s:
mayā saṃpūjitaṃ devi vṛddhiliṃga mahāprabham..
nirāhārastu yastatra karotyekaṃ prajāgaram .. 3 ..
16.39.d:
मया संपूजितं देवि वृद्धिलिंग महाप्रभम्..
निराहारस्तु यस्तत्र करोत्येकं प्रजागरम् .. 3 ..
16.39.m: Worshipped by me, O goddess, is the Vṛddhiliṅga of great splendour; / whoever, fasting there, keeps a single vigil,

16.39.s:
caturdaśyāṃ viśeṣeṇa tasya lokāḥ sanātanāḥ ..
rudreśvareti devasya tvāsīnnāma purā yuge .. 4 ..
16.39.d:
चतुर्दश्यां विशेषेण तस्य लोकाः सनातनाः ..
रुद्रेश्वरेति देवस्य त्वासीन्नाम पुरा युगे .. 4 ..
16.39.m: especially on the fourteenth day, his worlds are eternal. / In an earlier cosmic age, the name of the god was Rudreśvara.'

16.39.s:
tiṣyesmiṃstu punaḥ prāpte mlecchasparśabhayāturaḥ ..
asmim̐lliṃge layaṃ yātaḥ kedāraścābdhisaṃnidhau .. 5 ..
16.39.d:
तिष्येस्मिंस्तु पुनः प्राप्ते म्लेच्छस्पर्शभयातुरः ..
अस्मिम्̐ल्लिंगे लयं यातः केदारश्चाब्धिसंनिधौ .. 5 ..
16.39.m: When this Kali age arrived, however, frightened by the touch of barbarians, / Kedāra dissolved into this liṅga near the ocean.

16.39.s:
tena kedāranāmeti tasya khyātaṃ dharātale ..
māghe māsi yatāhāraḥ snātvā tu lavaṇodadhau ..6..
16.39.d:
तेन केदारनामेति तस्य ख्यातं धरातले ..
माघे मासि यताहारः स्नात्वा तु लवणोदधौ ..6..
16.39.m: Therefore, its name 'Kedāra' became famed on the surface of the earth. / In the month of Māgha, moderating one's food and bathing in the salt ocean,

16.39.s:
padmake tu mahākuṃḍe madhyesya lavaṇāṃbhasaḥ ..
rudreśāddakṣiṇe bhāge dhanuṣāṃ daśake sthite .. 7 ..
16.39.d:
पद्मके तु महाकुंडे मध्येस्य लवणांभसः ..
रुद्रेशाद्दक्षिणे भागे धनुषां दशके स्थिते .. 7 ..
16.39.m: in the great Padmaka pool in the midst of this salt water, / situated ten bow-lengths to the south of Rudreśa,

16.39.s:
snātvā vidhānato devi rudreśaṃ cārcayiṣyati ..
samyakkedārayā trāyāḥ phalaṃ tasya bhaviṣyati .. 8 ..
16.39.d:
स्नात्वा विधानतो देवि रुद्रेशं चार्चयिष्यति ..
सम्यक्केदारया त्रायाः फलं तस्य भविष्यति .. 8 ..
16.39.m: having bathed according to rule, O goddess, one will worship Rudreśa, / and he will obtain the full fruit of a pilgrimage to Kedāra.

16.39.s:
brahmahatyādipāpānāṃ pūjanānnāśanaṃ mahat ..
atha tasyaiva devasya itihāsaṃ purātanam .. 9 ..
16.39.d:
ब्रह्महत्यादिपापानां पूजनान्नाशनं महत् ..
अथ तस्यैव देवस्य इतिहासं पुरातनम् .. 9 ..
16.39.m: From worshipping [it], there is the great destruction of sins such as the killing of a brahmin. / Now, an ancient legend of that very deity,

16.39.s:
sarvakāmapradaṃ nṛṇāṃ kathyate te surapriye ..
āsīdrājā purā devi śaśabiṃduriti śrutaḥ .. 7.1.39.10 ..
16.39.d:
सर्वकामप्रदं नृणां कथ्यते ते सुरप्रिये ..
आसीद्राजा पुरा देवि शशबिंदुरिति श्रुतः .. 7.1.39.10 ..
16.39.m: which grants all desires to mortals, is told to you, O beloved of the gods. / Formerly, O goddess, there was a king renowned as Śaśabindu,

16.39.s:
sārvabhaumo mahīpālo vipakṣagaṇasūdanaḥ ..
kalidvāparayoḥ saṃdhau sabhūtaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ .. 11 ..
16.39.d:
सार्वभौमो महीपालो विपक्षगणसूदनः ..
कलिद्वापरयोः संधौ सभूतः पृथिवीपतिः .. 11 ..
16.39.m: a universal monarch, a protector of the earth, a destroyer of enemy hosts. / That lord of the earth existed at the junction of the Kali and Dvāpara ages.

16.39.s:
tasya bhāryā'bhavatsādhvī prāṇebhyo'pi garīyasī ..
na devī na ca gandharvī nāsurī na ca pannagī .. 12 ..
16.39.d:
तस्य भार्याऽभवत्साध्वी प्राणेभ्योऽपि गरीयसी ..
न देवी न च गन्धर्वी नासुरी न च पन्नगी .. 12 ..
16.39.m: He had a virtuous wife, dearer to him than his own breaths; / no goddess, nor Gandharva woman, nor Asura woman, nor serpent woman

16.39.s:
tādṛgrūpā varārohe yathā'sya śubhalocanā..
tasya hemamayaṃ padmaṃ śatapatraṃ manoramam..13..
16.39.d:
तादृग्रूपा वरारोहे यथाऽस्य शुभलोचना..
तस्य हेममयं पद्मं शतपत्रं मनोरमम्..13..
16.39.m: was of such beauty, O fair-hipped lady, as was his auspicious-eyed [wife]. / That noble king possessed a lovely, golden hundred-petaled lotus,

16.39.s:
khecaraṃ vegi nityaṃ ca tasya rājño mahātmanaḥ..
sa tena paryaṭam̐llokānsarvāndevi svakāmataḥ..14..
16.39.d:
खेचरं वेगि नित्यं च तस्य राज्ञो महात्मनः..
स तेन पर्यटम्̐ल्लोकान्सर्वान्देवि स्वकामतः..14..
16.39.m: which moved through the sky, swift and everlasting. / By means of it, O goddess, he wandered through all the worlds at will.

16.39.s:
ekadā phālgune māsi śuklapakṣe varānane ..
caturddaśyāṃ tu saṃprāptaḥ prabhāsakṣetramuttamam..15..
16.39.d:
एकदा फाल्गुने मासि शुक्लपक्षे वरानने ..
चतुर्द्दश्यां तु संप्राप्तः प्रभासक्षेत्रमुत्तमम्..15..
16.39.m: Once, in the bright fortnight of the month of Phālguna, O fair-faced lady, / on the fourteenth lunar day, he reached the supreme Prabhāsa-kṣetra.

16.39.s:
athāpaśyadṛṣīnsarvāñchrīsomeśapuraḥsthitān ..
rātrau jāgaraṇārthāya japahomaparāyaṇān.. 16 ..
16.39.d:
अथापश्यदृषीन्सर्वाञ्छ्रीसोमेशपुरःस्थितान् ..
रात्रौ जागरणार्थाय जपहोमपरायणान्.. 16 ..
16.39.m: Then he saw all the seers standing before glorious Someśa, / devoted to japa and oblation, for the sake of keeping vigil at night.

16.39.s:
sa dṛṣṭvā somanāthaṃ tu praṇipatya vidhānataḥ ..
pūjayāmāsa sarvāṃ stānyathārhaṃ bhaktisaṃyutaḥ .. 17 ..
16.39.d:
स दृष्ट्वा सोमनाथं तु प्रणिपत्य विधानतः ..
पूजयामास सर्वां स्तान्यथार्हं भक्तिसंयुतः .. 17 ..
16.39.m: Beholding Somanātha, he bowed down according to rule, / and, filled with devotion, worshipped all of them as was appropriate.

16.39.s:
tataḥ kedāramāsādya saṃsnāpya vidhivatpriye ..
pūjayitvā vicitrābhiḥ puṣpamālābhirīśvaram .. 18 ..
16.39.d:
ततः केदारमासाद्य संस्नाप्य विधिवत्प्रिये ..
पूजयित्वा विचित्राभिः पुष्पमालाभिरीश्वरम् .. 18 ..
16.39.m: Then, having approached Kedāra and properly bathed the Lord, O beloved, / having worshipped Īśvara with variegated garlands of flowers,

16.39.s:
naivedyairvividhairvastrairbhūṣaṇaiśca manoharaiḥ ..
tato'tra kārayāmāsa jāgaraṃ susamāhitaḥ .. 19 ..
16.39.d:
नैवेद्यैर्विविधैर्वस्त्रैर्भूषणैश्च मनोहरैः ..
ततोऽत्र कारयामास जागरं सुसमाहितः .. 19 ..
16.39.m: with diverse food-offerings, garments, and enchanting ornaments, / he then kept vigil there with a concentrated mind.

16.39.s:
tataste munayaḥ sarve kutūhalasamanvitāḥ ..
cyavano yājñavalkyaśca śāṃḍilyaḥ śākaṭāyanaḥ .. 7.1.39.20 ..
16.39.d:
ततस्ते मुनयः सर्वे कुतूहलसमन्विताः ..
च्यवनो याज्ञवल्क्यश्च शांडिल्यः शाकटायनः .. 7.1.39.20 ..
16.39.m: Then all those sages, filled with curiosity— / Cyavana, Yājñavalkya, Śāṇḍilya, Śākaṭāyana,

16.39.s:
raibhyo'tha jaiminiḥ krauṃco nāradaḥ parvataḥ śilaḥ ..
mārkaṃḍaṃ purataḥ kṛtvā jagmustasya samīpataḥ .. 21 ..
16.39.d:
रैभ्योऽथ जैमिनिः क्रौंचो नारदः पर्वतः शिलः ..
मार्कंडं पुरतः कृत्वा जग्मुस्तस्य समीपतः .. 21 ..
16.39.m: Raibhya, then Jaimini, Krauñca, Nārada, Parvata, and Śila— / placing Mārkaṇḍa at their head, went into his presence.

16.39.s:
cakruḥ kathāḥ suvicitrā itihāsāni bhūriśaḥ ..
kīrttayaṃtaḥ sthitāstatra papracchū rājasattamam .. 22 ..
16.39.d:
चक्रुः कथाः सुविचित्रा इतिहासानि भूरिशः ..
कीर्त्तयंतः स्थितास्तत्र पप्रच्छू राजसत्तमम् .. 22 ..
16.39.m: Relating many highly variegated stories and ancient legends, / standing there, they questioned the best of kings:

16.39.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
kasmātsomeśvaraṃ devaṃ parityajya narādhipa ..
kedārasya puro'kārṣīrjāgaraṃ tadbravīhi naḥ ..
nūnaṃ vetsi phalaṃ cāsya liṃgasya tvaṃ mahodayam .. 23 .. ..
16.39.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
कस्मात्सोमेश्वरं देवं परित्यज्य नराधिप ..
केदारस्य पुरोऽकार्षीर्जागरं तद्ब्रवीहि नः ..
नूनं वेत्सि फलं चास्य लिंगस्य त्वं महोदयम् .. 23 .. ..
16.39.m: The seers said: / "Why, O ruler of men, abandoning the god Someśvara, / did you keep vigil before Kedāra? Tell us that. / Surely you know the great and lofty fruit of this liṅga."

16.39.s:
.. rājovāca .. ..
śṛṇvaṃtu brāhmaṇāḥ sarve anyadehodbhavaṃ mama ..
purā'haṃ śūdrajātīya āsaṃ brāhmaṇapūjakaḥ .. 24 ..
16.39.d:
.. राजोवाच .. ..
शृण्वंतु ब्राह्मणाः सर्वे अन्यदेहोद्भवं मम ..
पुराऽहं शूद्रजातीय आसं ब्राह्मणपूजकः .. 24 ..
16.39.m: The king said: / "Let all the brahmins hear of what arose in my previous body. / In a former birth, I was of the Śūdra caste, a worshipper of brahmins,

16.39.s:
saurāṣṭraviṣaye śubhre dhanadhānyasamākule ..
atha kālāṃtare tatra anāvṛṣṭirabhūddvijāḥ .. 25 ..
16.39.d:
सौराष्ट्रविषये शुभ्रे धनधान्यसमाकुले ..
अथ कालांतरे तत्र अनावृष्टिरभूद्द्विजाः .. 25 ..
16.39.m: in the fair region of Saurāṣṭra, crowded with wealth and grain. / Then in the course of time, O twice-born ones, a drought occurred there.

16.39.s:
tato'haṃ kṣudhayāviṣṭaḥ prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāsthitaḥ ..
athāpaśyaṃ saraḥ śubhraṃ hariṇīmūlasaṃsthitam .. 26 ..
16.39.d:
ततोऽहं क्षुधयाविष्टः प्रभासं क्षेत्रमास्थितः ..
अथापश्यं सरः शुभ्रं हरिणीमूलसंस्थितम् .. 26 ..
16.39.m: Then, overcome by hunger, I went to Prabhāsa-kṣetra. / There I saw a bright lake situated at the foot of Hariṇī,

16.39.s:
tacca rāmasaronāma padminīṣaṇḍamaṃḍitam ..
kṣīrodāṃbudhisaṃkāśaṃ dṛṣṭvā snātaḥ klamānvitaḥ .. 27 ..
16.39.d:
तच्च रामसरोनाम पद्मिनीषण्डमंडितम् ..
क्षीरोदांबुधिसंकाशं दृष्ट्वा स्नातः क्लमान्वितः .. 27 ..
16.39.m: named Rāmasaras, adorned with clumps of lotuses, / resembling the ocean of milk. Seeing it, I, being exhausted, bathed.

16.39.s:
saṃtarpya ca pitṝndevānpītvā svacchamathodakam ..
tato'haṃ bhāryayā prokto gṛhāṇemānsaroruhān .. 28 ..
16.39.d:
संतर्प्य च पितॄन्देवान्पीत्वा स्वच्छमथोदकम् ..
ततोऽहं भार्यया प्रोक्तो गृहाणेमान्सरोरुहान् .. 28 ..
16.39.m: Having offered libations to the ancestors and gods, and drunk the clear water, / I was then addressed by my wife: 'Take these lotuses.

16.39.s:
etatsamīpato ramyaṃ dṛśyate sthānamuttamam ..
vikrīṇīmo'tra gatvā tu yena syādbhojanaṃ vibho .. 29 ..
16.39.d:
एतत्समीपतो रम्यं दृश्यते स्थानमुत्तमम् ..
विक्रीणीमोऽत्र गत्वा तु येन स्याद्भोजनं विभो .. 29 ..
16.39.m: Near this, a charming, excellent place is seen; / going there, let us sell them, so that there may be food, O master.'

16.39.s:
athāvatīrya salilaṃ gṛhītāni mayā dvijāḥ ..
kamalāni subhū rīṇi prasthitaśca puraṃ prati .. 7.1.39.30 ..
16.39.d:
अथावतीर्य सलिलं गृहीतानि मया द्विजाः ..
कमलानि सुभू रीणि प्रस्थितश्च पुरं प्रति .. 7.1.39.30 ..
16.39.m: Then, having descended into the water, O twice-born ones, I gathered / very many lotuses and set out toward the city.

16.39.s:
tatra gatvā ca rathyāsu catvareṣu trikeṣu ca ..
praphullakamalānyeva kretuṃ vai munisattamāḥ .. 31 ..
16.39.d:
तत्र गत्वा च रथ्यासु चत्वरेषु त्रिकेषु च ..
प्रफुल्लकमलान्येव क्रेतुं वै मुनिसत्तमाः .. 31 ..
16.39.m: Having gone there, along the streets, in the squares, and at the crossroads, / to sell those blooming lotuses, O best of sages,

16.39.s:
na kaścitprati gṛhṇāti astaṃ prāpto divākaraḥ ..
prāsādaṃ kaṃcidāsādya suptohaṃ saha bhāryayā ..32..
16.39.d:
न कश्चित्प्रति गृह्णाति अस्तं प्राप्तो दिवाकरः ..
प्रासादं कंचिदासाद्य सुप्तोहं सह भार्यया ..32..
16.39.m: no one bought them, and the sun went to its setting. / Having reached a temple, I slept alongside my wife.

16.39.s:
tatra suptasya me buddhiḥ śrutvā gītadhvaniṃ tadā ..
samutpannā sabhā ryasya kṣudhārtasya viśeṣataḥ ..
nūnaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ hyetatkasmiṃścidvibudhālaye .. 33 ..
16.39.d:
तत्र सुप्तस्य मे बुद्धिः श्रुत्वा गीतध्वनिं तदा ..
समुत्पन्ना सभा र्यस्य क्षुधार्तस्य विशेषतः ..
नूनं जागरणं ह्येतत्कस्मिंश्चिद्विबुधालये .. 33 ..
16.39.m: As I slept there, hearing the sound of singing at that time, / an idea arose in me, accompanied by my wife, especially afflicted by hunger: / 'Surely this is a vigil in some house of the gods.

16.39.s:
saroruhāṇi cādāya vrajāmyatra surālaye ..
yadi kaścitpragṛhṇāti prāṇayātrā tato bhavet .. 34 ..
16.39.d:
सरोरुहाणि चादाय व्रजाम्यत्र सुरालये ..
यदि कश्चित्प्रगृह्णाति प्राणयात्रा ततो भवेत् .. 34 ..
16.39.m: Taking the lotuses, I shall go to that temple. / If someone takes them, then there will be subsistence for my life.'

16.39.s:
athotthāya samāyāto hyatrāhaṃ munipuṃgavāḥ ..
apaśyaṃ liṃgametattu pūjitaṃ kusumaiḥ śubhaiḥ .. 35 ..
16.39.d:
अथोत्थाय समायातो ह्यत्राहं मुनिपुंगवाः ..
अपश्यं लिंगमेतत्तु पूजितं कुसुमैः शुभैः .. 35 ..
16.39.m: Then, rising up, I came here, O bulls among sages; / and I saw this liṅga worshipped with auspicious flowers,

16.39.s:
rudreśvarābhidhamidaṃ vṛddhaliṃgaṃ svayaṃbhuvam ..
veśyānaṃgavatīnāmnī śivarātriparāyaṇā .. 36 ..
16.39.d:
रुद्रेश्वराभिधमिदं वृद्धलिंगं स्वयंभुवम् ..
वेश्यानंगवतीनाम्नी शिवरात्रिपरायणा .. 36 ..
16.39.m: this self-manifest ancient liṅga named Rudreśvara. / A courtesan named Anaṅgavatī, devoted to Śivarātri,

16.39.s:
jāgartti puratastasya gītanṛtyotsavādinā ..
tataḥ kaścinmayā dṛṣṭaḥ kimetadrātrijāgaram ..37..
16.39.d:
जागर्त्ति पुरतस्तस्य गीतनृत्योत्सवादिना ..
ततः कश्चिन्मया दृष्टः किमेतद्रात्रिजागरम् ..37..
16.39.m: was keeping vigil before it with song, dance, celebrations, and the like. / Then someone was seen by me, [and I asked]: 'What is this night vigil?

16.39.s:
keyaṃ strī dṛśyate'tyarthaṃ gītanṛtyotsave ratā ..
so'bravīcchivadharmoktā śivarātriḥ sudharmadā ..38..
16.39.d:
केयं स्त्री दृश्यतेऽत्यर्थं गीतनृत्योत्सवे रता ..
सोऽब्रवीच्छिवधर्मोक्ता शिवरात्रिः सुधर्मदा ..38..
16.39.m: Who is this woman seen, intensely devoted to the festivities of singing and dancing?' / He said: 'This is the night of Śiva, declared by Śiva's teachings, granting great righteousness.

16.39.s:
tāṃ cānaṃgavatīnāmnī veśyeyaṃ dharmasaṃyutā ..
jāgartti paramaṃ śreyaḥ śivarātrivrataṃ śubham.. 39 ..
16.39.d:
तां चानंगवतीनाम्नी वेश्येयं धर्मसंयुता ..
जागर्त्ति परमं श्रेयः शिवरात्रिव्रतं शुभम्.. 39 ..
16.39.m: And on it, this virtuous courtesan named Anaṅgavatī / keeps vigil; the auspicious observance of Śivarātri brings supreme welfare.

16.39.s:
śivarātrivrataṃ hyetadyaḥ samyakkurute naraḥ ..
na sa duḥkhamavāpnoti na dāri dryaṃ na baṃdhanam.. 7.1.39.40 ..
16.39.d:
शिवरात्रिव्रतं ह्येतद्यः सम्यक्कुरुते नरः ..
न स दुःखमवाप्नोति न दारि द्र्यं न बंधनम्.. 7.1.39.40 ..
16.39.m: For that person who duly performs this Śivarātri observance / does not incur sorrow, poverty, or bondage;

16.39.s:
duṣṭaṃ cāriṣṭayogaṃ vā na rogaṃ na bhayaṃ kvacit ..
sukhasaubhāgyasaṃpanno jāyate satkule naraḥ .. 41 ..
16.39.d:
दुष्टं चारिष्टयोगं वा न रोगं न भयं क्वचित् ..
सुखसौभाग्यसंपन्नो जायते सत्कुले नरः .. 41 ..
16.39.m: nor an evil conjunction of misfortune, nor disease, nor fear anywhere. / Endowed with happiness and fortune, that man is born into a good family,

16.39.s:
tejasvī ca yaśasvī ca sarvakalyāṇabhājanam ..
bhavedasya prasādena evamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ .. 42 ..
16.39.d:
तेजस्वी च यशस्वी च सर्वकल्याणभाजनम् ..
भवेदस्य प्रसादेन एवमाहुर्मनीषिणः .. 42 ..
16.39.m: splendid, renowned, and a vessel of all auspiciousness / he becomes by his grace: so say the wise.'

16.39.s:
.. rājovāca .. ..
atha me buddhirutpannā tadvrataṃ prati niścalā ..
ciṃtitaṃ manasā hyetanmayābrāhmaṇasattamāḥ .. 43 ..
16.39.d:
.. राजोवाच .. ..
अथ मे बुद्धिरुत्पन्ना तद्व्रतं प्रति निश्चला ..
चिंतितं मनसा ह्येतन्मयाब्राह्मणसत्तमाः .. 43 ..
16.39.m: The king said: / "Then an unwavering intention toward that vow arose in me; / and this was reflected in my mind, O best of brahmins:

16.39.s:
annābhāvānmamotpanna upavāso balādyataḥ ..
tadahaṃ padmake tīrthesnātvā ca lavaṇāṃbhasi .. 44 ..
16.39.d:
अन्नाभावान्ममोत्पन्न उपवासो बलाद्यतः ..
तदहं पद्मके तीर्थेस्नात्वा च लवणांभसि .. 44 ..
16.39.m: 'Since through lack of food a fast has been imposed upon me by force, / therefore, having bathed in the salt water at the Padmaka tīrtha,

16.39.s:
etaiḥ saroruhairdevaṃ pūjayāmi maheśvaram..
tato mayā sabhāryeṇa rudreśaḥ saṃprapūjitaḥ .. 45 ..
16.39.d:
एतैः सरोरुहैर्देवं पूजयामि महेश्वरम्..
ततो मया सभार्येण रुद्रेशः संप्रपूजितः .. 45 ..
16.39.m: I shall worship the god Maheśvara with these lotuses.' / Then, accompanied by my wife, Rudreśa was worshipped by me

16.39.s:
padmaiśca bhaktiyuktena sabhāryeṇa viśeṣataḥ ..
jāgratsthitastu devāgre tāṃ rātriṃ saha bhāryayā .. 46 ..
16.39.d:
पद्मैश्च भक्तियुक्तेन सभार्येण विशेषतः ..
जाग्रत्स्थितस्तु देवाग्रे तां रात्रिं सह भार्यया .. 46 ..
16.39.m: with lotuses, filled with devotion, especially together with my wife; / and keeping awake, I remained before the deity for that night alongside my wife.

16.39.s:
tataḥ prabhātasamaya udite sūryamaṇḍale ..
sā veśyā māmuvācedaṃ kaladhautapalatrayam .. 47 ..
16.39.d:
ततः प्रभातसमय उदिते सूर्यमण्डले ..
सा वेश्या मामुवाचेदं कलधौतपलत्रयम् .. 47 ..
16.39.m: Then, at dawn, when the orb of the sun had risen, / that courtesan said this to me: '[Take] three palas of silver...'

16.39.s:
gṛhāṇamūlyaṃ padmānāṃ na gṛhītaṃ mayā hi tat ..
sāttvikaṃ bhāvamāsthāya sabhāryeṇa dvijottamāḥ .. 48 ..
16.39.d:
गृहाणमूल्यं पद्मानां न गृहीतं मया हि तत् ..
सात्त्विकं भावमास्थाय सभार्येण द्विजोत्तमाः .. 48 ..
16.39.m: "Take the price of the lotuses!" But it was not accepted by me, / adopting a pure disposition, together with my wife, O best of brahmins. 48

16.39.s:
tato bhikṣāṃ samāhṛtya prāṇayātrā mayā kṛtā ..
kālena mahatā prāptaḥ kāladharmaṃ munīśvarāḥ .. 49 ..
16.39.d:
ततो भिक्षां समाहृत्य प्राणयात्रा मया कृता ..
कालेन महता प्राप्तः कालधर्मं मुनीश्वराः .. 49 ..
16.39.m: Then, having gathered alms, my sustenance was maintained by me. / After a great length of time, O lords of sages, I met the law of time [death]. 49

16.39.s:
iyaṃ me dayitā sādhvī prāṇebhyo'pi garīyasī ..
mama dehaṃ samādāya praviṣṭā havyavāhanam.. .. 7.1.39.50 ..
16.39.d:
इयं मे दयिता साध्वी प्राणेभ्योऽपि गरीयसी ..
मम देहं समादाय प्रविष्टा हव्यवाहनम्.. .. 7.1.39.50 ..
16.39.m: This virtuous wife of mine, dearer to me even than life, / took my body and entered the sacrificial fire. 50

16.39.s:
tatprabhāvādahaṃ jātaḥ sarvabhaumo mahīpatiḥ ..
jātismaraḥ sabhāryastu satyametaddvijottamāḥ .. 51 ..
16.39.d:
तत्प्रभावादहं जातः सर्वभौमो महीपतिः ..
जातिस्मरः सभार्यस्तु सत्यमेतद्द्विजोत्तमाः .. 51 ..
16.39.m: By the power of that, I was born as a sovereign king of the earth, / remembering my previous births, together with my wife; this is the truth, O best of brahmins. 51

16.39.s:
etasmātkāraṇādasya bhaktirliṃgasya copari ..
mama nityaṃ sabhāryasya satyametadbravīmi vaḥ .. 52 ..
16.39.d:
एतस्मात्कारणादस्य भक्तिर्लिंगस्य चोपरि ..
मम नित्यं सभार्यस्य सत्यमेतद्ब्रवीमि वः .. 52 ..
16.39.m: For this reason, devotion towards this liṅga / is ever maintained by me and my wife; I tell you this truth. 52

16.39.s:
mayā kriyāvihīnena bhaktibāhyena sattamāḥ ..
vratametatsamācīrṇaṃ tasyedaṃ sumahatpha lam.. 53 ..
16.39.d:
मया क्रियाविहीनेन भक्तिबाह्येन सत्तमाः ..
व्रतमेतत्समाचीर्णं तस्येदं सुमहत्फ लम्.. 53 ..
16.39.m: By me, though devoid of ritual action and destitute of devotion, O best of men, / this observance was performed; this is its exceedingly great fruit. 53

16.39.s:
adhunā bhaktiyuktasya yathopakaraṇānmama ..
bhaviṣye yatphalaṃ kiṃcinno vedmi ca munīśvarāḥ ..
yena someśamutsṛjya atrāhaṃ bhakti tatparaḥ .. 54 ..
16.39.d:
अधुना भक्तियुक्तस्य यथोपकरणान्मम ..
भविष्ये यत्फलं किंचिन्नो वेद्मि च मुनीश्वराः ..
येन सोमेशमुत्सृज्य अत्राहं भक्ति तत्परः .. 54 ..
16.39.m: Now, of me endowed with devotion according to my means, / I do not know what the fruit will be in the future, O lords of sages, / by which, leaving Someśa aside, I am devoted here with full intent. 54

16.39.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
evaṃ śrutvā tu te viprā vismayotphullalocanāḥ ..
sādhusādhviti jalpaṃto rājānaṃ saṃpraśaṃsire .. 55 ..
16.39.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
एवं श्रुत्वा तु ते विप्रा विस्मयोत्फुल्ललोचनाः ..
साधुसाध्विति जल्पंतो राजानं संप्रशंसिरे .. 55 ..
16.39.m: Īśvara said: / Having heard this, those brahmins, their eyes wide with wonder, / proclaiming, "Excellent, excellent!", praised the king. 55

16.39.s:
pūjayāmāsuraniśaṃ liṃgaṃ tatra svayaṃbhuvam ..
tato'sau pārthivaśreṣṭho liṃgasyāsyaprasādataḥ ..
saṃsiddhiṃ paramāṃ prāpto durllabhāṃ tridaśairapi .. 56 ..
16.39.d:
पूजयामासुरनिशं लिंगं तत्र स्वयंभुवम् ..
ततोऽसौ पार्थिवश्रेष्ठो लिंगस्यास्यप्रसादतः ..
संसिद्धिं परमां प्राप्तो दुर्ल्लभां त्रिदशैरपि .. 56 ..
16.39.m: They worshipped the self-manifest liṅga there day and night. / Then that best of kings, through the grace of this liṅga, / attained supreme perfection, difficult even for the gods to attain. 56

16.39.s:
sā ca veśyā bhagavatī śivarātriprabhāvataḥ ..
tasya liṃgasya māhātmyādraṃbhānāmāpsarā'bhavat .. 57 ..
16.39.d:
सा च वेश्या भगवती शिवरात्रिप्रभावतः ..
तस्य लिंगस्य माहात्म्याद्रंभानामाप्सराऽभवत् .. 57 ..
16.39.m: And that noble courtesan, by the power of Śivarātri / [and] by the māhātmya of that liṅga, became the apsaras named Rambhā. 57

16.39.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena talliṃgaṃ pūjayedbudhaḥ ..
dharmakāmārthamokṣaṃ ca yo vāṃchatyakhilapradam .. 58 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsa kṣetramāhātmye kedāreśvara (rudreśvara)liṅgamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ..39..
16.39.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन तल्लिंगं पूजयेद्बुधः ..
धर्मकामार्थमोक्षं च यो वांछत्यखिलप्रदम् .. 58 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां सहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभास क्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये केदारेश्वर (रुद्रेश्वर)लिङ्गमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामैकोनचत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः..39..
16.39.m:
Therefore, a wise man should worship that liṅga with all effort / if he desires duty, pleasure, wealth, and liberation—that bestower of everything. 58
Thus ends the thirty-ninth chapter, entitled "Description of the Māhātmya of the Kedāreśvara (Rudreśvara) Liṅga," in the first Prabhāsa-kṣetra-māhātmya of the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skandapurāṇa comprising eighty-one thousand verses. 39

16.40.s:
īśvara uvāca..
tato gacchenmahādevi śvetaketupratiṣṭhitam..
liṃgaṃ mahāprabhāvaṃ tu bhīmenārādhitaṃ purā..1..
16.40.d:
ईश्वर उवाच..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि श्वेतकेतुप्रतिष्ठितम्..
लिंगं महाप्रभावं तु भीमेनाराधितं पुरा..1..
16.40.m: Īśvara said: / Next, O great goddess, one should go to the [liṅga] installed by Śvetaketu, / a liṅga of great power which was formerly worshipped by Bhīma. 1

16.40.s:
kedāreśvarasāṃnidhye nātidūre vyavasthitam..
pūjayate ttadvidhānena kṣīrasnānādibhiḥ kramāt ..
yātrāphalamabhiprepsuḥ pretya svargaphalāya vai .. 2 ..
16.40.d:
केदारेश्वरसांनिध्ये नातिदूरे व्यवस्थितम्..
पूजयते त्तद्विधानेन क्षीरस्नानादिभिः क्रमात् ..
यात्राफलमभिप्रेप्सुः प्रेत्य स्वर्गफलाय वै .. 2 ..
16.40.m: It is situated in the presence of Kedāreśvara, not very far away. / One should worship it according to the rule, beginning with a bath of milk and so forth, in due order, / desiring the fruit of the pilgrimage for the sake of the fruit of heaven after death. 2

16.40.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
śvetaketostu yaddeva liṃgaṃ proktaṃ tvayā mama ..
tasya jātaṃ kathaṃ deva nāma bhīmeśvareti ca .. 3 ..
16.40.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
श्वेतकेतोस्तु यद्देव लिंगं प्रोक्तं त्वया मम ..
तस्य जातं कथं देव नाम भीमेश्वरेति च .. 3 ..
