16.40.m: The Goddess said: / O Lord, as for the liṅga of Śvetaketu which was mentioned by you to me, / how, O Lord, did its name become "Bhīmeśvara"? 3

16.40.s: kathaṃ vinirmitaṃ pūrvaṃ tasmindṛṣṭe tu kiṃ phalam .. 4 ..
16.40.d: कथं विनिर्मितं पूर्वं तस्मिन्दृष्टे तु किं फलम् .. 4 ..
16.40.m: How was it fashioned in the past, and what is the fruit when it is seen? 4

16.40.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
āsīttretāyuge pūrvaṃ rājā svāyaṃbhuveṃtare ..
śvetaketuriti khyāto rājarṣiḥ sumahātapāḥ .. 5 ..
16.40.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
आसीत्त्रेतायुगे पूर्वं राजा स्वायंभुवेंतरे ..
श्वेतकेतुरिति ख्यातो राजर्षिः सुमहातपाः .. 5 ..
16.40.m: Īśvara said: / Formerly, in the Tretāyuga during the Svāyambhuva manvantara, / there was a royal sage of very great austerity, famous as Śvetaketu. 5

16.40.s:
sa prabhāsaṃ samāgatya pratiṣṭhāpya mahe śvaram ..
tapastepe suvipulaṃ sāgarasya taṭe śubhe .. 6 ..
16.40.d:
स प्रभासं समागत्य प्रतिष्ठाप्य महे श्वरम् ..
तपस्तेपे सुविपुलं सागरस्य तटे शुभे .. 6 ..
16.40.m: Having arrived at Prabhāsa and installed Maheśvara, / he performed extensive austerity on the auspicious shore of the ocean. 6

16.40.s:
paṃcāgnisādhako grīṣme varṣāsvākāśagastathā ..
hemaṃte jalamadhyastho nava varṣāṇi paṃca ca .. 7 ..
16.40.d:
पंचाग्निसाधको ग्रीष्मे वर्षास्वाकाशगस्तथा ..
हेमंते जलमध्यस्थो नव वर्षाणि पंच च .. 7 ..
16.40.m: Practicing the five fires in summer, standing exposed to the sky during the rains, / and staying in the middle of water in winter, for nine and five [fourteen] years. 7

16.40.s:
tataścaturddaśe devi tapasā niyamena ca ..
tuṣṭenokto mayā devi varaṃ varaya suvrata .. 8 ..
16.40.d:
ततश्चतुर्द्दशे देवि तपसा नियमेन च ..
तुष्टेनोक्तो मया देवि वरं वरय सुव्रत .. 8 ..
16.40.m: Then in the fourteenth [year], O goddess, being pleased by his austerity and observance, / he was addressed by me: "O one of good vows, choose a boon!" 8

16.40.s:
śvetaketurathovāca bhaktiṃ dehi suniścalām ..
sthāne'sminsthīyatāṃ deva yadi tuṣṭo'si me prabho .. 9 ..
16.40.d:
श्वेतकेतुरथोवाच भक्तिं देहि सुनिश्चलाम् ..
स्थानेऽस्मिन्स्थीयतां देव यदि तुष्टोऽसि मे प्रभो .. 9 ..
16.40.m: Śvetaketu then said: "Grant me unswerving devotion; / O Lord, may you abide in this place if you are pleased with me, O Master!" 9
"So be it," I said, and then vanished from his sight. / Then, after a period of time had elapsed, the highly lustrous Śvetaketu, 10

16.40.s:
samārādhya tvidaṃ liṃgaṃ prāptaḥ sthānaṃ mahodayam ..
tato jātaṃ nāma tasya śvetaketvīśvaraṃ śrutam .. 11 ..
16.40.d:
समाराध्य त्विदं लिंगं प्राप्तः स्थानं महोदयम् ..
ततो जातं नाम तस्य श्वेतकेत्वीश्वरं श्रुतम् .. 11 ..
16.40.m: having fully worshipped this liṅga, attained an exalted state. / Thence its famous name became Śvetaketvīśvara, 11

16.40.s:
agnitīrthe mahāpuṇye sarvapātakanāśane ..
tataḥ kaliyuge prāpte bhrātṛbhiśca samanvitaḥ .. 12 ..
16.40.d:
अग्नितीर्थे महापुण्ये सर्वपातकनाशने ..
ततः कलियुगे प्राप्ते भ्रातृभिश्च समन्वितः .. 12 ..
16.40.m: at the exceedingly meritorious Agnitīrtha, which destroys all sins. / Afterwards, when the Kaliyuga arrived, accompanied by his brothers, 12

16.40.s:
tīrthayātrāprasaṃgena yadā prabhāsamāgataḥ ..
bhīmaseno mahābāhurvāyuputro mamāṃśajaḥ .. 13 ..
16.40.d:
तीर्थयात्राप्रसंगेन यदा प्रभासमागतः ..
भीमसेनो महाबाहुर्वायुपुत्रो ममांशजः .. 13 ..
16.40.m: when he came to Prabhāsa on the occasion of a pilgrimage to sacred fords, / the mighty-armed Bhīmasena, son of the Wind-god and born of my portion, 13

16.40.s:
talliṃgaṃ pūjayāmāsa kṛtvā jāgeśvaraṃ nijam ..
matvā tīrthaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sāgarasya samīpataḥ .. 14 ..
16.40.d:
तल्लिंगं पूजयामास कृत्वा जागेश्वरं निजम् ..
मत्वा तीर्थं महापुण्यं सागरस्य समीपतः .. 14 ..
16.40.m: worshipped that liṅga, making it his own Jāgeśvara, / recognizing the sacred ford near the ocean as exceedingly meritorious. 14

16.40.s:
tadā prabhṛti bhīmeśaṃ punarnāmā'bhavacchubham ..
dṛṣṭamātreṇa tenaiva sakṛlliṃgena bhāmini .. 15 ..
16.40.d:
तदा प्रभृति भीमेशं पुनर्नामाऽभवच्छुभम् ..
दृष्टमात्रेण तेनैव सकृल्लिंगेन भामिनि .. 15 ..
16.40.m: From that time forward, its auspicious name became "Bhīmeśa" once again. / By merely seeing that liṅga even once, O fair lady, 15

16.40.s:
anyajanmakṛtānyeva pāpāni subahūnyapi ..
nāśamāyāṃti sarvāṇi tathaivāmuṣmikāṇi tu .. 16 ..
16.40.d:
अन्यजन्मकृतान्येव पापानि सुबहून्यपि ..
नाशमायांति सर्वाणि तथैवामुष्मिकाणि तु .. 16 ..
16.40.m: the numerous sins committed even in other births / all go to destruction, as do those pertaining to the next world. 16

16.40.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye bhīmeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 40 ..
16.40.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये भीमेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम चत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः .. 40 ..
16.40.m: Thus ends the fortieth chapter, entitled "Description of the Māhātmya of Bhīmeśvara," in the first Prabhāsa-kṣetra-māhātmya of the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skandapurāṇa comprising eighty-one thousand verses. 40

16.41.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tasyaiva pūrvadigbhāge sarasvatyā pratiṣṭhitam ..
liṃgaṃ mahāprabhāvaṃ tu someśādagnigocare .. 1 ..
16.41.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तस्यैव पूर्वदिग्भागे सरस्वत्या प्रतिष्ठितम् ..
लिंगं महाप्रभावं तु सोमेशादग्निगोचरे .. 1 ..
16.41.m: Īśvara said: / In the eastern direction from that very [shrine], installed by Sarasvatī, / is a liṅga of great power, in the south-east of Someśa, 1

16.41.s:
bhairaveśvararūpastu vāḍavaḥ kumbhasaṃsthitaḥ ..
yatra devyā samānītaḥ sāgarasya samīpataḥ .. 2 ..
16.41.d:
भैरवेश्वररूपस्तु वाडवः कुम्भसंस्थितः ..
यत्र देव्या समानीतः सागरस्य समीपतः .. 2 ..
16.41.m: where the submarine fire in the form of Bhairaveśvara, situated in a pot, / was brought by the goddess near the ocean. 2

16.41.s:
viśrāmārthaṃ kṣaṇaṃ muktvā devyā liṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ..
samabhyarcya vidhānena gṛhītvā vaḍavānalam..
samudramadhye cikṣepa devānāṃ hitakāmyayā .. 3 ..
16.41.d:
विश्रामार्थं क्षणं मुक्त्वा देव्या लिंगं प्रतिष्ठितम् ..
समभ्यर्च्य विधानेन गृहीत्वा वडवानलम्..
समुद्रमध्ये चिक्षेप देवानां हितकाम्यया .. 3 ..
16.41.m: Depositing [it] for a moment for the sake of rest, the liṅga was installed by the goddess; / having worshipped it properly, she took the submarine fire / and cast it into the middle of the ocean, desiring the welfare of the gods. 3

16.41.s:
tato hṛṣṭatarā devāḥ śaṃkhadundubhiniḥsvanaiḥ ..
pūrayantoṃ'baraṃ devīmīḍire puṣpavṛṣṭibhiḥ .. 4 ..
16.41.d:
ततो हृष्टतरा देवाः शंखदुन्दुभिनिःस्वनैः ..
पूरयन्तोंऽबरं देवीमीडिरे पुष्पवृष्टिभिः .. 4 ..
16.41.m: Then the exceedingly delighted gods, filling the sky / with the sounds of conches and kettle-drums, praised the goddess with showers of flowers. 4

16.41.s:
devamāteti te nāma kṛtvocustāṃ tadā surāḥ ..
kṛtvā tu bhairavaṃ kāryamasādhyaṃ devadānavaiḥ .. 5 ..
16.41.d:
देवमातेति ते नाम कृत्वोचुस्तां तदा सुराः ..
कृत्वा तु भैरवं कार्यमसाध्यं देवदानवैः .. 5 ..
16.41.m: Conferring the name "Mother of the Gods" upon her, the gods then said to her: / "Having accomplished a terrifying task that could not be achieved by gods or demons, 5

16.41.s:
pratiṣṭhitavatī cātra yasmālliṃgaṃ mahodayam ..
tvaṃ sarvasaritāṃ śreṣṭhā sarvapātakanāśinī ..
tasmādbhairavanāmeti liṃgaṃ khyātiṃ gamiṣyati .. 6 ..
16.41.d:
प्रतिष्ठितवती चात्र यस्माल्लिंगं महोदयम् ..
त्वं सर्वसरितां श्रेष्ठा सर्वपातकनाशिनी ..
तस्माद्भैरवनामेति लिंगं ख्यातिं गमिष्यति .. 6 ..
16.41.m: and because you have installed an exalted liṅga here, / [and since] you are the best of all rivers and the destroyer of all sins, / therefore this liṅga will attain renown by the name 'Bhairava'." 6

16.41.s:
ityuktā tu tadā devī bhairaveśvaranairṛte ..
sāgarasya sthitā ramye tatra mūrttimatī satī .. 7 ..
16.41.d:
इत्युक्ता तु तदा देवी भैरवेश्वरनैरृते ..
सागरस्य स्थिता रम्ये तत्र मूर्त्तिमती सती .. 7 ..
16.41.m: Being addressed thus, the goddess then, to the south-west of Bhairaveśvara, / remained on the lovely [shore] of the ocean, embodied there as a chaste lady. 7

16.41.s:
pūjayettāṃ vidhānena taṃ tathā bhairaveśvaram ..
mahānavamyāṃ yatnena kṛtvā snānaṃ vidhānataḥ ..
sarasvatīṃ pūjayitvā vāgdoṣānmucyate'khilāt .. 8 ..
16.41.d:
पूजयेत्तां विधानेन तं तथा भैरवेश्वरम् ..
महानवम्यां यत्नेन कृत्वा स्नानं विधानतः ..
सरस्वतीं पूजयित्वा वाग्दोषान्मुच्यतेऽखिलात् .. 8 ..
16.41.m: One should worship her according to the rule, and likewise that Bhairaveśvara. / Having performed a ritual ablution according to the rule on the great ninth day with diligence, / and having worshipped Sarasvatī, one is released from every defect of speech. 8

16.41.s:
tasyā liṃgaṃ tu saṃpūjya saṃsnāpya payasā pṛthak ..
aghoreṇaiva vidhivatsamyagyātrāphalaṃ labhet .. 9 ..
16.41.d:
तस्या लिंगं तु संपूज्य संस्नाप्य पयसा पृथक् ..
अघोरेणैव विधिवत्सम्यग्यात्राफलं लभेत् .. 9 ..
16.41.m: Having worshipped her liṅga and bathed it separately with milk / according to the rite with the Aghora mantra, one properly obtains the fruit of the pilgrimage. 9

16.41.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye bhairaveśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 41 .. .. ..
16.41.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये भैरवेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकचत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः .. 41 .. .. ..
16.41.m: Thus ends the forty-first chapter, entitled "Description of the Māhātmya of Bhairaveśvara," in the first Prabhāsa-kṣetra-māhātmya of the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skandapurāṇa comprising eighty-one thousand verses. 41

16.42.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi caṇḍīśaṃ devamuttamam ..
someśādīśadigbhāge dhanuṣāṃ saptake sthitam .. 1 ..
16.42.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि चण्डीशं देवमुत्तमम् ..
सोमेशादीशदिग्भागे धनुषां सप्तके स्थितम् .. 1 ..
16.42.m:
Īśvara said:
Then one should go, O great goddess, to Caṇḍīśa, the supreme god,
situated seven bow-lengths in the north-eastern direction from Someśa, / 1

16.42.s:
daṇḍapāṇestu bhavanāddakṣiṇe nātidūragam ..
caṃḍyā pratiṣṭhitaṃ pūrvaṃ caṇḍenārādhitaṃ tataḥ .. 2 ..
16.42.d:
दण्डपाणेस्तु भवनाद्दक्षिणे नातिदूरगम् ..
चंड्या प्रतिष्ठितं पूर्वं चण्डेनाराधितं ततः .. 2 ..
16.42.m:
not very far to the south of the residence of Daṇḍapāṇi.
It was consecrated formerly by Caṇḍī, and subsequently worshipped by Caṇḍa, / 2

16.42.s:
gaṇena mama deveśi tatkṛtvā duṣkaraṃ tapaḥ ..
tena caṇḍeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ prakhyātaṃ dharaṇītale .. 3 ..
16.42.d:
गणेन मम देवेशि तत्कृत्वा दुष्करं तपः ..
तेन चण्डेश्वरं लिंगं प्रख्यातं धरणीतले .. 3 ..
16.42.m:
my gaṇa, O ruler of gods, after performing severe austerity.
Therefore that Caṇḍeśvara liṅga is renowned across the surface of the earth. / 3

16.42.s:
snāpayetpayasā pūrvaṃ dadhnā ghṛtayutena ca ..
madhunekṣurasenaiva kuṃkumena vilepayet .. 4 ..
16.42.d:
स्नापयेत्पयसा पूर्वं दध्ना घृतयुतेन च ..
मधुनेक्षुरसेनैव कुंकुमेन विलेपयेत् .. 4 ..
16.42.m:
One should first bathe it with milk, and then with curds joined with ghee,
with honey, sugarcane juice, and smear it with saffron, / 4

16.42.s:
karpūrośīramiśreṇa mṛganābhirasena ca ..
candanena sugandhena puṣpaiḥ saṃpūjayettataḥ .. 5 ..
16.42.d:
कर्पूरोशीरमिश्रेण मृगनाभिरसेन च ..
चन्दनेन सुगन्धेन पुष्पैः संपूजयेत्ततः .. 5 ..
16.42.m:
with musk-juice mixed with camphor and uśīra,
and with fragrant sandalpaste; then one should worship it with flowers. / 5

16.42.s:
dagdhvā dhūpaṃ puro devi tato devasya cāgurum ..
vastraiḥ saṃpūjayetpaścādātmavittānusārataḥ .. 6 ..
16.42.d:
दग्ध्वा धूपं पुरो देवि ततो देवस्य चागुरुम् ..
वस्त्रैः संपूजयेत्पश्चादात्मवित्तानुसारतः .. 6 ..
16.42.m:
Having burnt incense and agallochum before the god, O goddess,
one should afterwards worship with garments according to one’s wealth. / 6

16.42.s:
naivedyaṃ paramānnaṃ ca dattvā dīpasama nvitam ..
tato dadyāddvijātibhyo yathāśaktyā tu dakṣiṇām.. 7 ..
16.42.d:
नैवेद्यं परमान्नं च दत्त्वा दीपसम न्वितम् ..
ततो दद्याद्द्विजातिभ्यो यथाशक्त्या तु दक्षिणाम्.. 7 ..
16.42.m:
Having offered food offerings, supreme rice, together with lamps,
one should then give a sacrificial fee to twice-borns according to one's means. / 7

16.42.s:
dakṣiṇāṃ diśamāsthāya yatkiṃcittatra dīyate..
caṇḍīśasya varārohe tatsarvaṃ cākṣayaṃ bhavet .. 8 ..
16.42.d:
दक्षिणां दिशमास्थाय यत्किंचित्तत्र दीयते..
चण्डीशस्य वरारोहे तत्सर्वं चाक्षयं भवेत् .. 8 ..
16.42.m:
Whatever is given there towards the southern direction
of Caṇḍīśa, O lady of fair hips, all that becomes inexhaustible. / 8

16.42.s:
yaḥ śrāddhaṃ kurute tatra caṇḍīśasya tu dakṣiṇe ..
ākalpaṃ tṛptimāyāṃti pitarastasya bhāmini .. 9 ..
16.42.d:
यः श्राद्धं कुरुते तत्र चण्डीशस्य तु दक्षिणे ..
आकल्पं तृप्तिमायांति पितरस्तस्य भामिनि .. 9 ..
16.42.m:
The man who performs a śrāddha there to the south of Caṇḍīśa,
his ancestors attain satisfaction until the end of the kalpa, O beautiful lady. / 9

16.42.s:
ayane cottare prāpte yaḥ kuryādghṛta kambalam ..
na sa bhūyo'tra saṃsāre janma prāpnoti dāruṇam.. 7.1.42.10 ..
16.42.d:
अयने चोत्तरे प्राप्ते यः कुर्याद्घृत कम्बलम् ..
न स भूयोऽत्र संसारे जन्म प्राप्नोति दारुणम्.. 7.1.42.10 ..
16.42.m:
And when the northern solstice has arrived, whoever offers a blanket of ghee,
he does not obtain terrible rebirth again in this saṃsāra. / 10

16.42.s:
evaṃ kṛtvā naro bhaktyā yātrāṃ devasya śūlinaḥ ..
nirmālyātikramodbhūtairajñānādbhakṣaṇodbhavaiḥ ..
pāpaiḥ pramucyate jaṃtustathā'nyaiḥ karmasaṃbhavaiḥ .. 11 ..
16.42.d:
एवं कृत्वा नरो भक्त्या यात्रां देवस्य शूलिनः ..
निर्माल्यातिक्रमोद्भूतैरज्ञानाद्भक्षणोद्भवैः ..
पापैः प्रमुच्यते जंतुस्तथाऽन्यैः कर्मसंभवैः .. 11 ..
16.42.m:
Performing thus with devotion the pilgrimage to the trident-bearing god,
a creature is released from the sins arising from stepping on discarded offerings,
from eating [them] through ignorance, and likewise from others born of actions. / 11

16.42.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathameprabhāsakṣetramāhātmye caṇḍīśamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmadvicatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 42 ..
16.42.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमेप्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये चण्डीशमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामद्विचत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः .. 42 ..
16.42.m: Thus ends the forty-second chapter, named the Description of the Greatness of Caṇḍīśa, in the first [part], the Greatness of Prabhāsa-kṣetra, in the seventh Prabhāsa section, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses. / 42

16.43.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchedvarārohe liṃgaṃ sūryapratiṣṭhitam ..
someśātpaścime bhāge dhanuṣāṃ saptake sthitam..
ādityeśvaranāmānaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam .. 1 ..
16.43.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेद्वरारोहे लिंगं सूर्यप्रतिष्ठितम् ..
सोमेशात्पश्चिमे भागे धनुषां सप्तके स्थितम्..
आदित्येश्वरनामानं सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 1 ..
16.43.m:
Īśvara said:
Then one should go, O lady of fair hips, to the liṅga consecrated by Sūrya,
situated seven bow-lengths to the west of Someśa,
named Ādityeśvara, which destroys all sins. / 1

16.43.s:
tretāyuge mahādevi samudreṇa mahātmanā ..
ratnaiḥ saṃpūjitaṃ liṃgaṃ varṣāṇāmayutaṃ priye .. 2 ..
16.43.d:
त्रेतायुगे महादेवि समुद्रेण महात्मना ..
रत्नैः संपूजितं लिंगं वर्षाणामयुतं प्रिये .. 2 ..
16.43.m:
In the Tretā age, O great goddess, by the high-souled Ocean,
that liṅga was worshipped with jewels for ten thousand years, O beloved. / 2

16.43.s:
tena ratneśvaraṃnāma sāṃprataṃ prathitaṃ kṣitau ..
paṃcāmṛtena saṃsnāpya paṃcaratnaiḥ prapūjayet ..3..
16.43.d:
तेन रत्नेश्वरंनाम सांप्रतं प्रथितं क्षितौ ..
पंचामृतेन संस्नाप्य पंचरत्नैः प्रपूजयेत् ..3..
16.43.m:
Therefore it is currently renowned on earth by the name Ratneśvara.
Having bathed it with the five nectars, one should worship it with the five jewels. / 3

16.43.s:
tato rājopacāreṇa pūjayedvidhivannaraḥ ..
evaṃ kṛte mahādevi merudānaphalaṃ labhet ..4..
16.43.d:
ततो राजोपचारेण पूजयेद्विधिवन्नरः ..
एवं कृते महादेवि मेरुदानफलं लभेत् ..4..
16.43.m:
Then a person should worship it duly with royal services.
When this is done, O great goddess, he obtains the fruit of giving Mount Meru, / 4

16.43.s: sarveṣāṃ caiva yajñānāṃ dānānāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ..5..
16.43.d: सर्वेषां चैव यज्ञानां दानानां नात्र संशयः ..5..
16.43.m: and of all sacrifices and gifts; of this there is no doubt; / 5

16.43.s:
tīrthānāṃ cāpi sarveṣāṃ yaccānyatsukṛtaṃ bhuvi ..
uddharetpitṛvargaṃ ca mātṛvargaṃ ca mānavaḥ .. 6 ..
16.43.d:
तीर्थानां चापि सर्वेषां यच्चान्यत्सुकृतं भुवि ..
उद्धरेत्पितृवर्गं च मातृवर्गं च मानवः .. 6 ..
16.43.m:
and of all sacred fords, as well as whatever other good deed [exists] on earth.
A mortal shall deliver the multitude of his paternal ancestors and maternal ancestors. / 6

16.43.s:
bālye vayasi yatpāpaṃ vārddhake yauvane'pi vā ..
kṣālayeccaiva tatsarvaṃ dṛṣṭvā ratneśvaraṃ naraḥ .. 7 ..
16.43.d:
बाल्ये वयसि यत्पापं वार्द्धके यौवनेऽपि वा ..
क्षालयेच्चैव तत्सर्वं दृष्ट्वा रत्नेश्वरं नरः .. 7 ..
16.43.m:
Whatever sin was committed in childhood, old age, or youth,
a person washes away all of that by beholding Ratneśvara. / 7

16.43.s:
dhenudānaṃ praśaṃsaṃti tasminsthāne maharṣayaḥ ..
dhenudastārayennūnaṃ daśa pūrvāndaśāparān .. 8 ..
16.43.d:
धेनुदानं प्रशंसंति तस्मिन्स्थाने महर्षयः ..
धेनुदस्तारयेन्नूनं दश पूर्वान्दशापरान् .. 8 ..
16.43.m:
Great seers praise the gift of a cow in that place.
A giver of a cow will surely liberate ten preceding and ten succeeding generations. / 8

16.43.s:
devasya dakṣiṇe bhāge yo japecchatarudriyam ..
saṃpūjya vidhivalliṃgaṃ na sa bhūyaḥ prajāyate ..9..
16.43.d:
देवस्य दक्षिणे भागे यो जपेच्छतरुद्रियम् ..
संपूज्य विधिवल्लिंगं न स भूयः प्रजायते ..9..
16.43.m:
Whoever mutters the Śatarudrīya on the southern side of the god,
having worshipped the liṅga duly, is not born again. / 9

16.43.s:
evaṃ saṃkṣepataḥ proktamādityeśamahodayam ..
śrutvā'vadhārya yatnena mucyate karmabaṃdhanaiḥ .. 7.1.43.10 ..
16.43.d:
एवं संक्षेपतः प्रोक्तमादित्येशमहोदयम् ..
श्रुत्वाऽवधार्य यत्नेन मुच्यते कर्मबंधनैः .. 7.1.43.10 ..
16.43.m:
Thus has the great majesty of Ādityeśa been declared in brief.
Having heard and grasped it with effort, one is freed from the bonds of action. / 10

16.43.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya ādityeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma tricatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 43 ..
16.43.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्य आदित्येश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम त्रिचत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः .. 43 ..
16.43.m: Thus ends the forty-third chapter, named the Description of the Greatness of Ādityeśvara, in the first [part], the Greatness of Prabhāsa-kṣetra, in the seventh Prabhāsa section, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses. / 43

16.44.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
ādityeśaṃ samabhyarcya punaḥ someśvaraṃ vrajet ..
taṃ saṃpūjya vidhānena paṃcāṃgena viśeṣataḥ .. 1 ..
16.44.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
आदित्येशं समभ्यर्च्य पुनः सोमेश्वरं व्रजेत् ..
तं संपूज्य विधानेन पंचांगेन विशेषतः .. 1 ..
16.44.m:
Īśvara said:
Having worshipped Ādityeśa, one should go again to Someśvara.
Having worshipped him according to the rules, especially with five parts of the body, / 1

16.44.s:
dṛṣṭvā someśvaraṃ caiva sāṣṭāṃgaṃ praṇipatya ca ..
pradakṣiṇādikaṃ kuryātsaṃpaśyecca punaḥpunaḥ .. 2 ..
16.44.d:
दृष्ट्वा सोमेश्वरं चैव साष्टांगं प्रणिपत्य च ..
प्रदक्षिणादिकं कुर्यात्संपश्येच्च पुनःपुनः .. 2 ..
16.44.m:
and beholding Someśvara, having prostrated with eight limbs,
one should perform circumambulation and the like, and gaze upon [him] again and again. / 2

16.44.s:
sūryācandramasorliṃgaṃ triḥkṛtvā prayataḥ śuciḥ ..
agnīṣomātmakaṃ karma tena sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavet .. 3 ..
16.44.d:
सूर्याचन्द्रमसोर्लिंगं त्रिःकृत्वा प्रयतः शुचिः ..
अग्नीषोमात्मकं कर्म तेन सर्वं कृतं भवेत् .. 3 ..
16.44.m:
Restrained and pure, having done so thrice before the liṅga of Sūrya and the Moon,
all rites characterized by Agni and Soma have thereby been performed by him. / 3

16.44.s:
umādevīṃ tato gacchetsomeśvarasamīpataḥ ..
dvitīyāṃ tu tato gaccheddaityasūdanasannidhau .. 4 ..
16.44.d:
उमादेवीं ततो गच्छेत्सोमेश्वरसमीपतः ..
द्वितीयां तु ततो गच्छेद्दैत्यसूदनसन्निधौ .. 4 ..
16.44.m:
Then one should go to goddess Umā near Someśvara;
then one should go to the second near Daityasūdana. / 4

16.44.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame pramāsakṣetramāhātmye someśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catuścatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 44 ..
16.44.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रमासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये सोमेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम चतुश्चत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः .. 44 ..
16.44.m: Thus ends the forty-fourth chapter, named the Description of the Greatness of Someśvara, in the first [part], the Greatness of Prabhāsa-kṣetra, in the seventh Prabhāsa section, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses. / 44

16.45.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi aṃgāreśvaramuttamam ..
sthāpitaṃ bhūmiputreṇa someśādīśa gocare .. 1 ..
16.45.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि अंगारेश्वरमुत्तमम् ..
स्थापितं भूमिपुत्रेण सोमेशादीश गोचरे .. 1 ..
16.45.m:
Īśvara said:
Then one should go, O great goddess, to the excellent Aṅgāreśvara,
established by the son of the Earth within the range of north-east from Someśa. / 1

16.45.s:
tripuraṃ dagdhukāmasya purā mama varānane ..
krodhādaśru viniṣkrāṃtaṃ locanatritayena tu ..2..
16.45.d:
त्रिपुरं दग्धुकामस्य पुरा मम वरानने ..
क्रोधादश्रु विनिष्क्रांतं लोचनत्रितयेन तु ..2..
16.45.m:
Anciently, O lovely-faced lady, when I desired to burn Tripura,
a tear came forth out of anger from my trio of eyes. / 2

16.45.s:
tacca bhūmau nipatitaṃ tato bhūbhisuto'bhavat ..
sa prabhāsaṃ tato gatvā bālyātprabhṛti śaṃkaram .. 3 ..
16.45.d:
तच्च भूमौ निपतितं ततो भूभिसुतोऽभवत् ..
स प्रभासं ततो गत्वा बाल्यात्प्रभृति शंकरम् .. 3 ..
16.45.m:
And that fell on the ground; then the son of the Earth was born.
He, having gone to Prabhāsa, propitiated Śaṃkara with austerity / 3

16.45.s:
tapasā''rādhayāmāsa bahūnvarṣagaṇānpriye ..
tasya tuṣṭo mahādevaḥ suprītātmā varaṃ dadau .. 4 ..
16.45.d:
तपसा'ऽराधयामास बहून्वर्षगणान्प्रिये ..
तस्य तुष्टो महादेवः सुप्रीतात्मा वरं ददौ .. 4 ..
16.45.m:
from his childhood for many groups of years, O beloved.
Mahādeva, pleased with him and well-disposed in mind, granted a boon. / 4

16.45.s:
so'bravīdyadi me deva tuṣṭosi vṛṣabhadhvaja ..
grahatvaṃ dehi sarveśa na cānyaṃ varamutsahe .. 5 ..
16.45.d:
सोऽब्रवीद्यदि मे देव तुष्टोसि वृषभध्वज ..
ग्रहत्वं देहि सर्वेश न चान्यं वरमुत्सहे .. 5 ..
16.45.m:
He said: ‘If you are pleased with me, O god whose banner bears a bull,
grant [me] the status of a planet, O Lord of all; I do not desire any other boon.’ / 5

16.45.s:
sa tatheti pratijñāya punastaṃ vākyamabravīt ..
ihāgatya naro yo māṃ pūjayiṣyati bhaktitaḥ .. 6 ..
16.45.d:
स तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय पुनस्तं वाक्यमब्रवीत् ..
इहागत्य नरो यो मां पूजयिष्यति भक्तितः .. 6 ..
16.45.m:
Having promised ‘So be it’, he spoke this word again to him:
‘Whichsoever person, having arrived here, worships me with devotion, / 6

16.45.s:
na bhaviṣyati vai pīḍā tāvakī tasya kutracit ..
puṣpāṇi raktavarṇāni madhvājyāktāni bhūriśaḥ .. 7 ..
16.45.d:
न भविष्यति वै पीडा तावकी तस्य कुत्रचित् ..
पुष्पाणि रक्तवर्णानि मध्वाज्याक्तानि भूरिशः .. 7 ..
16.45.m:
no affliction caused by you shall ever befall him.
Red-colored flowers in abundance smeared with honey and ghee, / 7

16.45.s:
homayiṣyati yo bhaktyā lakṣamekaṃ tadagrataḥ ..
paṃcopacāravidhinā tvāṃ tu saṃpūjya yatnataḥ .. 8 ..
16.45.d:
होमयिष्यति यो भक्त्या लक्षमेकं तदग्रतः ..
पंचोपचारविधिना त्वां तु संपूज्य यत्नतः .. 8 ..
16.45.m:
whoever offers as oblation in fire with devotion, one hundred thousand before it,
having worshipped you carefully by the rite of fivefold service, / 8

16.45.s:
tasya janmāvadhirnaiva tava pīḍā bhaviṣyati ...
tathā vidrumadānena lapsyate phalamīpsitam .. 9 ..
16.45.d:
तस्य जन्मावधिर्नैव तव पीडा भविष्यति ...
तथा विद्रुमदानेन लप्स्यते फलमीप्सितम् .. 9 ..
16.45.m:
as long as his life lasts there shall be no affliction from you;
likewise, through the gift of coral, he will obtain his desired fruit.’ / 9

16.45.s:
evamuktvā sa bhagavānatraivāṃtaradhīyana ..
bhaumo'pi grahamadhyastho vimānena virājate ..7.1.45.10..
16.45.d:
एवमुक्त्वा स भगवानत्रैवांतरधीयन ..
भौमोऽपि ग्रहमध्यस्थो विमानेन विराजते ..7.1.45.10..
16.45.m:
Having spoken thus, the Lord disappeared right there.
Bhauma also, abiding in the midst of the planets, shines in an aerial chariot. / 10

16.45.s:
evaṃ saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ bhaumamāhātmyamuttamam..
śrutaṃ harati pāpāni tathārogyaṃ prayacchati .. 11 ..
16.45.d:
एवं संक्षेपतः प्रोक्तं भौममाहात्म्यमुत्तमम्..
श्रुतं हरति पापानि तथारोग्यं प्रयच्छति .. 11 ..
16.45.m:
Thus the excellent greatness of Bhauma has been declared in brief;
heard, it removes sins and bestows good health. / 11

16.45.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmyeṃ'gāreśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcacatvāriṃśodhyāyaḥ .. 45 ..
16.45.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्येंऽगारेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम पञ्चचत्वारिंशोध्यायः .. 45 ..
16.45.m: Thus ends the forty-fifth chapter, named the Description of the Greatness of Aṅgāreśvara, in the first [part], the Greatness of Prabhāsa-kṣetra, in the seventh Prabhāsa section, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses. / 45

16.46.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi tasyaivottarataḥ sthitam ..
liṃgaṃ mahāprabhāvaṃ tu budheśvaramiti śrutam .. 1 ..
16.46.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि तस्यैवोत्तरतः स्थितम् ..
लिंगं महाप्रभावं तु बुधेश्वरमिति श्रुतम् .. 1 ..
16.46.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the liṅga situated to the north of it, / of great majesty, known as Budheśvara.

16.46.s:
dhanuṣāṃ dvitaye caiva nātidūre vyavasthitam ..
sarvapāpa haraṃ liṃgaṃ darśanādeva bhāmini .. 2 ..
16.46.d:
धनुषां द्वितये चैव नातिदूरे व्यवस्थितम् ..
सर्वपाप हरं लिंगं दर्शनादेव भामिनि .. 2 ..
16.46.m: Situated at a distance of two bow-lengths, not very far, / it is a liṅga that takes away all sins merely by darśana, O lovely woman.

16.46.s:
budhena caiva deveśi tatra taptaṃ mahātapaḥ ..
sthāpitaṃ vimalaṃ liṃgaṃ samārādhya sadāśivam .. 3 ..
16.46.d:
बुधेन चैव देवेशि तत्र तप्तं महातपः ..
स्थापितं विमलं लिंगं समाराध्य सदाशिवम् .. 3 ..
16.46.m: And by Budha, O goddess of the gods, great austerity was performed there; / having propitiated Sadāśiva, the spotless liṅga was installed [by him].

16.46.s:
varṣāyutāni catvāri saṃpūjya tu vidhānataḥ ..
ananyacetāḥ śāṃtātmā pratyakṣīkṛtavānbhavam.. 4 ..
16.46.d:
वर्षायुतानि चत्वारि संपूज्य तु विधानतः ..
अनन्यचेताः शांतात्मा प्रत्यक्षीकृतवान्भवम्.. 4 ..
16.46.m: Having worshipped according to rule for forty thousand years, / with undivided mind and peaceful soul, he brought Bhava before his eyes.

16.46.s:
tatastuṣṭamanā devo grahatvaṃ tasya taddadau ..
taṃ saṃpūjya vidhānena somaputrapratiṣṭhitam..
saumyāṣṭamyāṃ viśeṣeṇa rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet .. 5 ..
16.46.d:
ततस्तुष्टमना देवो ग्रहत्वं तस्य तद्ददौ ..
तं संपूज्य विधानेन सोमपुत्रप्रतिष्ठितम्..
सौम्याष्टम्यां विशेषेण राजसूयफलं लभेत् .. 5 ..
16.46.m: Then, with a pleased mind, the god granted him status as a planet. / Having worshipped according to rule that [liṅga] installed by the son of Soma, / particularly on a Wednesday eighth [lunar day], one obtains the fruit of a Rājasūya sacrifice.

16.46.s:
na daurbhāgyaṃ kule tasya na caiveṣṭaviyojanam ..
śatruto na bhayaṃ tasya bhavettasyaprasādataḥ .. 6 ..
16.46.d:
न दौर्भाग्यं कुले तस्य न चैवेष्टवियोजनम् ..
शत्रुतो न भयं तस्य भवेत्तस्यप्रसादतः .. 6 ..
16.46.m: There is no misfortune in his family, nor separation from cherished ones; / through his grace, he has no fear from enemies.

16.46.s:
iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ māhātmyaṃ budhadaivatam..
śrutvā'bhinaṃdya prayataḥ prāpnoti paramaṃ padam .. 7 ..
16.46.d:
इति संक्षेपतः प्रोक्तं माहात्म्यं बुधदैवतम्..
श्रुत्वाऽभिनंद्य प्रयतः प्राप्नोति परमं पदम् .. 7 ..
16.46.m: Thus the māhātmya dedicated to the deity Budha has been declared in brief; / having heard it and rejoiced, restrained, one attains the supreme state.

16.46.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpu rāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye budheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaṣaṭcatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 46 ..
16.46.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापु राण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये बुधेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामषट्चत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः .. 46 ..
16.46.m: Thus in the glorious Skanda Purāṇa, in the collection of eighty-one thousand [verses], in the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the first Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, the forty-sixth chapter named 'Description of the Budheśvara-māhātmya'.

16.47.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi devaṃ guruniṣevitam..
umāyāḥ pūrvadigbhāge siddheśāgneyagocare .. 1 ..
16.47.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि देवं गुरुनिषेवितम्..
उमायाः पूर्वदिग्भागे सिद्धेशाग्नेयगोचरे .. 1 ..
16.47.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the god served by Guru, / to the eastern region of Umā, in the southeast area of Siddheśa.

16.47.s:
saṃsthitaṃ tu mahalliṃgaṃ devācārya pratiṣṭhitam ..
ārādhya parayā bhaktyā liṃgaṃ varṣasahasrakam .. 2 ..
16.47.d:
संस्थितं तु महल्लिंगं देवाचार्य प्रतिष्ठितम् ..
आराध्य परया भक्त्या लिंगं वर्षसहस्रकम् .. 2 ..
16.47.m: There stands the great liṅga installed by the preceptor of the gods. / Having worshipped the liṅga with supreme devotion for a thousand years,
he satisfied the lord of gods, Bhava, Śarva, the lord of Umā. / He obtained all desires unobtainable by the undisciplined.

16.47.s:
devānāṃ caiva pūjyatvaṃ prāpya jñānamathaiśvaram..
grahatvaṃ ca tathā prāpya modate divi sāṃpratam .. 4 ..
16.47.d:
देवानां चैव पूज्यत्वं प्राप्य ज्ञानमथैश्वरम्..
ग्रहत्वं च तथा प्राप्य मोदते दिवि सांप्रतम् .. 4 ..
16.47.m: And having obtained the status of being worshipped by the gods, divine knowledge, / and likewise planetary status, he now rejoices in heaven.

16.47.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavo bhaktyā na durgati mavāpnuyāt..
bṛhaspatikṛtaṃ liṃgaṃ ye paśyaṃti narottamāḥ .. 5 ..
16.47.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा मानवो भक्त्या न दुर्गति मवाप्नुयात्..
बृहस्पतिकृतं लिंगं ये पश्यंति नरोत्तमाः .. 5 ..
16.47.m: Having seen it with devotion, a human being does not meet an evil state. / Those best among men who see the liṅga made by Bṛhaspati,

16.47.s:
bṛhaspatikṛtā pīḍā naiva teṣāṃ hi jāyate ..
tatra śuklacaturdaśyāṃ guruvāre tathā priye .. .. 6 ..
16.47.d:
बृहस्पतिकृता पीडा नैव तेषां हि जायते ..
तत्र शुक्लचतुर्दश्यां गुरुवारे तथा प्रिये .. .. 6 ..
16.47.m: affliction caused by Bṛhaspati never arises for them. / There, on the bright fourteenth [lunar day], and on Thursday, O beloved,

16.47.s:
saṃpūjya vidhivalliṃgaṃ samyagrājopacārataḥ ..
athavā bhaktibhāvena prāpnuyātparamaṃ padam .. 7 ..
16.47.d:
संपूज्य विधिवल्लिंगं सम्यग्राजोपचारतः ..
अथवा भक्तिभावेन प्राप्नुयात्परमं पदम् .. 7 ..
16.47.m: having worshipped the liṅga according to rule with all royal services, / or with a disposition of devotion, one attains the supreme state.

16.47.s:
snānaṃ palasahasreṇa paṃcāmṛtarasena yaḥ ..
karoti bhaktyā martyo vai mucyate sa ṛṇatrayāt ..8..
16.47.d:
स्नानं पलसहस्रेण पंचामृतरसेन यः ..
करोति भक्त्या मर्त्यो वै मुच्यते स ऋणत्रयात् ..8..
16.47.m: A mortal who performs with devotion a ritual ablution / with a thousand palas of the liquid of fivefold ambrosia, is indeed freed from the three debts:

16.47.s:
mātṛkātpaitṛkāddevi tathā gurusamudbhavāt ..
sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā nirdvaṃdvo muktimāpnuyāt .. 9 ..
16.47.d:
मातृकात्पैतृकाद्देवि तथा गुरुसमुद्भवात् ..
सर्वपापविशुद्धात्मा निर्द्वंद्वो मुक्तिमाप्नुयात् .. 9 ..
16.47.m: from the maternal, from the paternal, O goddess, and from that originating from the guru. / Purified in soul from all sins, free from the pairs of opposites, he attains liberation.

16.47.s:
evaṃ saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ māhātmyaṃ gurudaivatam ..
śṛṇuyādyastu bhāvena tasya prīto gururbhavet .. 7.1.47.10 ..
16.47.d:
एवं संक्षेपतः प्रोक्तं माहात्म्यं गुरुदैवतम् ..
शृणुयाद्यस्तु भावेन तस्य प्रीतो गुरुर्भवेत् .. 7.1.47.10 ..
16.47.m: Thus has been declared in brief the māhātmya dedicated to the deity Guru. / For him who listens with devotion, Guru will be pleased.

16.47.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye vṛhaspatīśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 47 .... ..
16.47.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये वृहस्पतीश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम सप्तचत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः .. 47 .... ..
16.47.m: Thus in the glorious Skanda Purāṇa, in the collection of eighty-one thousand [verses], in the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the first Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, the forty-seventh chapter named 'Description of the Bṛhaspatīśvara-māhātmya'.

16.48.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi liṃgaṃ śukrapratiṣṭhitam..
sarvapāpaharaṃ devi vibhūtīśvarapaścime..1..
16.48.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि लिंगं शुक्रप्रतिष्ठितम्..
सर्वपापहरं देवि विभूतीश्वरपश्चिमे..1..
16.48.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the liṅga installed by Śukra, / removing all sins, O goddess, to the west of Vibhūtīśvara,

16.48.s:
nātidūre sthitaṃ tatra svayaṃ śukreṇa nirmitam..
yatra saṃjīvanīṃ prāpto vidyāṃ rudraprabhāvataḥ ..2..
16.48.d:
नातिदूरे स्थितं तत्र स्वयं शुक्रेण निर्मितम्..
यत्र संजीवनीं प्राप्तो विद्यां रुद्रप्रभावतः ..2..
16.48.m: situated not very far from there, fashioned by Śukra himself, / where he obtained the lore of reviving the dead through the power of Rudra.

16.48.s:
saṃtapya tu mahāghoraṃ tapovarṣasahasrakam ..
saṃprasādya virūpākṣaṃ yo'vāpa grahatāṃ sudhīḥ ..3..
16.48.d:
संतप्य तु महाघोरं तपोवर्षसहस्रकम् ..
संप्रसाद्य विरूपाक्षं योऽवाप ग्रहतां सुधीः ..3..
16.48.m: Having performed very dreadful austerity for a thousand years, / having propitiated Virūpākṣa, the wise one obtained the status of a planet.

16.48.s:
grastena śaṃbhunā yena devakāryārthasiddhaye ..
tatrodaragatenaiva tapastaptaṃ suduṣkaram.. 4..
16.48.d:
ग्रस्तेन शंभुना येन देवकार्यार्थसिद्धये ..
तत्रोदरगतेनैव तपस्तप्तं सुदुष्करम्.. 4..
16.48.m: He, swallowed by Śambhu for the accomplishment of the purpose of the gods, / performed very difficult austerity while dwelling within his belly.

16.48.s:
varṣāṇāmayutaṃ sāgraṃ tuṣṭiṃ nīto maheśvaraḥ ..
niṣkāsitastataḥ śīghraṃ śukra mārgeṇa śaṃbhunā ..5..
16.48.d:
वर्षाणामयुतं साग्रं तुष्टिं नीतो महेश्वरः ..
निष्कासितस्ततः शीघ्रं शुक्र मार्गेण शंभुना ..5..
16.48.m: For fully ten thousand years, Maheśvara was brought to satisfaction. / Then he was quickly expelled by Śambhu through the path of semen.

16.48.s:
tataḥ śukreti nāmābhūdbhārgavasya mahātmanaḥ ..
tadārādhayate liṃgaṃ yaḥ kṛtvā niścalaṃ manaḥ ..6..
16.48.d:
ततः शुक्रेति नामाभूद्भार्गवस्य महात्मनः ..
तदाराधयते लिंगं यः कृत्वा निश्चलं मनः ..6..
16.48.m: Thereupon, the name 'Śukra' came to be for that great-souled Bhārgava. / He who worships that liṅga having made his mind steadfast,
and recites the Mṛtyuñjaya mantra a hundred thousand times, attains his desired aim.

16.48.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā tvathavā spṛṣṭvā janmādimaraṇāntakāt..
mucyate pātakānmṛtyoḥ prasādāttasya bhāmini..8..
16.48.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा त्वथवा स्पृष्ट्वा जन्मादिमरणान्तकात्..
मुच्यते पातकान्मृत्योः प्रसादात्तस्य भामिनि..8..
16.48.m: Having seen or touched it, one is freed from the sin / extending from birth to death, through his grace, O lovely woman.

16.48.s:
mṛtasaṃjīvanārthaṃ yadaiśvaryamaṇimādikam..
prāpnuyānnātra saṃdeho yasya bhaktiḥ suniścalā ..9..
16.48.d:
मृतसंजीवनार्थं यदैश्वर्यमणिमादिकम्..
प्राप्नुयान्नात्र संदेहो यस्य भक्तिः सुनिश्चला ..9..
16.48.m: Whatever sovereignty for reviving the dead, beginning with the power of becoming small, / he attains, there is no doubt, whose devotion is very firm.

16.48.s:
paṃcāmṛtena saṃsnāpya devaṃ śukapratiṣṭhitam..
sugandhapuṣpaiḥ saṃpūjya śaukrīṃ pīḍāṃ sa nāpnuyāt ..7.1.48.10..
16.48.d:
पंचामृतेन संस्नाप्य देवं शुकप्रतिष्ठितम्..
सुगन्धपुष्पैः संपूज्य शौक्रीं पीडां स नाप्नुयात् ..7.1.48.10..
16.48.m: Having bathed the god installed by Śukra with fivefold ambrosia / and worshipped with fragrant flowers, he does not suffer affliction caused by Śukra.

16.48.s:
iti sarvaṃ samāsena māhātmyaṃ śukradaivatam ..
kathitaṃ tava suśroṇi śrutaṃ pāpabhayāpaham ..11..
16.48.d:
इति सर्वं समासेन माहात्म्यं शुक्रदैवतम् ..
कथितं तव सुश्रोणि श्रुतं पापभयापहम् ..11..
16.48.m: Thus the entire māhātmya dedicated to the deity Śukra / has been told to you in summary, O woman of beautiful hips; heard, it removes sin and fear.

16.48.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye śukreśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭacatvāriṃśodhyāyaḥ .. 48 ..
16.48.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये शुक्रेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामाष्टचत्वारिंशोध्यायः .. 48 ..
16.48.m: Thus in the glorious Skanda Purāṇa, in the collection of eighty-one thousand [verses], in the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the first Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, the forty-eighth chapter named 'Description of the Śukreśvara-māhātmya'.

16.49.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tasmācchukreśvarādgaccheddevi liṃgaṃ mahāprabham..
śanaiścaraiśvaraṃnāma mahāpātakanāśanam .. 1 ..
16.49.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तस्माच्छुक्रेश्वराद्गच्छेद्देवि लिंगं महाप्रभम्..
शनैश्चरैश्वरंनाम महापातकनाशनम् .. 1 ..
16.49.m: Īśvara said: / From that Śukreśvara, O goddess, one should go to the liṅga of great splendour / named Śanaiścaraiśvara, destroying great sins,

16.49.s:
budheśvarātpaścimato hyajādevyagnigocare ..
tasyā dhanuḥ paṃcakena nātidūre vyavasthitam .. 2 ..
16.49.d:
बुधेश्वरात्पश्चिमतो ह्यजादेव्यग्निगोचरे ..
तस्या धनुः पंचकेन नातिदूरे व्यवस्थितम् .. 2 ..
16.49.m: to the west of Budheśvara, in the southeast direction of the goddess Ajā, / situated not very far from it, at five bow-lengths.

16.49.s:
kalpaliṃgaṃ mahādevi pūjitaṃ devadānavaiḥ ..
chāyāputreṇa saṃtaptaṃ tapaḥ paramaduṣkaram .. 3 ..
16.49.d:
कल्पलिंगं महादेवि पूजितं देवदानवैः ..
छायापुत्रेण संतप्तं तपः परमदुष्करम् .. 3 ..
16.49.m: It is an eon-lasting liṅga, O great goddess, worshipped by gods and Dānavas. / By the son of Chāyā, extremely difficult austerity was performed,

16.49.s:
anādi nidhano devo yena liṃge'vatāritaḥ ..
prāptavānyo graheśatvaṃ bhaktyā śaṃbhoḥ prasādataḥ .. 4 ..
16.49.d:
अनादि निधनो देवो येन लिंगेऽवतारितः ..
प्राप्तवान्यो ग्रहेशत्वं भक्त्या शंभोः प्रसादतः .. 4 ..
16.49.m: by whom the god without beginning and end was brought down into the liṅga, / and who attained the status of lord of planets through devotion, by the grace of Śambhu.

16.49.s:
yasya dṛṣṭyā bibheti sma devāsuragaṇo mahān ..
na sa ko'pyasti vai prāṇī brahmāṃḍe sacarācare .. 5 ..
16.49.d:
यस्य दृष्ट्या बिभेति स्म देवासुरगणो महान् ..
न स कोऽप्यस्ति वै प्राणी ब्रह्मांडे सचराचरे .. 5 ..
16.49.m: At whose glance the great host of gods and asuras trembled; / there is indeed no living being in the universe of mobile and immobile things,

16.49.s:
devo vā dānavo vāpi sauriṇā pīḍito na yaḥ ..
śanivāreṇa saṃpūjya bhaktyā saurīśvaraṃ śivam .. .. 6 ..
16.49.d:
देवो वा दानवो वापि सौरिणा पीडितो न यः ..
शनिवारेण संपूज्य भक्त्या सौरीश्वरं शिवम् .. .. 6 ..
16.49.m: god or Dānava, who is not afflicted by Sauri. / Having worshipped the auspicious Saurīśvara with devotion on a Saturday,

16.49.s:
śamīpatrairmahādevi tilamāṣaguḍaudanaiḥ ..
saṃtarpya tu vidhānena dadyātkṛṣṇaṃ vṛṣaṃ dvije .. 7 ..
16.49.d:
शमीपत्रैर्महादेवि तिलमाषगुडौदनैः ..
संतर्प्य तु विधानेन दद्यात्कृष्णं वृषं द्विजे .. 7 ..
16.49.m: with leaves of the śamī, O great goddess, and with sesame, māṣa beans, jaggery, and cooked rice, / having gratified [him] according to rule, one should give a black bull to a twice-born.

16.49.s:
stutvā stotraiśca vividhaiḥ purāṇaśrutisaṃbhavaiḥ ..
atha vaikena deveśaḥ stotreṇa paritoṣitaḥ .. 8 ..
16.49.d:
स्तुत्वा स्तोत्रैश्च विविधैः पुराणश्रुतिसंभवैः ..
अथ वैकेन देवेशः स्तोत्रेण परितोषितः .. 8 ..
16.49.m: Having praised with various hymns arising from the Purāṇas and the Śruti, / or with a single hymn, the lord of gods was completely pleased,

16.49.s:
rājñā daśarathenaiva kṛtena tu balīyasā ..
stutyaḥ saurīśvaro devaḥ sarvapīḍopaśāṃtaye.. 9 ..
16.49.d:
राज्ञा दशरथेनैव कृतेन तु बलीयसा ..
स्तुत्यः सौरीश्वरो देवः सर्वपीडोपशांतये.. 9 ..
16.49.m: [the hymn] made by King Daśaratha, the mighty one. / The divine lord Saurīśvara is to be praised for the appeasement of all afflictions.

16.49.s:
.. devyu vāca .. ..
kathaṃ daśaratho rājā cakre śānaiścarīṃ stutim ..
kathaṃ saṃtuṣṭimagamattasya devaḥ śanaiścaraḥ .. 7.1.49.10 ..
16.49.d:
.. देव्यु वाच .. ..
कथं दशरथो राजा चक्रे शानैश्चरीं स्तुतिम् ..
कथं संतुष्टिमगमत्तस्य देवः शनैश्चरः .. 7.1.49.10 ..
16.49.m: The goddess said: / How did King Daśaratha compose the hymn to Śanaiścara? / How did the divine Śanaiścara become pleased with him?

16.49.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
raghuvaṃśe'ti vikhyāto rājā daśaratho balī ..
cakravartī sa vijñeyaḥ saptadvīpādhipaḥ purā .. 11 ..
16.49.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
रघुवंशेऽति विख्यातो राजा दशरथो बली ..
चक्रवर्ती स विज्ञेयः सप्तद्वीपाधिपः पुरा .. 11 ..
16.49.m:
Īśvara said:
In ancient times there was a powerful king renowned in Raghu's lineage, named Daśaratha, / known as a universal monarch and ruler of the seven continents.

16.49.s:
kṛttikāṃte śaniṃ kṛtvā daivajñairjñāpito hi saḥ ..
rohiṇīṃ bheda yitvā tu śaniryāsyati sāṃpratam .. 12 ..
16.49.d:
कृत्तिकांते शनिं कृत्वा दैवज्ञैर्ज्ञापितो हि सः ..
रोहिणीं भेद यित्वा तु शनिर्यास्यति सांप्रतम् .. 12 ..
16.49.m: When Śani reached the end of Kṛttikā, astrologers informed him: / 'Śani is now about to go on, piercing Rohiṇī.'

16.49.s:
uktaṃ śakaṭabhedaṃ tu surāsurabhayaṃkaram ..
dvādaśābdaṃ tu durbhikṣaṃ bhaviṣyati sudāruṇam .. 13 ..
16.49.d:
उक्तं शकटभेदं तु सुरासुरभयंकरम् ..
द्वादशाब्दं तु दुर्भिक्षं भविष्यति सुदारुणम् .. 13 ..
16.49.m: The piercing of the cart was described as terrifying to gods and demons alike: / 'A most terrible famine lasting twelve years will take place.'

16.49.s:
etacchrutvā munervākyaṃ maṃtribhiḥ sahito nṛpaḥ ..
ākulaṃ tu jagaddṛṣṭvā paurajānapadādikam .. 14 ..
16.49.d:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा मुनेर्वाक्यं मंत्रिभिः सहितो नृपः ..
आकुलं तु जगद्दृष्ट्वा पौरजानपदादिकम् .. 14 ..
16.49.m: Hearing these words from the sage, the king, together with his ministers, / seeing the world—the citizens, country-dwellers, and others—in distress,

16.49.s:
vadaṃti satataṃ lokā niyamena samāgatāḥ ..
deśāśca nagara grāmā bhayākrāṃtāḥ samaṃtataḥ ..
munīnvasiṣṭhapramukhānpapraccha ca svayaṃ nṛpaḥ .. 15 ..
16.49.d:
वदंति सततं लोका नियमेन समागताः ..
देशाश्च नगर ग्रामा भयाक्रांताः समंततः ..
मुनीन्वसिष्ठप्रमुखान्पप्रच्छ च स्वयं नृपः .. 15 ..
16.49.m: and the people constantly speaking, assembled according to rule, / while the countries, cities, and villages were everywhere seized with terror, / the king himself questioned the sages headed by Vasiṣṭha.

16.49.s:
.. daśaratha uvāca .. ..
samādhānaṃ kimatrāste brūhi me dvija sattama .. 16 ..
16.49.d:
.. दशरथ उवाच .. ..
समाधानं किमत्रास्ते ब्रूहि मे द्विज सत्तम .. 16 ..
16.49.m:
Daśaratha said:
What remedy is there in this matter? Tell me, best among the twice-born!

16.49.s:
.. vasiṣṭha uvāca .. ..
prājāpatye ca nakṣatre tasminbhinne kutaḥ prajāḥ ..
ayaṃ yogo hyasādhyastu brahmādīṃdrādibhiḥ suraiḥ.. .. 17 ..
16.49.d:
.. वसिष्ठ उवाच .. ..
प्राजापत्ये च नक्षत्रे तस्मिन्भिन्ने कुतः प्रजाः ..
अयं योगो ह्यसाध्यस्तु ब्रह्मादींद्रादिभिः सुरैः.. .. 17 ..
16.49.m:
Vasiṣṭha said:
When that constellation of Prajāpati is pierced, how can subjects survive? / Indeed, this conjunction cannot be averted even by the gods headed by Brahmā and Indra.

16.49.s:
tadā saṃciṃtya manasā sāhasaṃ paramaṃ mahat ..
samādāya dhanurdivyaṃ divyairastraiḥ samanvitam .. 18 ..
16.49.d:
तदा संचिंत्य मनसा साहसं परमं महत् ..
समादाय धनुर्दिव्यं दिव्यैरस्त्रैः समन्वितम् .. 18 ..
16.49.m: Then, having resolved in his mind upon an exceedingly great, daring deed, / taking up his divine bow equipped with celestial weapons,

16.49.s:
rathamāruhya vegena gato nakṣatramaṃḍalam ...
rathaṃ tu kāṃcanaṃ divyaṃ maṇiratnavibhūṣitam .. 19 ..
16.49.d:
रथमारुह्य वेगेन गतो नक्षत्रमंडलम् ...
रथं तु कांचनं दिव्यं मणिरत्नविभूषितम् .. 19 ..
16.49.m: he swiftly mounted his chariot and went to the circle of constellations. / It was a celestial golden chariot, adorned with gems and jewels,

16.49.s:
dhvajaiśca cāmaraiśchatraiḥ kiṃkiṇairatha śobhitam..
haṃsavarṇahayairyuktaṃ mahāketusamanvitam .. 7.1.49.20 ..
16.49.d:
ध्वजैश्च चामरैश्छत्रैः किंकिणैरथ शोभितम्..
हंसवर्णहयैर्युक्तं महाकेतुसमन्वितम् .. 7.1.49.20 ..
16.49.m: and adorned with flags, chowries, umbrellas, and small tinkling bells, / yoked to swan-white horses and furnished with a great banner.

16.49.s:
dīpyamāno mahāratnaiḥ kirīṭamukuṭojjvalaḥ ..
babhrāja sa tadākāśe dvitīya iva bhāskaraḥ .. 21 ..
16.49.d:
दीप्यमानो महारत्नैः किरीटमुकुटोज्ज्वलः ..
बभ्राज स तदाकाशे द्वितीय इव भास्करः .. 21 ..
16.49.m: Blazing with great gems, radiant with his diadem and crown, / he shone in the sky at that moment like a second sun.

16.49.s:
ākarṇaṃ cāpamāpūrya saṃhārāstraṃ niyojya ca ..
kṛttikāṃte śaniṃ jñātvā praviśya kila rohiṇīm .. 22 ..
16.49.d:
आकर्णं चापमापूर्य संहारास्त्रं नियोज्य च ..
कृत्तिकांते शनिं ज्ञात्वा प्रविश्य किल रोहिणीम् .. 22 ..
16.49.m: Drawing his bow to his ear and fitting the weapon of destruction, / knowing Śani was at the end of Kṛttikā and about to enter Rohiṇī,

16.49.s:
dṛṣṭvā daśaratho'syāgre tasthau sabhrukuṭīmukhaḥ ..
saṃhārāstraṃ śanirdṛṣṭvā surāsuravimarddanam.. .. 23 ..
16.49.d:
दृष्ट्वा दशरथोऽस्याग्रे तस्थौ सभ्रुकुटीमुखः ..
संहारास्त्रं शनिर्दृष्ट्वा सुरासुरविमर्द्दनम्.. .. 23 ..
16.49.m: seeing [him], Daśaratha stood before him with a knit brow on his face. / Seeing the weapon of destruction that crushes gods and demons,

16.49.s:
hasitvā tadrayātsauriridaṃ vacanamabravīt ..
pauruṣaṃ tava rājeṃdra paraṃ ripubhayaṃkaram .. 24 ..
16.49.d:
हसित्वा तद्रयात्सौरिरिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ..
पौरुषं तव राजेंद्र परं रिपुभयंकरम् .. 24 ..
16.49.m: Sauri laughed in his swift speed and spoke these words: / 'O king of kings, your valor is supreme and strikes terror into foes!

16.49.s:
devāsuramanuṣyāśca siddhavidyādharoragāḥ ..
mayā vilokitāḥ sarve bhayaṃ cāśu vrajaṃti te .. 25 ..
16.49.d:
देवासुरमनुष्याश्च सिद्धविद्याधरोरगाः ..
मया विलोकिताः सर्वे भयं चाशु व्रजंति ते .. 25 ..
16.49.m: Gods, demons, men, siddhas, vidyādharas, and serpents— / all whom I gaze upon immediately fall into terror.

16.49.s:
tuṣṭohaṃ tava rājeṃdra tapasā pauruṣeṇa ca ..
varaṃ brūhi pradāsyāmi manasā yadabhīpsitam .. 26 .. ..
16.49.d:
तुष्टोहं तव राजेंद्र तपसा पौरुषेण च ..
वरं ब्रूहि प्रदास्यामि मनसा यदभीप्सितम् .. 26 .. ..
16.49.m: I am pleased with you, O king of kings, because of your austerity and your valor! / Name a boon; I will grant whatever is desired in your heart.'

16.49.s:
.. daśaratha uvāca .. ..
rohiṇīṃ bhedayitvā tu na gaṃtavyaṃ tvayā śane ..
saritaḥ sāgarā yāvadyāvaccadrārkamedinī .. 27 ..
16.49.d:
.. दशरथ उवाच .. ..
रोहिणीं भेदयित्वा तु न गंतव्यं त्वया शने ..
सरितः सागरा यावद्यावच्चद्रार्कमेदिनी .. 27 ..
16.49.m:
Daśaratha said:
O Śani, you must not go piercing Rohiṇī / as long as rivers, oceans, the moon, the sun, and the earth endure!

16.49.s:
yācitaṃ te mayā saure nānya micchāmi te varam ..
evamuktaḥ śaniḥ prādādvaraṃ tasmai tu śāśvatam .. 28 ..
16.49.d:
याचितं ते मया सौरे नान्य मिच्छामि ते वरम् ..
एवमुक्तः शनिः प्रादाद्वरं तस्मै तु शाश्वतम् .. 28 ..
16.49.m: This is what I have requested of you, O Sauri; I desire no other boon from you! / Addressed in this way, Śani granted him an eternal boon.

16.49.s:
prāpyaivaṃ tu varaṃ rājā kṛtakṛtyo'bhavattadā ..
punarevābravītsaurirvaraṃ varaya suvrata .. 29 ..
16.49.d:
प्राप्यैवं तु वरं राजा कृतकृत्योऽभवत्तदा ..
पुनरेवाब्रवीत्सौरिर्वरं वरय सुव्रत .. 29 ..
16.49.m: Having obtained this boon, the king was then fulfilled in his purpose. / Again Sauri said: 'Choose another boon, O you of noble vows!'

16.49.s:
prārthayāmāsa hṛṣṭātmā varamevaṃ śanestadā ..
na bhettavyaṃ ca śakaṭaṃ tvayā bhāskaranaṃdana .. 7.1.49.30 ..
16.49.d:
प्रार्थयामास हृष्टात्मा वरमेवं शनेस्तदा ..
न भेत्तव्यं च शकटं त्वया भास्करनंदन .. 7.1.49.30 ..
16.49.m: His heart delighted, he then requested this boon from Śani: / 'The cart must not be pierced by you, O son of the Sun!

16.49.s:
dvādaśābdaṃ tu durbhikṣaṃ na kartavyaṃ kadācana ..
kīrtireṣā madīyā ca trailokye vicariṣyati .. 31 ..
16.49.d:
द्वादशाब्दं तु दुर्भिक्षं न कर्तव्यं कदाचन ..
कीर्तिरेषा मदीया च त्रैलोक्ये विचरिष्यति .. 31 ..
16.49.m: A famine of twelve years must never be caused! / And may this fame of mine wander throughout the three worlds!'

16.49.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
varadvayaṃ tataḥ prāpya hṛṣṭaromā sa pārthivaḥ ..
rathopari dhanurmuktvā bhūtvā caiva kṛtāṃjaliḥ .. 32 ..
16.49.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
वरद्वयं ततः प्राप्य हृष्टरोमा स पार्थिवः ..
रथोपरि धनुर्मुक्त्वा भूत्वा चैव कृतांजलिः .. 32 ..
16.49.m:
Īśvara said:
Having obtained the two boons, his body bristling with joy, that lord of the earth / set down his bow upon the chariot and, with joined palms,

16.49.s:
dhyātvā sarasvatīṃ devīṃ gaṇanāthaṃ vināyakam ..
rājā daśarathaḥ stotraṃ saureridamathākarot .. 33 .. ..
16.49.d:
ध्यात्वा सरस्वतीं देवीं गणनाथं विनायकम् ..
राजा दशरथः स्तोत्रं सौरेरिदमथाकरोत् .. 33 .. ..
16.49.m: meditated upon goddess Sarasvatī and Vināyaka, the lord of gaṇas; / then King Daśaratha composed this hymn of praise to Sauri.

16.49.s:
.. rājovāca .. ..
namo nīlamayūkhāya nīlotpalanibhāya ca ..
namo nirmāṃsadehāya dīrghaśmaśrujaṭāya ca ..34..
16.49.d:
.. राजोवाच .. ..
नमो नीलमयूखाय नीलोत्पलनिभाय च ..
नमो निर्मांसदेहाय दीर्घश्मश्रुजटाय च ..34..
16.49.m:
The king said:
Praise to the one of dark blue rays, resembling a blue lotus! / Praise to the one of fleshless body, with a long beard and matted hair!

16.49.s:
namo viśālanetrāya śuṣkodarabhayāna ka ..
namaḥ paruṣagātrāya sthūlaromāya vai namaḥ .. 35 ..
16.49.d:
नमो विशालनेत्राय शुष्कोदरभयान क ..
नमः परुषगात्राय स्थूलरोमाय वै नमः .. 35 ..
16.49.m: Praise to the broad-eyed one, terrible with an emaciated belly! / Praise to the one of rough limbs, praise to the coarse-haired one!

16.49.s:
namo nityaṃ kṣudhārttāya nityataptāya vai namaḥ ..
namaḥ kālāgnirūpāya kṛtāṃtaka namostu te .. 36 ..
16.49.d:
नमो नित्यं क्षुधार्त्ताय नित्यतप्ताय वै नमः ..
नमः कालाग्निरूपाय कृतांतक नमोस्तु ते .. 36 ..
16.49.m: Praise to the one who is constantly afflicted by hunger, praise to the perpetually burning one! / Praise to the one whose form is the fire of time! Praise be to you, O bringer of the end!

16.49.s:
namo dīrghāya śuṣkāya kāladṛṣṭe namo'stu te ..
namaste koṭarākṣāya durnirīkṣyāya vai namaḥ ..37..
16.49.d:
नमो दीर्घाय शुष्काय कालदृष्टे नमोऽस्तु ते ..
नमस्ते कोटराक्षाय दुर्निरीक्ष्याय वै नमः ..37..
16.49.m: Praise to the tall and dried-up one! Praise be to you whose glance is death! / Praise to you with hollow, sunken eyes! Praise indeed to the one difficult to look upon!

16.49.s:
namo ghorāya raudrāya bhīṣaṇāya karā line ..
namaste sarvabhakṣāya valīmukha namo'stu te .. 38 ..
16.49.d:
नमो घोराय रौद्राय भीषणाय करा लिने ..
नमस्ते सर्वभक्षाय वलीमुख नमोऽस्तु ते .. 38 ..
16.49.m: Praise to the terrible, fierce, frightening one with gaping fangs! / Praise to you, the all-devouring one! Praise be to you with wrinkled face!

16.49.s:
sūryaputra namaste'stu bhāskare bhayadāyaka ..
adhodṛṣṭe namastubhyaṃ vapuḥśyāma namo'stu te .. 39 ..
16.49.d:
सूर्यपुत्र नमस्तेऽस्तु भास्करे भयदायक ..
अधोदृष्टे नमस्तुभ्यं वपुःश्याम नमोऽस्तु ते .. 39 ..
16.49.m: O son of Sūrya, praise be to you, who brings fear to the Sun! / Praise to you of downward gaze! Praise be to you of dark body!

16.49.s:
namo mandagate tubhyaṃ nistriṃśāya namonamaḥ ..
namasta ugrarūpāya caṇḍatejāya te namaḥ .. 7.1.49.40 ..
16.49.d:
नमो मन्दगते तुभ्यं निस्त्रिंशाय नमोनमः ..
नमस्त उग्ररूपाय चण्डतेजाय ते नमः .. 7.1.49.40 ..
16.49.m: Praise to you of slow movement! Praise, praise to the merciless one! / Praise to you of ferocious form! Praise to you of fierce splendor!

16.49.s:
tapasā dagdhadehāya nityaṃ yogaratāya ca ..
namaste jñānanetrāya kaśyapātmajasūnave .. 41 ..
16.49.d:
तपसा दग्धदेहाय नित्यं योगरताय च ..
नमस्ते ज्ञाननेत्राय कश्यपात्मजसूनवे .. 41 ..
16.49.m: To the one whose body is burned by austerity, who is constantly devoted to yoga, / praise be to you who has eyes of knowledge, O grandson of Kaśyapa!

16.49.s:
tuṣṭo dadāsi vai rājyaṃ ruṣṭo harasi tatkṣaṇāt ..
devāsuramanuṣyāśca paśupakṣisarīsṛpāḥ ..42..
16.49.d:
तुष्टो ददासि वै राज्यं रुष्टो हरसि तत्क्षणात् ..
देवासुरमनुष्याश्च पशुपक्षिसरीसृपाः ..42..
16.49.m: When pleased, you grant sovereignty; when angry, you snatch it away that very instant! / Gods, demons, men, beasts, birds, and reptiles,

16.49.s:
tvayā vilokitāḥ saure dainyamāśu vrajaṃti ca ..
brahmā śakro yamaścaiva ṛṣayaḥ saptatārakāḥ .. 43 ..
16.49.d:
त्वया विलोकिताः सौरे दैन्यमाशु व्रजंति च ..
ब्रह्मा शक्रो यमश्चैव ऋषयः सप्ततारकाः .. 43 ..
16.49.m: when gazed upon by you, O Sauri, swiftly fall into misery. / Brahmā, Śakra, Yama, and the seven seers—

16.49.s:
rājyabhraṣṭāśca te sarve tava dṛṣṭyā vilokitāḥ ..
deśāśca nagaragrāmā dvīpāścaivādrayastathā .. 44 ..
16.49.d:
राज्यभ्रष्टाश्च ते सर्वे तव दृष्ट्या विलोकिताः ..
देशाश्च नगरग्रामा द्वीपाश्चैवाद्रयस्तथा .. 44 ..
16.49.m: all of them were cast down from their realms when gazed upon by your glance! / Countries, cities, villages, continents, and mountains,

16.49.s: raudradṛṣṭyā tu ye dṛṣṭāḥ kṣayaṃ gacchaṃti tatkṣaṇāt .. 45 ..
16.49.d: रौद्रदृष्ट्या तु ये दृष्टाः क्षयं गच्छंति तत्क्षणात् .. 45 ..
16.49.m: whatever are looked upon with a terrible glance immediately go to destruction.

16.49.s:
prasādaṃ kuru me saure varārthe'haṃ tavāśritaḥ
saure kṣamasvāparādhaṃ sarvabhūtahitāya ca .. 46 ..
16.49.d:
प्रसादं कुरु मे सौरे वरार्थेऽहं तवाश्रितः
सौरे क्षमस्वापराधं सर्वभूतहिताय च .. 46 ..
16.49.m: Be gracious to me, O Sauri! For the sake of a boon I have sought refuge with you. / O Sauri, forgive my transgression for the welfare of all beings!

16.49.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
evaṃ stutastadā saurī rājñā daśarathena ca ..
maharājaḥ śanirvākyaṃ hṛṣṭaro mā'bravīdidam .. 47 ..
16.49.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
एवं स्तुतस्तदा सौरी राज्ञा दशरथेन च ..
महराजः शनिर्वाक्यं हृष्टरो माऽब्रवीदिदम् .. 47 ..
16.49.m:
Īśvara said:
Praised thus at that time by King Daśaratha, / the great king Śani, with hairs standing on end with joy, spoke these words.

16.49.s:
.. śaniruvāca .. ..
tuṣṭo'haṃ tava rājendra stavenānena suvrata ..
varaṃ brūhi pradāsyāmi svecchayā raghunaṃdana .. 48 .. ..
16.49.d:
.. शनिरुवाच .. ..
तुष्टोऽहं तव राजेन्द्र स्तवेनानेन सुव्रत ..
वरं ब्रूहि प्रदास्यामि स्वेच्छया रघुनंदन .. 48 .. ..
16.49.m:
Śani said:
I am pleased with you, O king of kings, by this hymn of praise, O you of noble vows! / Name a boon according to your own desire; I shall grant it, O delight of the Raghus!

16.49.s:
.. daśaratha uvāca .. ..
adyaprabhṛti piṃgākṣa pīḍā kāryā na kasyacit ..
devāsuramanuṣyāṇāṃ paśupakṣisarīsṛpām .. 49 ..
16.49.d:
.. दशरथ उवाच .. ..
अद्यप्रभृति पिंगाक्ष पीडा कार्या न कस्यचित् ..
देवासुरमनुष्याणां पशुपक्षिसरीसृपाम् .. 49 ..
16.49.m:
Daśaratha said:
From this day forward, O tawny-eyed one, no affliction should be caused to anyone— / to gods, demons, men, beasts, birds, or reptiles!

16.49.s:
.. śaniruvāca .. ..
grahāṇāṃ durgraho jñeyo grahapīḍāṃ karomyaham ..
adeyaṃ prārthitaṃ rājankiṃcidyuktaṃ dadāmyaham .. 7.1.49.50 ..
16.49.d:
.. शनिरुवाच .. ..
ग्रहाणां दुर्ग्रहो ज्ञेयो ग्रहपीडां करोम्यहम् ..
अदेयं प्रार्थितं राजन्किंचिद्युक्तं ददाम्यहम् .. 7.1.49.50 ..
16.49.m:
Śani said:
Know that of all planets I am hard to propitiate; I do cause planetary affliction. / What you have asked cannot be granted, O king; yet I shall grant something suitable.

16.49.s:
tvayā proktaṃ mama stotraṃ ye paṭhi ṣyaṃti mānavāḥ ..
puruṣāśca striyo vāpi madbhayenopapīḍitāḥ .. 51 ..
16.49.d:
त्वया प्रोक्तं मम स्तोत्रं ये पठि ष्यंति मानवाः ..
पुरुषाश्च स्त्रियो वापि मद्भयेनोपपीडिताः .. 51 ..
16.49.m: Those mortals who will recite this hymn of praise to me spoken by you, / whether men or women afflicted with fear of me,

16.49.s:
devāsuramanuṣyāstu siddhavidyādharoragāḥ ..
mṛtyusthāne sthito vāpi janmaprāṃtagatastathā .. 52 ..
16.49.d:
देवासुरमनुष्यास्तु सिद्धविद्याधरोरगाः ..
मृत्युस्थाने स्थितो वापि जन्मप्रांतगतस्तथा .. 52 ..
16.49.m: gods, demons, or humans, siddhas, vidyādharas, or serpents, / even if I am situated in their house of death or positioned at the end of their birth constellation—

16.49.s:
ekakālaṃ dvikālaṃ vā teṣāṃ śreyo dadāmyaham ..
pūjayitvā japetstotraṃ bhūtvā caiva kṛtāṃjaliḥ .. 53 ..
16.49.d:
एककालं द्विकालं वा तेषां श्रेयो ददाम्यहम् ..
पूजयित्वा जपेत्स्तोत्रं भूत्वा चैव कृतांजलिः .. 53 ..
16.49.m: Once or twice a day, I bestow welfare upon them. / Having worshipped and folded their hands, one should recite this hymn. 53

16.49.s:
tasya pīḍāṃ na caivāhamiha kuryāṃ kadācana ..
janmasthāne sthito vāpi mṛtyusthāne sthito'pi ca .. 54 ..
16.49.d:
तस्य पीडां न चैवाहमिह कुर्यां कदाचन ..
जन्मस्थाने स्थितो वापि मृत्युस्थाने स्थितोऽपि च .. 54 ..
16.49.m: I will never cause affliction to him here [in this world], / whether I am situated in the house of birth or in the house of death, 54

16.49.s:
janmaṛkṣe ca lagne ca daśāsvaṃtardaśāsu ca ..
rakṣāmi satataṃ tasya pīḍāṃ cānyagrahasya ca .. 55 ..
16.49.d:
जन्मऋक्षे च लग्ने च दशास्वंतर्दशासु च ..
रक्षामि सततं तस्य पीडां चान्यग्रहस्य च .. 55 ..
16.49.m: or in the birth-constellation, the ascendant, or during planetary periods and sub-periods; / I constantly protect him from affliction by other planets as well. 55

16.49.s:
anenaiva prakāreṇa rpāḍāmuktastvasau bhavet ..
etatproktaṃ mayā dattaṃ varaṃ ca raghunaṃdana .. 56 ..
16.49.d:
अनेनैव प्रकारेण र्पाडामुक्तस्त्वसौ भवेत् ..
एतत्प्रोक्तं मया दत्तं वरं च रघुनंदन .. 56 ..
16.49.m: In this very way he shall become free from affliction. / This boon has been spoken and granted by me, O joy of the Raghu clan! 56

16.49.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
varadvayaṃ ca saṃprāpya rājā daśarathaḥ purā ..
mene kṛtārthamātmānaṃ namaskṛtya śanaiścaram .. 57 ..
16.49.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
वरद्वयं च संप्राप्य राजा दशरथः पुरा ..
मेने कृतार्थमात्मानं नमस्कृत्य शनैश्चरम् .. 57 ..
16.49.m: Īśvara said: / Having obtained the two boons in the past, King Daśaratha / bowed to Śanaiścara and considered himself to have achieved his purpose. 57

16.49.s:
śaniṃ stutvā'bhyanujñāto rathamāruhya vīryavān ..
svasthānaṃ gatavānrājā pūjyamāno divaukasaiḥ .. 58 ..
16.49.d:
शनिं स्तुत्वाऽभ्यनुज्ञातो रथमारुह्य वीर्यवान् ..
स्वस्थानं गतवान्राजा पूज्यमानो दिवौकसैः .. 58 ..
16.49.m: Having praised Śani and received his permission, the heroic king / mounted his chariot and went to his own abode, being worshipped by the heaven-dwellers. 58

16.49.s:
ya idaṃ prātarutthāya saurivāre paṭhennaraḥ ..
sarvagrahodbhavā pīḍā na bhavedbhuvi tasya tu .. 59 ..
16.49.d:
य इदं प्रातरुत्थाय सौरिवारे पठेन्नरः ..
सर्वग्रहोद्भवा पीडा न भवेद्भुवि तस्य तु .. 59 ..
16.49.m: The man who rises early in the morning on Saturday and recites this / shall experience no affliction arising from any planet on earth. 59

16.49.s:
śanaiścaraṃ smareddevaṃ nityaṃ bhaktisamanvitaḥ ..
pūjayitvā paṭhetstotraṃ tasya tuṣyati bhāskariḥ .. 7.1.49.60 ..
16.49.d:
शनैश्चरं स्मरेद्देवं नित्यं भक्तिसमन्वितः ..
पूजयित्वा पठेत्स्तोत्रं तस्य तुष्यति भास्करिः .. 7.1.49.60 ..
16.49.m: One should constantly remember the deity Śanaiścara endowed with devotion. / Having worshipped him, one should recite the hymn; the son of Bhāskara is pleased with him. 60

16.49.s:
iti te kathitaṃ devi māhātmyaṃ śanidaivatam ..
sarvapāpopaśamanaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam .. 61 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathamaṃ prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye śanaiścareśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonapañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 49 .. .. cha ..
16.49.d:
इति ते कथितं देवि माहात्म्यं शनिदैवतम् ..
सर्वपापोपशमनं सर्वकामफलप्रदम् .. 61 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमं प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये शनैश्चरेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकोनपञ्चाशोऽध्यायः .. 49 .. .. छ ..
16.49.m:
Thus the māhātmya dedicated to Śani has been related to you, O goddess, / which subdues all sins and bestows the fruit of all desires. 61
Thus ends the forty-ninth chapter, entitled “Description of the Māhātmya of Śanaiścareśvara,” in the first Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya of the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses]. 49

16.50.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi liṃgaṃ rāhupratiṣṭhitam ..
śanaiścareśvarāddevi vāyavye saṃpratiṣṭhitam .. 1 ..
16.50.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि लिंगं राहुप्रतिष्ठितम् ..
शनैश्चरेश्वराद्देवि वायव्ये संप्रतिष्ठितम् .. 1 ..
16.50.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to the liṅga established by Rāhu, / situated, O goddess, to the northwest of Śanaiścareśvara. 1

16.50.s:
ajādevyāścottarato dhanuṣāṃ saptake sthitam ..
maṃgalāyāḥ samīpasthaṃ nātidūre vyavasthitam .. 2 ..
16.50.d:
अजादेव्याश्चोत्तरतो धनुषां सप्तके स्थितम् ..
मंगलायाः समीपस्थं नातिदूरे व्यवस्थितम् .. 2 ..
16.50.m: It stands to the north of Ajādevī at a distance of seven bows, / situated near Maṅgalā, not very far away. 2

16.50.s:
liṃgaṃ mahāprabhāvaṃ tu saiṃhikeyapratiṣṭhitam ..
tatra varṣasahasraṃ tu vaipracittistapo'karot .. 3 ..
16.50.d:
लिंगं महाप्रभावं तु सैंहिकेयप्रतिष्ठितम् ..
तत्र वर्षसहस्रं तु वैप्रचित्तिस्तपोऽकरोत् .. 3 ..
16.50.m: The liṅga of great power was established by the son of Siṃhikā; / there the son of Vipracitti performed tapas for a thousand years. 3

16.50.s:
svarbhānuḥ sa mahāvīryo vaktrayodhī mahāsurāḥ ..
samārādhya mahādevaṃ divyena tapasā prabhum .. 4 ..
16.50.d:
स्वर्भानुः स महावीर्यो वक्त्रयोधी महासुराः ..
समाराध्य महादेवं दिव्येन तपसा प्रभुम् .. 4 ..
16.50.m: That Svarbhānu of great valor, the great Asura who fights with his mouth, / worshipped the Lord Mahādeva with divine tapas, 4

16.50.s:
liṃge'vatārayāmāsa jagaddīpaṃ maheśvaram ..
yaścainaṃ pūjayedbhaktyā naraḥ samyakca paśyati ..
tasya pāpaṃ kṣayaṃ yāti api brahmavadhodbhavam .. 5 ..
16.50.d:
लिंगेऽवतारयामास जगद्दीपं महेश्वरम् ..
यश्चैनं पूजयेद्भक्त्या नरः सम्यक्च पश्यति ..
तस्य पापं क्षयं याति अपि ब्रह्मवधोद्भवम् .. 5 ..
16.50.m: and caused Maheśvara, the light of the universe, to descend into the liṅga. / And whatever man worships it with devotion and beholds it properly, / his sin is destroyed, even that arisen from the slaying of a brahmin. 5

16.50.s:
nāṃdho na badhiro mūko na rogī na ca nirddhanaḥ ..
kadācijjāyate martyastena dṛṣṭena bhūtale .. 6 ..
16.50.d:
नांधो न बधिरो मूको न रोगी न च निर्द्धनः ..
कदाचिज्जायते मर्त्यस्तेन दृष्टेन भूतले .. 6 ..
16.50.m: When it is beheld on earth, a mortal is never born / blind, deaf, mute, diseased, or destitute. 6

16.50.s:
sukhasaubhāgyasaṃpannastadā bhavati rūpavān ..
sarvakāmasamṛddhātmā modate divi devavat .. 7 ..
16.50.d:
सुखसौभाग्यसंपन्नस्तदा भवति रूपवान् ..
सर्वकामसमृद्धात्मा मोदते दिवि देववत् .. 7 ..
16.50.m: He then becomes endowed with happiness and good fortune, handsome, / his soul enriched with all desires, and he rejoices in heaven like a god. 7

16.50.s:
iti te kathitaṃ devi māhātmyaṃ rāhudaivatam ..
śrutvā tu mohaniryāto naro niṣkalmaṣo bhavet .. 8 ..
16.50.d:
इति ते कथितं देवि माहात्म्यं राहुदैवतम् ..
श्रुत्वा तु मोहनिर्यातो नरो निष्कल्मषो भवेत् .. 8 ..
16.50.m: Thus the māhātmya dedicated to Rāhu has been related to you, O goddess; / having heard it, a man is freed from delusion and becomes stainless. 8

16.50.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye rāhvīśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma paṃcāśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 50 ..
16.50.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये राह्वीश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम पंचाशोऽध्यायः .. 50 ..
16.50.m: Thus ends the fiftieth chapter, entitled “Description of the Māhātmya of Rāhvīśvara,” in the first Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya of the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses]. 50

16.51.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi ketuliṃgaṃ mahāprabham ..
rāhvīśānāduttare ca maṃgalāyāśca dakṣiṇe .. 1 ..
16.51.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि केतुलिंगं महाप्रभम् ..
राह्वीशानादुत्तरे च मंगलायाश्च दक्षिणे .. 1 ..
16.51.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to the Ketu-liṅga of great splendor, / to the north of Rāhvīśāna and to the south of Maṅgalā, 1

16.51.s:
dhanuṣoṃtaramānena nātidūre vyavasthitam ..
liṃgaṃ mahāprabhāvaṃ hi sarvapātakanāśanam .. 2 ..
16.51.d:
धनुषोंतरमानेन नातिदूरे व्यवस्थितम् ..
लिंगं महाप्रभावं हि सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 2 ..
16.51.m: situated at a distance of a bow, not very far away; / it is indeed a liṅga of great power, destroying all wicked deeds. 2

16.51.s:
keturnāma grahotyugraḥ śivasadbhāvabhāvitaḥ ..
vartulo'tīva vistīrṇo locanābhyāṃ subhīṣaṇaḥ .. 3 ..
16.51.d:
केतुर्नाम ग्रहोत्युग्रः शिवसद्भावभावितः ..
वर्तुलोऽतीव विस्तीर्णो लोचनाभ्यां सुभीषणः .. 3 ..
16.51.m: The planet named Ketu is extremely fierce, yet suffused with devotion to Śiva; / he is round, extremely vast, and terrifying to behold with one's eyes. 3

16.51.s:
palāladhūmasaṃkāśo grahapīḍāpahārakaḥ ..
tatrākarottapaścograṃ divyābdānāṃ śataṃ priye .. 4 ..
16.51.d:
पलालधूमसंकाशो ग्रहपीडापहारकः ..
तत्राकरोत्तपश्चोग्रं दिव्याब्दानां शतं प्रिये .. 4 ..
16.51.m: Resembling straw smoke, he removes planetary affliction. / There he performed fierce tapas for a hundred divine years, O beloved. 4

16.51.s:
tasya tuṣṭo mahādevo graha tvaṃ pradadau priye ..
ekādaśaśatānāṃ ca grahāṇāmādhipatyatām .. 5 ..
16.51.d:
तस्य तुष्टो महादेवो ग्रह त्वं प्रददौ प्रिये ..
एकादशशतानां च ग्रहाणामाधिपत्यताम् .. 5 ..
16.51.m: Pleased with him, Mahādeva granted him the status of a planet, O beloved, / and the sovereignty over eleven hundred planets. 5

16.51.s:
tatrasthaṃ pūjayedbhaktyā ketuliṃgaṃ mahāprabham ..
ketūdaye mahāghore tasmindṛṣṭe viśeṣataḥ .. 6 ..
16.51.d:
तत्रस्थं पूजयेद्भक्त्या केतुलिंगं महाप्रभम् ..
केतूदये महाघोरे तस्मिन्दृष्टे विशेषतः .. 6 ..
16.51.m: One should worship with devotion the Ketu-liṅga of great splendor situated there; / especially when it is beheld during the terrible rising of Ketu, 6

16.51.s:
grahapīḍāsu cogrāsu pūjayettaṃ vidhānataḥ ..
puṣpairgaṃdhaistathā dhūpairnaivedyairvividhaiḥ śubhaiḥ .. 7 ..
16.51.d:
ग्रहपीडासु चोग्रासु पूजयेत्तं विधानतः ..
पुष्पैर्गंधैस्तथा धूपैर्नैवेद्यैर्विविधैः शुभैः .. 7 ..
16.51.m: and during fierce planetary afflictions, one should worship it according to the rule / with flowers, scents, incenses, and various auspicious food offerings. 7
One should duly propitiate the god Ketu, the destroyer of sins. 8

16.51.s:
iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ ketuliṃgaṃ mahodayam ..
grahapīḍopaśamanaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam .. 9 ..
16.51.d:
इति संक्षेपतः प्रोक्तं केतुलिंगं महोदयम् ..
ग्रहपीडोपशमनं सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 9 ..
16.51.m: Thus has been briefly described the Ketu-liṅga of great fortune, / which pacifies planetary affliction and destroys all sins. 9

16.51.s:
etāni nava liṃgāni grahāṇāṃ kathitāni te ..
yaḥ paśyati naro nityaṃ tasya pīḍābhayaṃ kutaḥ .. 7.1.51.10 ..
16.51.d:
एतानि नव लिंगानि ग्रहाणां कथितानि ते ..
यः पश्यति नरो नित्यं तस्य पीडाभयं कुतः .. 7.1.51.10 ..
16.51.m: These nine liṅgas of the planets have been told to you; / for the man who sees them daily, whence can there be fear of affliction? 10

16.51.s:
na daurbhāgyaṃ kule tasya na rogī naiva duḥkhitaḥ ..
jāyate putravaddevi taṃ rakṣaṃti mahāgrahāḥ .. 11 ..
16.51.d:
न दौर्भाग्यं कुले तस्य न रोगी नैव दुःखितः ..
जायते पुत्रवद्देवि तं रक्षंति महाग्रहाः .. 11 ..
16.51.m: In his family no one is born unfortunate, diseased, or sorrowful; / the great planets protect him like a son, O goddess. 11

16.51.s:
iti te kathitaṃ samyakcaturdaśāyatanaṃ priye ..
vighneśvaraṃ samārabhya yāvatketupratiṣṭhitam .. 12 ..
16.51.d:
इति ते कथितं सम्यक्चतुर्दशायतनं प्रिये ..
विघ्नेश्वरं समारभ्य यावत्केतुप्रतिष्ठितम् .. 12 ..
16.51.m: Thus, O beloved, the fourteen sanctuaries have been described to you properly, / beginning with Vighneśvara and ending with the one established by Ketu. 12

16.51.s:
navagraheśvarāṇāṃ tu māhātmyaṃ pāpanāśanam ..
tathaiva paṃcaliṃgānāṃ śrutvā pāpaiḥ pramucyate .. 13 ..
16.51.d:
नवग्रहेश्वराणां तु माहात्म्यं पापनाशनम् ..
तथैव पंचलिंगानां श्रुत्वा पापैः प्रमुच्यते .. 13 ..
16.51.m: Having heard the māhātmya of the Navagraheśvaras, which destroys sin, / and likewise that of the five liṅgas, one is freed from sins. 13

16.51.s:
kaparddinaṃ samārabhya caṃḍanāthāṃtakāni ca ..
paṃcaiva mudrāliṃgāni nāpuṇyo veda mānavaḥ .. 14 ..
16.51.d:
कपर्द्दिनं समारभ्य चंडनाथांतकानि च ..
पंचैव मुद्रालिंगानि नापुण्यो वेद मानवः .. 14 ..
16.51.m: No unmeritorious man knows the five Mudrā-liṅgas / beginning with Kapardin and ending with Caṇḍanātha. 14

16.51.s:
sūryeśvaraṃ samārabhya ketuliṃgāṃtakāni vai ..
navagrahāṇāṃ liṃgāni nānyo jānāti kaścana .. 15 ..
16.51.d:
सूर्येश्वरं समारभ्य केतुलिंगांतकानि वै ..
नवग्रहाणां लिंगानि नान्यो जानाति कश्चन .. 15 ..
16.51.m: No one else knows the liṅgas of the nine planets / beginning with Sūryeśvara and ending with the Ketu-liṅga. 15

16.51.s:
caturdaśavidhā tvevaṃ proktā''yatanasaṃgatiḥ ..
yaścaināṃ veda bhāvena sa kṣetraphalamaśnute .. 16 ..
16.51.d:
चतुर्दशविधा त्वेवं प्रोक्ता'ऽयतनसंगतिः ..
यश्चैनां वेद भावेन स क्षेत्रफलमश्नुते .. 16 ..
16.51.m: Thus has the group of fourteen sanctuaries been declared; / and whoever knows this with devotion enjoys the fruit of the sacred field. 16

16.51.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye ketvīśvaramāhātmyavarṇananāmaikapaṃcāśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 51 ..
16.51.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये केत्वीश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णननामैकपंचाशोऽध्यायः .. 51 ..
16.51.m: Thus ends the fifty-first chapter, entitled “Description of the Māhātmya of Ketvīśvara,” in the first Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya of the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses]. 51

16.52.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
paṃcātha siddhaliṃgāni kathayāmi yaśasvini ..
yeṣāṃ darśanato devi siddhā yātrā bhavennṛṇām .. 1 ..
16.52.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
पंचाथ सिद्धलिंगानि कथयामि यशस्विनि ..
येषां दर्शनतो देवि सिद्धा यात्रा भवेन्नृणाम् .. 1 ..
16.52.m: Īśvara said: / Next, O renowned one, I will tell of the five Siddha-liṅgas, / by the darśana of which, O goddess, the pilgrimage of men becomes successful. 1

16.52.s:
someśādīśadigbhāge varāroheti yā smṛtā ..
tasyāśca pūrvadigbhāge devaṃ siddheśvaraṃ param ..
abhigamya naro bhaktyā aṇimādikamāpnuyāt .. 2 ..
16.52.d:
सोमेशादीशदिग्भागे वरारोहेति या स्मृता ..
तस्याश्च पूर्वदिग्भागे देवं सिद्धेश्वरं परम् ..
अभिगम्य नरो भक्त्या अणिमादिकमाप्नुयात् .. 2 ..
16.52.m: To the northeast of Someśa is the one remembered as Varārohā; / and approaching with devotion the supreme deity Siddheśvara to the east of her, / a man attains [the perfections of] Aṇimā and the rest. 2

16.52.s:
siddhaiḥ pratiṣṭhitaṃ liṃgaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhaktyā tu mānavaḥ ..
mucyate pātakaiḥ sarvaiḥ siddhalokaṃ sa gacchati .. 3 ..
16.52.d:
सिद्धैः प्रतिष्ठितं लिंगं दृष्ट्वा भक्त्या तु मानवः ..
मुच्यते पातकैः सर्वैः सिद्धलोकं स गच्छति .. 3 ..
16.52.m: Having seen with devotion the liṅga established by the Siddhas, / a man is freed from all sins and goes to the realm of the Siddhas. 3

16.52.s:
vighnāni nāśamāyāṃti tatra kṣetranivāsinām ..
kāmaḥ krodho bhaya lobho rāgo matsara eva ca .. 4 ..
16.52.d:
विघ्नानि नाशमायांति तत्र क्षेत्रनिवासिनाम् ..
कामः क्रोधो भय लोभो रागो मत्सर एव च .. 4 ..
16.52.m: Obstacles come to destruction for those dwelling in that sacred field: / desire, anger, fear, greed, passion, and malice, 4

16.52.s:
īrṣyā daṃbhastathā''lasyaṃ nidrā mohastvahaṃkṛtiḥ ..
etāni vighnarūpāṇi siddhervighnakarāṇi tu .. 5 ..
16.52.d:
ईर्ष्या दंभस्तथा'ऽलस्यं निद्रा मोहस्त्वहंकृतिः ..
एतानि विघ्नरूपाणि सिद्धेर्विघ्नकराणि तु .. 5 ..
16.52.m: jealousy, hypocrisy, laziness, sleep, delusion, and egotism— / these obstacles that cause hindrances to perfection. 5

16.52.s:
tāni nāśaṃ samāyāṃti tatra siddhe śvarārcanāt ..
evaṃ jñātvā tu yatnena tatra yātrāṃ samācaret .. 6 ..
16.52.d:
तानि नाशं समायांति तत्र सिद्धे श्वरार्चनात् ..
एवं ज्ञात्वा तु यत्नेन तत्र यात्रां समाचरेत् .. 6 ..
16.52.m: They come to destruction there by the worship of Siddheśvara. / Knowing this, one should diligently make a pilgrimage there. // 6

16.52.s:
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ devi siddheśvaramahodayam..
sarvakāmapradaṃ nṛṇāṃ śrutaṃ pātakanāśanam .. 7 ..
16.52.d:
इत्येवं कथितं देवि सिद्धेश्वरमहोदयम्..
सर्वकामप्रदं नृणां श्रुतं पातकनाशनम् .. 7 ..
16.52.m: Thus has the great exalted power of Siddheśvara been told, O goddess; / granting all desires to men, it destroys sin when heard. // 7

16.52.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye siddheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvipañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 52 ..
16.52.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये सिद्धेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम द्विपञ्चाशत्तमोऽध्यायः .. 52 ..
16.52.m: Thus ends the fifty-second chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Siddheśvara', in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, an eighty-one-thousand-verse compendium. // 52

16.53.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi kapileśvaramuttamam..
tasyaiva pūrvadigbhāge nātidūre vyava sthitam .. 1 ..
16.53.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि कपिलेश्वरमुत्तमम्..
तस्यैव पूर्वदिग्भागे नातिदूरे व्यव स्थितम् .. 1 ..
16.53.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the excellent Kapileśvara, / situated in its eastern quarter, not very far away, // 1

16.53.s:
liṃgaṃ mahāprabhāvaṃ tu darśanātpāpanāśanam ..
kapilonāma rājarṣiryatra taptvā mahātapaḥ .. 2 ..
16.53.d:
लिंगं महाप्रभावं तु दर्शनात्पापनाशनम् ..
कपिलोनाम राजर्षिर्यत्र तप्त्वा महातपः .. 2 ..
16.53.m: a liṅga of great power that destroys sins upon darśana, / where the royal seer named Kapila, having performed great tapas, // 2

16.53.s:
saṃprāptaḥ paramāṃ siddhiṃ pratiṣṭhāpya maheśvaram ..
devasāṃnidhyamīśānaṃ tasmim̐lliṃge sadā hariḥ .. 3 ..
16.53.d:
संप्राप्तः परमां सिद्धिं प्रतिष्ठाप्य महेश्वरम् ..
देवसांनिध्यमीशानं तस्मिम्̐ल्लिंगे सदा हरिः .. 3 ..
16.53.m: attained the supreme perfection after installing Maheśvara. / The presence of the god, Īśāna, is always in that liṅga, [as is] Hari. // 3

16.53.s:
śuklapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ sarvalokahitārthataḥ ..
saptakṛtvo mahādevaṃ someśaṃ kapileśvaram..
yaḥ paśyetprayato bhūtvā sa godānaphalaṃ labhet .. 4 ..
16.53.d:
शुक्लपक्षे चतुर्दश्यां सर्वलोकहितार्थतः ..
सप्तकृत्वो महादेवं सोमेशं कपिलेश्वरम्..
यः पश्येत्प्रयतो भूत्वा स गोदानफलं लभेत् .. 4 ..
16.53.m: On the fourteenth day of the bright fortnight, for the benefit of all worlds, / he who, having become restrained, beholds Mahādeva, Someśa, [and] Kapileśvara seven times, obtains the fruit of gifting cows. // 4

16.53.s:
tiladhenuṃ ca yo dadyāttasmiṃstīrthe samāhitaḥ ..
tilasaṃkhyāyugānyeva sa svarge vasati priye .. 5 ..
16.53.d:
तिलधेनुं च यो दद्यात्तस्मिंस्तीर्थे समाहितः ..
तिलसंख्यायुगान्येव स स्वर्गे वसति प्रिये .. 5 ..
16.53.m: And he who, concentrated in mind, gives a cow made of sesame seeds at that sacred ford, / dwells in heaven, O beloved, for as many yugas as the number of sesame seeds. // 5

16.53.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kapileśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma tripañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 53 ..
16.53.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये कपिलेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम त्रिपञ्चाशोऽध्यायः .. 53 ..
16.53.m: Thus ends the fifty-third chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Kapileśvara', in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, an eighty-one-thousand-verse compendium. // 53

16.54.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi gaṃdharveśvaramuttamam ..
daṇḍapāṇestu bhavanāduttare nikaṭe sthitam..1..
16.54.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि गंधर्वेश्वरमुत्तमम् ..
दण्डपाणेस्तु भवनादुत्तरे निकटे स्थितम्..1..
16.54.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the excellent Gandharveśvara, / situated near the north of Daṇḍapāṇi's abode, // 1

16.54.s:
yatra gaṃdharvarājo vai ghanavāheti viśrutaḥ..
tasya gaṃdharvaseneti khyātā putrī mahāprabhā..2..
16.54.d:
यत्र गंधर्वराजो वै घनवाहेति विश्रुतः..
तस्य गंधर्वसेनेति ख्याता पुत्री महाप्रभा..2..
16.54.m: where indeed there was a king of gandharvas famous as Ghanavāha; / he had a daughter of great splendor renowned as Gandharvasenā. // 2

16.54.s:
śikhaṃḍinā gaṇenaiva sā śaptā rūpagarvitā..
tato gośṛṃgaṛṣiṇā dattastasyā anugrahaḥ..3..
16.54.d:
शिखंडिना गणेनैव सा शप्ता रूपगर्विता..
ततो गोशृंगऋषिणा दत्तस्तस्या अनुग्रहः..3..
16.54.m: She, proud of her beauty, was cursed by the attendant Śikhaṇḍin; / then a favor was granted to her by the seer Gośṛṅga, // 3

16.54.s:
somavāravratenaiva someśārādhanaṃ prati..
tataḥ kṣetraṃ samāgatya tapaḥ kṛtvā suduścaram..4..
16.54.d:
सोमवारव्रतेनैव सोमेशाराधनं प्रति..
ततः क्षेत्रं समागत्य तपः कृत्वा सुदुश्चरम्..4..
16.54.m: directing her to the worship of Someśa by means of the Monday vow. / Then, having come to the sacred field and performed very arduous tapas, // 4

16.54.s:
liṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhayāmāsa tatra gaṃdharvarāṭ svayam..
tathaiva putryā tasyaiva tatra liṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhitam..5..
16.54.d:
लिंगं प्रतिष्ठयामास तत्र गंधर्वराट् स्वयम्..
तथैव पुत्र्या तस्यैव तत्र लिंगं प्रतिष्ठितम्..5..
16.54.m: the king of gandharvas himself installed a liṅga there; / likewise, a liṅga was installed there by his daughter. // 5

16.54.s:
atha tatraiva deveśi daṃḍapāṇeḥ samīpataḥ ..
ghanavāheśvaraṃ nāma yo liṃgaṃ yatnato'rcayet .. 6 ..
16.54.d:
अथ तत्रैव देवेशि दंडपाणेः समीपतः ..
घनवाहेश्वरं नाम यो लिंगं यत्नतोऽर्चयेत् .. 6 ..
16.54.m: Now, whoever diligently worships the liṅga named Ghanavāheśvara / right there near Daṇḍapāṇi, O ruler of the gods, // 6

16.54.s:
gaṃdharvalokamāpnoti dṛṣṭvā sa prayataḥ śuciḥ ..
iti te kathitaṃ devi gāṃdharvaṃ liṃgamuttamam .. 7 ..
16.54.d:
गंधर्वलोकमाप्नोति दृष्ट्वा स प्रयतः शुचिः ..
इति ते कथितं देवि गांधर्वं लिंगमुत्तमम् .. 7 ..
16.54.m: and, restrained and pure, beholds it, attains the world of the gandharvas. / Thus has the excellent liṅga of the gandharvas been told to you, O goddess. // 7

16.54.s:
tṛtīyaṃ sarvapāpānāṃ nāśanaṃ puṇyavarddhanam ..
agnitīrthe naraḥ snātvā pūjya gaṃdharvapūjitam .. 8 ..
16.54.d:
तृतीयं सर्वपापानां नाशनं पुण्यवर्द्धनम् ..
अग्नितीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा पूज्य गंधर्वपूजितम् .. 8 ..
16.54.m: The third [liṅga] destroys all sins and increases merit. / A person, having bathed in the Agnitīrtha and worshipped [the liṅga] worshipped by the gandharva, // 8

16.54.s:
ayane cottare prāpte nirvāṇamadhigacchati ..
śrutvā 'bhinaṃdya māhātmyaṃ mucyate mahato bhayāt .. 9 ..
16.54.d:
अयने चोत्तरे प्राप्ते निर्वाणमधिगच्छति ..
श्रुत्वा ऽभिनंद्य माहात्म्यं मुच्यते महतो भयात् .. 9 ..
16.54.m: attains nirvāṇa when the northern course of the sun arrives. / Having heard and applauded its māhātmya, one is released from great fear. // 9

16.54.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetra māhātmye gandharveśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catuḥpaṃcāśo'dhyāyaḥ..54..
16.54.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्र माहात्म्ये गन्धर्वेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम चतुःपंचाशोऽध्यायः..54..
16.54.m: Thus ends the fifty-fourth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Gandharveśvara', in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, an eighty-one-thousand-verse compendium. // 54

16.55.s:
īśvara uvāca..
tato gacchenmahādevi tatpūrve vimaleśvaram..
gauryāḥ pūrvaṃ samīpasthaṃ nātidūre vyavasthitam..1..
16.55.d:
ईश्वर उवाच..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि तत्पूर्वे विमलेश्वरम्..
गौर्याः पूर्वं समीपस्थं नातिदूरे व्यवस्थितम्..1..
