16.55.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to Vimaleśvara to the east of that, / situated near the east of Gaurī, not very far away, // 1

16.55.s:
gurornairṛtyadigbhāge sthitaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam..
api kṛtvā mahāpāpaṃ nārī vā puruṣo'pi vā .. 2 ..
16.55.d:
गुरोर्नैरृत्यदिग्भागे स्थितं पापप्रणाशनम्..
अपि कृत्वा महापापं नारी वा पुरुषोऽपि वा .. 2 ..
16.55.m: standing in the south-western quarter from Guru, destroying sins. / Even if having committed a great sin, a woman or a man, // 2

16.55.s:
kṣayābhibhūtadeho vā taṃ samabhyarcya bhaktitaḥ ..
sarvaduḥkhāntago bhūtvā nirmalaṃ padamāpnuyāt .. 3 ..
16.55.d:
क्षयाभिभूतदेहो वा तं समभ्यर्च्य भक्तितः ..
सर्वदुःखान्तगो भूत्वा निर्मलं पदमाप्नुयात् .. 3 ..
16.55.m: or one whose body is overwhelmed by consumption, by worshipping it with devotion, / puts an end to all sorrows and attains the stainless state. // 3

16.55.s:
gaṃdharvasenā yatraiva vimalā'bhūtkṣayā nvitā ..
vimaleśvaranāmnā vai talliṃgaṃ prathitaṃ kṣitau .. 4 ..
16.55.d:
गंधर्वसेना यत्रैव विमलाऽभूत्क्षया न्विता ..
विमलेश्वरनाम्ना वै तल्लिंगं प्रथितं क्षितौ .. 4 ..
16.55.m: Where Gandharvasenā, afflicted by consumption, became spotless, / that liṅga became renowned on earth by the name Vimaleśvara. // 4

16.55.s:
iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ vimaleśvarasūcakam ..
māhātmyaṃ sarvapāpaghnaṃ turīyaṃ bhavasundari .. 5 ..
16.55.d:
इति ते कथितं सर्वं विमलेश्वरसूचकम् ..
माहात्म्यं सर्वपापघ्नं तुरीयं भवसुन्दरि .. 5 ..
16.55.m: Thus all that indicates Vimaleśvara has been told to you, / the fourth māhātmya destroying all sins, O beauty of the world! // 5

16.55.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye vimaleśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcapañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 55 ..
16.55.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये विमलेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम पञ्चपञ्चाशोऽध्यायः .. 55 ..
16.55.m: Thus ends the fifty-fifth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Vimaleśvara', in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, an eighty-one-thousand-verse compendium. // 55

16.56.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
atha te paṃcamaṃ vacmi siddhaligaṃ mahāprabham ..
brahmaṇo nairṛte bhāge dhanuṣāṃ ṣoḍaśe sthitam .. 1 ..
16.56.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
अथ ते पंचमं वच्मि सिद्धलिगं महाप्रभम् ..
ब्रह्मणो नैरृते भागे धनुषां षोडशे स्थितम् .. 1 ..
16.56.m: Īśvara said: / Now I shall tell you of the fifth perfected liṅga of great splendor, / situated in the south-western quarter from Brahmā at [a distance of] sixteen bow-lengths, // 1

16.56.s:
rāhuliṃgasya cābhyāśe liṃgaṃ dhanadanirmitam ..
dhanadatvaṃ ca saṃprāpto yatra taptvā mahattapaḥ .. 2 ..
16.56.d:
राहुलिंगस्य चाभ्याशे लिंगं धनदनिर्मितम् ..
धनदत्वं च संप्राप्तो यत्र तप्त्वा महत्तपः .. 2 ..
16.56.m: near the liṅga of Rāhu, the liṅga fashioned by Dhanada, / where, having performed great tapas, he attained the status of Dhanada. // 2

16.56.s:
saṃsthāpya vidhivatpūjya liṃgaṃ varṣasahasrakam ..
alakādhipatirjātastatra śaṃbhoḥ prasādataḥ .. 3 ..
16.56.d:
संस्थाप्य विधिवत्पूज्य लिंगं वर्षसहस्रकम् ..
अलकाधिपतिर्जातस्तत्र शंभोः प्रसादतः .. 3 ..
16.56.m: Having established and worshipped the liṅga according to rule for a thousand years, / he became the lord of Alakā there by the grace of Śambhu. // 3

16.56.s:
jātiṃ smṛtvā pūrvikāṃ tu jñātvā dīpadaśāphalam ..
śivarātre prabhāvaṃ tu prabhāsaṃ punarāgataḥ .. 4 ..
16.56.d:
जातिं स्मृत्वा पूर्विकां तु ज्ञात्वा दीपदशाफलम् ..
शिवरात्रे प्रभावं तु प्रभासं पुनरागतः .. 4 ..
16.56.m: Remembering his former birth and knowing the fruit of the lamp's wick, / and the power of Śivarātri, he came again to Prabhāsa. // 4

16.56.s:
prabhāvātiśayaṃ jñātvā sthāpayāmāsa śaṃkaram ..
tatra pratyakṣatāṃ nītastapasā yena śaṃkaraḥ .. 5 ..
16.56.d:
प्रभावातिशयं ज्ञात्वा स्थापयामास शंकरम् ..
तत्र प्रत्यक्षतां नीतस्तपसा येन शंकरः .. 5 ..
16.56.m: Knowing the extraordinary power, he installed Śaṃkara, / by whom Śaṃkara was made manifest there through tapas, // 5

16.56.s:
mahābhaktyā mahādevi tasmim̐lliṃge'vatāritaḥ ..
taṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavo bhaktyā pūjayitvā yathāvidhi .. 6 ..
16.56.d:
महाभक्त्या महादेवि तस्मिम्̐ल्लिंगेऽवतारितः ..
तं दृष्ट्वा मानवो भक्त्या पूजयित्वा यथाविधि .. 6 ..
16.56.m: and brought down into that liṅga with great devotion, O great goddess. / Seeing it with devotion, a human being, having worshipped it according to rule // 6

16.56.s:
pañcopacāraiḥ sadbhaktyā gandhadhūpānulepanaiḥ ..
tasyānvaye daridraśca kadāpi na bhaviṣyati .. 7 ..
16.56.d:
पञ्चोपचारैः सद्भक्त्या गन्धधूपानुलेपनैः ..
तस्यान्वये दरिद्रश्च कदापि न भविष्यति .. 7 ..
16.56.m: with fivefold offerings, with true devotion, with scents, incense, and ointments— / in his lineage, no one will ever be poor. // 7

16.56.s:
ye caitatpūjayiṣyaṃti liṃgaṃ bhaktiyutā narāḥ ..
ajeyāste bhaviṣyaṃti śatrūṇāṃ darpanāśanāḥ .. 8 ..
16.56.d:
ये चैतत्पूजयिष्यंति लिंगं भक्तियुता नराः ..
अजेयास्ते भविष्यंति शत्रूणां दर्पनाशनाः .. 8 ..
16.56.m: And those men endowed with devotion who will worship this liṅga / will become invincible, destroyers of their enemies' pride. // 8

16.56.s:
iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ dhanadeśamahodayam ..
śrutvānumodya yatnena daridro naiva jāyate .. 9 ..
16.56.d:
इति ते कथितं सर्वं धनदेशमहोदयम् ..
श्रुत्वानुमोद्य यत्नेन दरिद्रो नैव जायते .. 9 ..
16.56.m: Thus all the great power of Dhanadeśa has been told to you; / having heard and approved it with effort, one never becomes poor. // 9

16.56.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye dhanadeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭpañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 56 ..
16.56.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये धनदेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षट्पञ्चाशोऽध्यायः .. 56 ..
16.56.m: Thus ends the fifty-sixth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Dhanadeśvara', in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, an eighty-one-thousand-verse compendium. // 56

16.57.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
paṃcaivaṃ siddhaliṃgāni kathitāni tava priye ..
yaścainaṃ veda saṃketaṃ kṣetravāsī sa ucyate .. 1 ..
16.57.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
पंचैवं सिद्धलिंगानि कथितानि तव प्रिये ..
यश्चैनं वेद संकेतं क्षेत्रवासी स उच्यते .. 1 ..
16.57.m: Īśvara said: / Thus the five perfected liṅgas have been told to you, O beloved. / And he who knows this secret is called a dweller in the sacred field. // 1

16.57.s:
atha śaktitrayāṇāṃ te raudrīṇāṃ vacmi vistaram ..
icchā kriyājñānaśaktyastisrastāḥ parikīrttitāḥ .. 2 ..
16.57.d:
अथ शक्तित्रयाणां ते रौद्रीणां वच्मि विस्तरम् ..
इच्छा क्रियाज्ञानशक्त्यस्तिस्रस्ताः परिकीर्त्तिताः .. 2 ..
16.57.m: Now I shall tell you in detail about the three Rudra powers; / they are proclaimed as the three powers of will, action, and knowledge. // 2

16.57.s:
punastāsāṃ pūjanāyānukramaṃ kramataḥ śṛṇu ..
caturdaśa tathā paṃca pūrvamuktāni yāni tu .. 3 ....
16.57.d:
पुनस्तासां पूजनायानुक्रमं क्रमतः शृणु ..
चतुर्दश तथा पंच पूर्वमुक्तानि यानि तु .. 3 ....
16.57.m: Hear further the sequence for their worship in proper order: / those fourteen and five which were mentioned before— // 3

16.57.s:
catvāri trīṇi caikaṃ vā yathāśaktyābhipūjya ca ..
liṃgāni tāni saṃpūjya śaktīstisrastato'rcayet .. 4 ..
16.57.d:
चत्वारि त्रीणि चैकं वा यथाशक्त्याभिपूज्य च ..
लिंगानि तानि संपूज्य शक्तीस्तिस्रस्ततोऽर्चयेत् .. 4 ..
16.57.m: having worshipped four, three, or one according to one's ability, / having worshipped those liṅgas, one should then worship the three powers. // 4

16.57.s:
someśādīśadigbhāge varāroheti yā smṛtā ..
amā kalā sā somasya umā paścātprakīrttitā ..5..
16.57.d:
सोमेशादीशदिग्भागे वरारोहेति या स्मृता ..
अमा कला सा सोमस्य उमा पश्चात्प्रकीर्त्तिता ..5..
16.57.m: She who is remembered as Varārohā in the north-eastern quarter from Someśa, / is that amā digit of the moon; later she was proclaimed as Umā. // 5

16.57.s:
icchāśaktistu sā jñeyāprabhāsakṣetrasaṃsthitā ..
tatra devi hitārthāya sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ bhuvi .. 6 ..
16.57.d:
इच्छाशक्तिस्तु सा ज्ञेयाप्रभासक्षेत्रसंस्थिता ..
तत्र देवि हितार्थाय सर्वेषां प्राणिनां भुवि .. 6 ..
16.57.m: She should be known as the power of will (icchāśakti), situated in the Prabhāsa sacred field, / there, O goddess, for the benefit of all living beings on earth. (6)

16.57.s:
tasyā māhātmyamakhilaṃ kathayāmi tavādhunā ..
purā somena tyaktābhirbhāryābhistu varānane .. 7 ..
16.57.d:
तस्या माहात्म्यमखिलं कथयामि तवाधुना ..
पुरा सोमेन त्यक्ताभिर्भार्याभिस्तु वरानने .. 7 ..
16.57.m: I shall now relate her entire māhātmya to you. / Formerly, O fair-faced one, by the wives abandoned by Soma, (7)

16.57.s:
ṣaḍviṃśadbhistapastaptaṃ kṣetre prābhāsike śubhe ..
gaurī sā''rādhyamānātha divyavarṣagaṇānbahūn .. 8 ..
16.57.d:
षड्विंशद्भिस्तपस्तप्तं क्षेत्रे प्राभासिके शुभे ..
गौरी सा'ऽराध्यमानाथ दिव्यवर्षगणान्बहून् .. 8 ..
16.57.m: twenty-six [in number], austerity was performed in the auspicious sacred field of Prabhāsa. / Gaurī was then worshipped by them for many divine years. (8)

16.57.s:
tāsāṃ pratyakṣatāṃ prāptā pārvatī parameśvarī ..
uvāca varadā brūta yadvo manasi saṃsthitam .. 9 ..
16.57.d:
तासां प्रत्यक्षतां प्राप्ता पार्वती परमेश्वरी ..
उवाच वरदा ब्रूत यद्वो मनसि संस्थितम् .. 9 ..
16.57.m: Pārvatī, the supreme sovereign, became visible to them, / and, the granter of boons, said: “Speak what is in your heart.” (9)

16.57.s:
atha tāścābruvandevi yadi tuṣṭāsi pārvati ..
saubhāgyaṃ dehi no bhūri lāvaṇyaṃ paramaṃ tathā .. 7.1.57.10 ..
16.57.d:
अथ ताश्चाब्रुवन्देवि यदि तुष्टासि पार्वति ..
सौभाग्यं देहि नो भूरि लावण्यं परमं तथा .. 7.1.57.10 ..
16.57.m: Then they said: “O goddess, if you are pleased, O Pārvatī, / grant us abundant good fortune and supreme loveliness. (10)

16.57.s:
tyaktāḥ sarvā vayaṃ devi nirdoṣāḥ svāminā śubhe ..
daurbhāgyadoṣasaṃdagdhā daurbhāgyeṇa tu pīḍitāḥ .. 11 ..
16.57.d:
त्यक्ताः सर्वा वयं देवि निर्दोषाः स्वामिना शुभे ..
दौर्भाग्यदोषसंदग्धा दौर्भाग्येण तु पीडिताः .. 11 ..
16.57.m: We have all been abandoned, O goddess, though guiltless, by our husband, O auspicious one; / burned by the fault of misfortune and afflicted with bad luck.” (11)

16.57.s:
.. gauryuvāca .. ..
adyaprabhṛti sarvā vaḥ samaṃ drakṣyati rātripaḥ ..
prasādānmama cārvaṃgyo naitanmithyā bhaviṣyati .. 12 ..
16.57.d:
.. गौर्युवाच .. ..
अद्यप्रभृति सर्वा वः समं द्रक्ष्यति रात्रिपः ..
प्रसादान्मम चार्वंग्यो नैतन्मिथ्या भविष्यति .. 12 ..
16.57.m: Gaurī said: / “From this day forward, the lord of the night will look upon you all equally. / By my grace, O fair-limbed ones, this will not prove false. (12)

16.57.s:
varadā ceti mannāma varadānādbhaviṣyati ..
ihāgatya tu yā nārī pūjayiṣyati māṃ śubhām .. 13 ..
16.57.d:
वरदा चेति मन्नाम वरदानाद्भविष्यति ..
इहागत्य तु या नारी पूजयिष्यति मां शुभाम् .. 13 ..
16.57.m: And ‘Varadā’ (‘Giver of Boons’) will be my name, due to granting this boon. / A woman who comes here and worships me, the auspicious one, (13)

16.57.s:
na daurbhāgyaṃ kule tasyāḥ kvacitprāpsyaṃti yoṣitaḥ ..
māghamāse tṛtīyāyāmupavāsaparāyaṇā .. 14 ..
16.57.d:
न दौर्भाग्यं कुले तस्याः क्वचित्प्राप्स्यंति योषितः ..
माघमासे तृतीयायामुपवासपरायणा .. 14 ..
16.57.m: the women in her family will never incur misfortune anywhere. / Dedicated to fasting on the third lunar day in the month of Māgha, (14)

16.57.s:
yā māṃ drakṣyati suśroṇī mattulyā sā bhavi ṣyati ..
dampatī ṣoḍaśaivātra paridhāpya prayatnataḥ .. 15 ..
16.57.d:
या मां द्रक्ष्यति सुश्रोणी मत्तुल्या सा भवि ष्यति ..
दम्पती षोडशैवात्र परिधाप्य प्रयत्नतः .. 15 ..
16.57.m: whichever woman of fair hips sees me will become equal to me. / Having attentively clothed sixteen married couples here, (15)

16.57.s:
phalāni bhakṣyabhojyaṃ ca pakvānnāni ca ṣoḍaśa ..
yā pradāsyati vai nārī sā tūmaiva bhaviṣyati .. 16 ..
16.57.d:
फलानि भक्ष्यभोज्यं च पक्वान्नानि च षोडश ..
या प्रदास्यति वै नारी सा तूमैव भविष्यति .. 16 ..
16.57.m: whatever woman offers fruits, eatables, foods, and sixteen cooked dishes, / she indeed will become Umā herself. (16)

16.57.s:
etadgaurīvrataṃnāma tṛtīyāyāṃ tu kārayet ..
aprasūtā ca yā nārī yā nārī durbhagā bhavet .. 17 ..
16.57.d:
एतद्गौरीव्रतंनाम तृतीयायां तु कारयेत् ..
अप्रसूता च या नारी या नारी दुर्भगा भवेत् .. 17 ..
16.57.m: One should perform this known as the Gaurīvrata on the third [lunar day]. / A woman who has not borne children, and a woman who is unfortunate, (17)

16.57.s:
pumānasakṛdapyaivaṃ kṛtvā prāpsyatyabhīpsitam ..
evamuktvā sthitā tatra sā devī cārulocanā .. 18 ..
16.57.d:
पुमानसकृदप्यैवं कृत्वा प्राप्स्यत्यभीप्सितम् ..
एवमुक्त्वा स्थिता तत्र सा देवी चारुलोचना .. 18 ..
16.57.m: or a man, having performed it even once, will obtain the desired [result].” / Having spoken thus, that goddess of beautiful eyes remained there. (18)

16.57.s:
paśyate rātrināthaśca sarvāstā rohiṇīṃ yathā ..
anyāpi duḥkhasaṃdagdhā daurbhāgyeṇa tu pīḍitā .. 19 ..
16.57.d:
पश्यते रात्रिनाथश्च सर्वास्ता रोहिणीं यथा ..
अन्यापि दुःखसंदग्धा दौर्भाग्येण तु पीडिता .. 19 ..
16.57.m: And the lord of the night beholds them all, just like Rohiṇī. / Another woman too, burned by sorrow and afflicted with misfortune, (19)

16.57.s:
apūjayadumāṃ devīṃ subhagā sā'bhavattataḥ ..
iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ māhātmyaṃ śaktisaṃbhavam .. 7.1.57.20 ..
16.57.d:
अपूजयदुमां देवीं सुभगा साऽभवत्ततः ..
इति संक्षेपतः प्रोक्तं माहात्म्यं शक्तिसंभवम् .. 7.1.57.20 ..
16.57.m: worshipped the goddess Umā, and thereupon became fortunate. / Thus, in brief, has been declared the māhātmya arising from the Śakti; (20)

16.57.s:
someśvare varārohā nāmeti kathitaṃ tava ..
sarvapāpakṣayakaraṃ sarvadāridryanāśanam .. 21 ..
16.57.d:
सोमेश्वरे वरारोहा नामेति कथितं तव ..
सर्वपापक्षयकरं सर्वदारिद्र्यनाशनम् .. 21 ..
16.57.m: named Varārohā at Someśvara, it has been recounted to you, / causing the destruction of all sins and bringing an end to all poverty. (21)

16.57.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye varārohāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptapaṃcāśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 57 ..
16.57.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये वरारोहामाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम सप्तपंचाशोऽध्यायः .. 57 ..
16.57.m: Thus ends the fifty-seventh chapter, named ‘Description of the Māhātmya of Varārohā’, in the first Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya of the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses]. (57)

16.58.s:
īśvara uvāca .. ..
atha dvitīyāṃ te vacmi śaktiṃ devi kriyātmikām ..
prabhāsasthāṃ mahādevīṃ devānāṃ prītidāyinīm .. 1 ..
16.58.d:
ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
अथ द्वितीयां ते वच्मि शक्तिं देवि क्रियात्मिकाम् ..
प्रभासस्थां महादेवीं देवानां प्रीतिदायिनीम् .. 1 ..
16.58.m: Īśvara said: / Now I shall tell you, O goddess, of the second Śakti, whose nature is action (kriyā), / the Great Goddess situated in Prabhāsa, who bestows joy upon the gods. (1)

16.58.s:
someśādvāyave bhāge ṣaṣṭidhanvatare sthitā ..
tatra pīṭhaṃ mahādevi yoginīgaṇavanditam .. 2 ..
16.58.d:
सोमेशाद्वायवे भागे षष्टिधन्वतरे स्थिता ..
तत्र पीठं महादेवि योगिनीगणवन्दितम् .. 2 ..
16.58.m: She is located sixty bow-lengths in the north-western direction from Someśa. / There is the seat, O Great Goddess, praised by the host of yoginīs. (2)

16.58.s:
tasminsthāne sthitaṃ devi pātālavivaraṃ mahat ..
tasminmahāprabhe sthāne rakṣārūpeṇa saṃsthitām .. 3 ..
16.58.d:
तस्मिन्स्थाने स्थितं देवि पातालविवरं महत् ..
तस्मिन्महाप्रभे स्थाने रक्षारूपेण संस्थिताम् .. 3 ..
16.58.m: In that place, O goddess, is a great cavity leading to Pātāla. / In that place of great radiance, she who is situated in the form of protection, (3)

16.58.s:
pātālanidhi nikṣepadivyauṣadhirasāyanam ..
kṣetramadhye sthitaṃ sarvaṃ tadarcanarato labhet .. 4 ..
16.58.d:
पातालनिधि निक्षेपदिव्यौषधिरसायनम् ..
क्षेत्रमध्ये स्थितं सर्वं तदर्चनरतो लभेत् .. 4 ..
16.58.m: the treasures, deposits, divine herbs, and elixirs of Pātāla— / one devoted to her worship will obtain all that is situated within the sacred field. (4)

16.58.s:
bhairavīti ca taddevyāḥ pūrvaṃ nāma prakīrttitam ..
asminpunaścāṃtare tu aṣṭāviṃśe caturyuge ..
tretāyugamukhe rājā ajāpālo babhūva ha .. 5 ..
16.58.d:
भैरवीति च तद्देव्याः पूर्वं नाम प्रकीर्त्तितम् ..
अस्मिन्पुनश्चांतरे तु अष्टाविंशे चतुर्युगे ..
त्रेतायुगमुखे राजा अजापालो बभूव ह .. 5 ..
16.58.m: ‘Bhairavī’ was proclaimed to be that goddess's former name. / But again, in this interval, in the twenty-eighth four-age cycle, / at the beginning of the Tretāyuga, there was a king named Ajāpāla. (5)

16.58.s:
tena cāgatya kṣetresminpaṃcavarṣaśatāni ca ..
bhairavī pūjitā devī vyādhigrastena bhāmini .. 6 ..
16.58.d:
तेन चागत्य क्षेत्रेस्मिन्पंचवर्षशतानि च ..
भैरवी पूजिता देवी व्याधिग्रस्तेन भामिनि .. 6 ..
16.58.m: And having come to this sacred field, for five hundred years / the goddess Bhairavī was worshipped by him, who was afflicted with diseases, O passionate one. (6)

16.58.s:
tataḥ provāca taṃ devī saṃtuṣṭā rājasattamam ..
alaṃ kleśena rājarṣe tuṣṭāhaṃ tava bhaktitaḥ .. 7 ..
16.58.d:
ततः प्रोवाच तं देवी संतुष्टा राजसत्तमम् ..
अलं क्लेशेन राजर्षे तुष्टाहं तव भक्तितः .. 7 ..
16.58.m: Then, well pleased, the goddess addressed that best of kings: / “Enough with distress, O royal sage! I am pleased with your devotion.” (7)

16.58.s:
ityuktaḥ sa tadā rājā kṛtāñjalipuṭaḥ sudhīḥ ..
praṇamyovāca tāṃ devīmānaṃdāsrāvilekṣaṇaḥ .. 8 ..
16.58.d:
इत्युक्तः स तदा राजा कृताञ्जलिपुटः सुधीः ..
प्रणम्योवाच तां देवीमानंदास्राविलेक्षणः .. 8 ..
16.58.m: Thus addressed, the wise king then, joining his palms in reverence / and bowing down, spoke to that goddess, his eyes clouded with tears of joy: (8)

16.58.s:
yadi tuṣṭāsi me devi varārho yadi vāpyaham ..
sarve rogāḥ śarīrānme nāśaṃ yāṃtu bahiḥ kṛtāḥ .. 9 ..
16.58.d:
यदि तुष्टासि मे देवि वरार्हो यदि वाप्यहम् ..
सर्वे रोगाः शरीरान्मे नाशं यांतु बहिः कृताः .. 9 ..
16.58.m: “If you are pleased with me, O goddess, or if I am worthy of a boon, / may all diseases leave my body, cast outside, and be destroyed.” (9)

16.58.s:
evamuktā tu sā devī punaḥ provāca taṃ nṛpam ..
sarvameva mahārāja yathoktaṃ te bhaviṣyati .. 7.1.58.10 ..
16.58.d:
एवमुक्ता तु सा देवी पुनः प्रोवाच तं नृपम् ..
सर्वमेव महाराज यथोक्तं ते भविष्यति .. 7.1.58.10 ..
16.58.m: Addressed thus, that goddess spoke again to the king: / “Everything will be for you, O great king, just as you have spoken.” (10)

16.58.s:
ityukte tu tadā devyā tasya rājñaḥ kalevarāt ..
nirgatā vyādhayastatra ajārūpeṇa vai pṛthak .. 11 ..
16.58.d:
इत्युक्ते तु तदा देव्या तस्य राज्ञः कलेवरात् ..
निर्गता व्याधयस्तत्र अजारूपेण वै पृथक् .. 11 ..
16.58.m: When this was spoken by the goddess, then from the body of that king / the diseases came out separately in the form of goats, (11)

16.58.s:
sahasrāṇāṃ tu pañcaiva niyataṃ sārddhameva ca ..
iti vṛtte mahādevyā punaḥ prokto narādhipaḥ ..12 ..
16.58.d:
सहस्राणां तु पञ्चैव नियतं सार्द्धमेव च ..
इति वृत्ते महादेव्या पुनः प्रोक्तो नराधिपः ..12 ..
16.58.m: five thousand and a half precisely. / This having taken place, the king of men was addressed again by the Great Goddess: (12)

16.58.s:
rājannetānajārūpānvyādhīnpālaya kṛtsnaśaḥ ..
kiṃkurvāṇā bhaviṣyaṃti tavaivādeśakāriṇaḥ .. 13 ...
16.58.d:
राजन्नेतानजारूपान्व्याधीन्पालय कृत्स्नशः ..
किंकुर्वाणा भविष्यंति तवैवादेशकारिणः .. 13 ...
16.58.m: “O king, protect all these diseases in the form of goats! / They will become your servants, obedient to your command. (13)

16.58.s:
ajāpāleti te nāma khyātaṃ loke bhaviṣyati ..
tava nāmnā mama nāma ajāpāleśvarīti ca ..
bhaviṣyati dharāpṛṣṭhe tacca yāvaccaturyugam .. .. 14 ..
16.58.d:
अजापालेति ते नाम ख्यातं लोके भविष्यति ..
तव नाम्ना मम नाम अजापालेश्वरीति च ..
भविष्यति धरापृष्ठे तच्च यावच्चतुर्युगम् .. .. 14 ..
16.58.m: Your name will be renowned in the world as Ajāpāla (‘Goat-Protector’). / And after your name, my name shall be Ajāpāleśvarī / upon the face of the earth, as long as the four-age cycle lasts. (14)

16.58.s:
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturddaśyāṃ yo'tra māṃ pūjayiṣyati ..
tasyāṣṭaguṇamaiśvaryaṃ dāsye tuṣṭā na saṃśayaḥ .. 15 ..
16.58.d:
अष्टम्यां च चतुर्द्दश्यां योऽत्र मां पूजयिष्यति ..
तस्याष्टगुणमैश्वर्यं दास्ये तुष्टा न संशयः .. 15 ..
16.58.m: Whoever will worship me here on the eighth and fourteenth [lunar days], / pleased, I will bestow eightfold majesty upon him without a doubt. (15)

16.58.s:
aśvayukchuklāṣṭamyāṃ ca triḥ kṛtvā tu pradakṣiṇām ..
someśaṃ madhyataḥ kṛtvā saṃsnāpyābhyarcya māṃ pṛthak ..
tasya varṣatrayaṃ rājanna bhīḥ śoko bhaviṣyati .. 16 ..
16.58.d:
अश्वयुक्छुक्लाष्टम्यां च त्रिः कृत्वा तु प्रदक्षिणाम् ..
सोमेशं मध्यतः कृत्वा संस्नाप्याभ्यर्च्य मां पृथक् ..
तस्य वर्षत्रयं राजन्न भीः शोको भविष्यति .. 16 ..
16.58.m: And on the bright eighth of Āśvina, having circumambulated three times, / keeping Someśa in the center, and having bathed and worshipped me separately, / O king, he will have neither fear nor grief for three years. (16)

16.58.s:
yā tu vaṃdhyā bhavennārī rogiṇī durbhagā tathā ..
tayoktā navamī kāryā mamāgre tuṣṭivarddhinī .. 17 ..
16.58.d:
या तु वंध्या भवेन्नारी रोगिणी दुर्भगा तथा ..
तयोक्ता नवमी कार्या ममाग्रे तुष्टिवर्द्धिनी .. 17 ..
16.58.m: A woman who is barren, diseased, or likewise unfortunate, / should perform the prescribed ninth [lunar day] before me, which increases satisfaction.” (17)

16.58.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
ityuktvā tu tadā devī tatraivāṃtarhitā'bhavat ..
prabhāsakṣetramadhyasthaḥ sa rājātulavikramaḥ .. 18 ..
16.58.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
इत्युक्त्वा तु तदा देवी तत्रैवांतर्हिताऽभवत् ..
प्रभासक्षेत्रमध्यस्थः स राजातुलविक्रमः .. 18 ..
16.58.m: Īśvara said: / Having spoken thus, the goddess then vanished right there. / That king of unequalled valor, remaining within the Prabhāsa sacred field, (18)

16.58.s:
pālayāmāsa dharmātmā tānajānvyādhirūpiṇaḥ ..
auṣadhīrvividhākārāsteṣāṃ yāḥ puṣṭihetavaḥ .. 19 ..
16.58.d:
पालयामास धर्मात्मा तानजान्व्याधिरूपिणः ..
औषधीर्विविधाकारास्तेषां याः पुष्टिहेतवः .. 19 ..
16.58.m: the righteous-minded one, tended those goats in the form of diseases, / and various kinds of medicinal herbs that were the cause of their nourishment. (19)

16.58.s:
tatra varṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ puṣṭiṃ nītā ajāḥ pṛthak ..
mahānidhānasaṃsthānamajāpālena nirmiṃtam.. 7.1.58.20 ..
16.58.d:
तत्र वर्षशतं साग्रं पुष्टिं नीता अजाः पृथक् ..
महानिधानसंस्थानमजापालेन निर्मिंतम्.. 7.1.58.20 ..
16.58.m: There, for a full century of years, the goats were separately brought to nourishment. / The great repository's abode was constructed by Ajāpāla. (20)

16.58.s:
atha tasyāḥ prasādena sa rājā pṛthuvikramaḥ ..
saptadvīpādhipo jātaḥ sūryavaṃśavibhūṣaṇaḥ .. 21 ..
16.58.d:
अथ तस्याः प्रसादेन स राजा पृथुविक्रमः ..
सप्तद्वीपाधिपो जातः सूर्यवंशविभूषणः .. 21 ..
16.58.m: Then, by her grace, that king of vast prowess / became the ruler of seven continents, an ornament of the solar dynasty. (21)

16.58.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
atyāścaryamidaṃ deva ajā devyāḥ samudbhavam ..
punaśca śrotumicchāmi tasya rājñodbhutaṃ mahat .. 22 ..
16.58.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
अत्याश्चर्यमिदं देव अजा देव्याः समुद्भवम् ..
पुनश्च श्रोतुमिच्छामि तस्य राज्ञोद्भुतं महत् .. 22 ..
16.58.m: The goddess said: / “This is exceedingly wondrous, O god, the origin of the goddess [named from] goats! / I wish to hear further the great wonder performed by that king. (22)

16.58.s:
kathaṃ rājā sa deveśa saptadvīpāṃ vasundharām..
śaśāsa eka evāsau kathaṃ te vyādhayaḥ kṛtāḥ .. 23 ..
16.58.d:
कथं राजा स देवेश सप्तद्वीपां वसुन्धराम्..
शशास एक एवासौ कथं ते व्याधयः कृताः .. 23 ..
16.58.m: How, O Lord of gods, did that king rule the earth of seven continents / all alone? And how were those diseases made [into goats]?” (23)

16.58.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
purā babhūva rājarṣirdilīpa iti viśrutaḥ ..
dīrgho nāma sutastasya raghustasmādajāyata .. 24 ..
16.58.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
पुरा बभूव राजर्षिर्दिलीप इति विश्रुतः ..
दीर्घो नाम सुतस्तस्य रघुस्तस्मादजायत .. 24 ..
16.58.m: Īśvara said: / Formerly, there was a renowned royal sage named Dilīpa. / His son was named Dīrgha, and from him Raghu was born. (24)

16.58.s:
ajaḥputro raghoścāpi tasmādyaścātivīryavān ..
sa bhairavīṃ samārādhya kṛtvā vyādhīnajāgaṇān ..25..
16.58.d:
अजःपुत्रो रघोश्चापि तस्माद्यश्चातिवीर्यवान् ..
स भैरवीं समाराध्य कृत्वा व्याधीनजागणान् ..25..
16.58.m: And Raghu's son was Aja, who was born from him, of immense prowess. / Having propitiated Bhairavī and turned the diseases into flocks of goats,

16.58.s:
pālayāmāsa saṃhṛṣṭo hyajāpālastato'bhavat..
tasminkāle babhūvātha rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ..26..
16.58.d:
पालयामास संहृष्टो ह्यजापालस्ततोऽभवत्..
तस्मिन्काले बभूवाथ रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः..26..
16.58.m: he protected [the earth], delighted; thus he became Ajāpāla. / At that time, Rāvaṇa was the lord of the rākṣasas.

16.58.s:
laṃkāsthitaḥ suragaṇānniyuyoja svakarmasu..
akhaṃḍamaṃḍalaṃ candramātapatraṃ cakāra ha..27..
16.58.d:
लंकास्थितः सुरगणान्नियुयोज स्वकर्मसु..
अखंडमंडलं चन्द्रमातपत्रं चकार ह..27..
16.58.m: Residing in Laṅkā, he assigned the hosts of gods to his personal tasks: / he made the unbroken orb of the moon his parasol;

16.58.s:
indraṃ senāpatiṃ cakre vāyuṃ pāṃsupramārjakam..
varuṇaṃ dūtakarmasthaṃ dhanadaṃ dhanarakṣakam..28..
16.58.d:
इन्द्रं सेनापतिं चक्रे वायुं पांसुप्रमार्जकम्..
वरुणं दूतकर्मस्थं धनदं धनरक्षकम्..28..
16.58.m: he made Indra his general, Vāyu the sweeper of dust, / Varuṇa employed in the work of an envoy, Dhanada the guardian of wealth,

16.58.s:
yamaṃ saṃyamane'rīṇāṃ yuyuje mantraṇe manum..
meghāśchardaṃti liṃpaṃti drumāḥ puṣpāṇi cikṣipuḥ..29..
saptarṣayaḥ śāṃtiparā brāhmaṇāḥ śaṃsinaḥ priyaḥ..
nāgā yāmakakakṣāyāṃ gandharvā gītatatparāḥ..7.1.58.3...
16.58.d:
यमं संयमनेऽरीणां युयुजे मन्त्रणे मनुम्..
मेघाश्छर्दंति लिंपंति द्रुमाः पुष्पाणि चिक्षिपुः..29..
सप्तर्षयः शांतिपरा ब्राह्मणाः शंसिनः प्रियः..
नागा यामककक्षायां गन्धर्वा गीततत्पराः..7.1.58.3...
16.58.m:
Yama for subduing enemies, and he employed Manu in counsel; / the clouds poured water and plastered [the grounds], the trees cast down flowers,
the seven seers were dedicated to peace-offerings, the brahmins uttered pleasing praises, / the serpents stood watch at the gate, the gandharvas were intent on singing,

16.58.s:
prekṣaṇīye'psarovṛṃdaṃ vādye vidyādharā vṛtāḥ..
gaṃgādyāḥ saritaḥ pāne gārhapatye hutāśanaḥ..31..
16.58.d:
प्रेक्षणीयेऽप्सरोवृंदं वाद्ये विद्याधरा वृताः..
गंगाद्याः सरितः पाने गार्हपत्ये हुताशनः..31..
16.58.m: the host of apsarases was gathered for spectacles, the vidyādharas for instrumental music, / the Gaṅgā and other rivers for drinking water, Hutāśana for the household fire,

16.58.s:
viśvakarmāṃgasaṃskāre tena śilpī niyojitaḥ..
tiṣṭhaṃti pārthivāḥ sarve puraḥ sevāvidhāyinaḥ..32..
16.58.d:
विश्वकर्मांगसंस्कारे तेन शिल्पी नियोजितः..
तिष्ठंति पार्थिवाः सर्वे पुरः सेवाविधायिनः..32..
16.58.m: and the craftsman Viśvakarman was appointed by him for personal adornment. / All the earthly kings stood before him, rendering service;

16.58.s:
dṛśyaṃte bhāsvarai ratnaiḥ praskhalaṃto vibhūṣaṇaiḥ..
tāndṛṣṭvā rāvaṇaḥ prāha prahastaṃ pratihārakam..33..
16.58.d:
दृश्यंते भास्वरै रत्नैः प्रस्खलंतो विभूषणैः..
तान्दृष्ट्वा रावणः प्राह प्रहस्तं प्रतिहारकम्..33..
16.58.m: they were seen stumbling because of their radiant gems and ornaments. / Seeing them, Rāvaṇa said to Prahasta, the chamberlain:

16.58.s:
sevāṃ karttuṃ mama sthāne brūhi ke'tra samāgatāḥ ..
uvāca sa praṇamyāgre daṇḍapāṇirniśācaraḥ .. 34 ..
16.58.d:
सेवां कर्त्तुं मम स्थाने ब्रूहि केऽत्र समागताः ..
उवाच स प्रणम्याग्रे दण्डपाणिर्निशाचरः .. 34 ..
16.58.m: "Tell me, who have arrived here to render service at my abode?" / Bowing before him, that night-roaming demon, staff in hand, said:

16.58.s:
eṣa kākutstho māṃdhātā dhundhumāro nalo'rjunaḥ ..
yayātirnahuṣo bhīmo rāghavo'yaṃ vidūrathaḥ .. 35 ..
16.58.d:
एष काकुत्स्थो मांधाता धुन्धुमारो नलोऽर्जुनः ..
ययातिर्नहुषो भीमो राघवोऽयं विदूरथः .. 35 ..
16.58.m: "Here is the scion of Kakutstha, Māndhātṛ, Dhundhumāra, Nala, Arjuna, / Yayāti, Nahuṣa, Bhīma, this descendant of Raghu, and Vidūratha;

16.58.s:
ete cānye ca bahavo rājāna iha cāgatāḥ ..
sevākarāstava sthāne nājāpāla iho gataḥ .. 36 ..
16.58.d:
एते चान्ये च बहवो राजान इह चागताः ..
सेवाकरास्तव स्थाने नाजापाल इहो गतः .. 36 ..
16.58.m: these and many other kings have arrived here / to render service at your abode; but Ajāpāla has not come here."

16.58.s:
rāvaṇaḥ kupitaḥ prāha śīghraṃ dūta visarjaya ..
ityuktvā prahito dūto dhūmrākṣo nāma rākṣasaḥ.. 37 ..
16.58.d:
रावणः कुपितः प्राह शीघ्रं दूत विसर्जय ..
इत्युक्त्वा प्रहितो दूतो धूम्राक्षो नाम राक्षसः.. 37 ..
16.58.m: Infuriated, Rāvaṇa said: "Send an envoy quickly!" / Having spoken thus, an envoy was dispatched, a rākṣasa named Dhūmrākṣa:

16.58.s:
dhūmrākṣa gaccha brūhi tvamajāpālaṃ mamā jñayā ..
sevāṃ karttuṃ mamāgaccha karaṃ vā yaccha pārthiva .. 38 ..
16.58.d:
धूम्राक्ष गच्छ ब्रूहि त्वमजापालं ममा ज्ञया ..
सेवां कर्त्तुं ममागच्छ करं वा यच्छ पार्थिव .. 38 ..
16.58.m: "Dhūmrākṣa, go and tell Ajāpāla by my command: / 'Come to render service to me, or pay tribute, O king!

16.58.s:
athavā candrahāsena tvāṃ kariṣye vikaṃdharam ..
rāvaṇenaivamuktastu dhūmrākṣo garuḍo yathā .. .. 39 ..
16.58.d:
अथवा चन्द्रहासेन त्वां करिष्ये विकंधरम् ..
रावणेनैवमुक्तस्तु धूम्राक्षो गरुडो यथा .. .. 39 ..
16.58.m: Otherwise, I will make you neckless with Candrahāsa.'" / Thus addressed by Rāvaṇa, Dhūmrākṣa, like Garuḍa,

16.58.s:
saṃprāptastāṃ purīṃ ramyāṃ tava rājakulaṃ gataḥ ..
dadarśāyāṃtamekaṃ sa ajāpālamajāvṛtam .. 7.1.58.40 ..
16.58.d:
संप्राप्तस्तां पुरीं रम्यां तव राजकुलं गतः ..
ददर्शायांतमेकं स अजापालमजावृतम् .. 7.1.58.40 ..
16.58.m: reached that delightful city and went to the royal palace. / He saw Ajāpāla coming alone, surrounded by goats,

16.58.s:
muktakeśaṃ muktakacchaṃ svarṇakaṃbaladhāriṇam ..
yaṣṭiskaṃdhaṃ reṇuvṛtaṃ vyādhibhiḥ parivāritam .. 41 ..
16.58.d:
मुक्तकेशं मुक्तकच्छं स्वर्णकंबलधारिणम् ..
यष्टिस्कंधं रेणुवृतं व्याधिभिः परिवारितम् .. 41 ..
16.58.m: with disheveled hair, loose loincloth, wearing a golden woolen blanket, / with a staff on his shoulder, covered in dust, surrounded by diseases,

16.58.s:
nighnaṃtamiva śārdūlaṃ sarvopadravanāśanam ..
mahyāmālikhya nāmāni vinighnaṃtaṃ dviṣāṃ gaṇam.. 42 ..
16.58.d:
निघ्नंतमिव शार्दूलं सर्वोपद्रवनाशनम् ..
मह्यामालिख्य नामानि विनिघ्नंतं द्विषां गणम्.. 42 ..
16.58.m: as if striking down a tiger, destroying all afflictions, / writing the names on the earth and smiting the host of his foes,

16.58.s:
snātaṃ bhuktaṃ nijasthāne kṛtakṛtyaṃ manuṃ yathā ..
dṛṣṭvā hṛṣṭamanāḥ prāha dhūmrākṣo rāvaṇoditam .. 43 ..
16.58.d:
स्नातं भुक्तं निजस्थाने कृतकृत्यं मनुं यथा ..
दृष्ट्वा हृष्टमनाः प्राह धूम्राक्षो रावणोदितम् .. 43 ..
16.58.m: bathed and fed in his own abode, like Manu having accomplished his duty. / Seeing him, Dhūmrākṣa, pleased in mind, spoke what Rāvaṇa had said.

16.58.s:
ajāpālo'pi sākṣepaṃ pratyu ktvā kāraṇottaram ..
preṣayāmāsa dhūmrākṣaṃ tataḥ kṛtyaṃ samādadhe .. 44 ..
16.58.d:
अजापालोऽपि साक्षेपं प्रत्यु क्त्वा कारणोत्तरम् ..
प्रेषयामास धूम्राक्षं ततः कृत्यं समादधे .. 44 ..
16.58.m: Ajāpāla, having also replied with reproach and given a reasoned answer, / sent Dhūmrākṣa away, and then addressed the task at hand.

16.58.s:
jvaramākārayitvā tu provācedaṃ mahīpatiḥ..
gaccha laṃkādhipasthānamācara tvaṃ yathoditam .. 45 ..
16.58.d:
ज्वरमाकारयित्वा तु प्रोवाचेदं महीपतिः..
गच्छ लंकाधिपस्थानमाचर त्वं यथोदितम् .. 45 ..
16.58.m: Having summoned Fever, the king said this: / "Go to the abode of the lord of Laṅkā, and act as directed."

16.58.s:
niyuktastvajapālena jvaro divi jagāma ha ..
gatvā ca kaṃpayāmāsa rāvaṇaṃ rākṣaseśvaram .. 46 ..
16.58.d:
नियुक्तस्त्वजपालेन ज्वरो दिवि जगाम ह ..
गत्वा च कंपयामास रावणं राक्षसेश्वरम् .. 46 ..
16.58.m: Commissioned by Ajāpāla, Fever went to the sky; / and having gone, he caused Rāvaṇa, the lord of the rākṣasas, to tremble.

16.58.s:
rāvaṇastaṃ viditvā tu jvaraṃ paramadāruṇam ..
provāca tiṣṭhatu nṛpastena me na prayojanam .. 47 ..
16.58.d:
रावणस्तं विदित्वा तु ज्वरं परमदारुणम् ..
प्रोवाच तिष्ठतु नृपस्तेन मे न प्रयोजनम् .. 47 ..
16.58.m: Recognizing that exceedingly terrible fever, Rāvaṇa / said: "Let the king remain [where he is]; I have no need of him!"

16.58.s:
tataḥ sa vijvaro rājā babhūva dhanadānujaḥ ..
evaṃ tasya caritrāṇi saṃti cānyāni koṭiśaḥ .. 48 ..
16.58.d:
ततः स विज्वरो राजा बभूव धनदानुजः ..
एवं तस्य चरित्राणि संति चान्यानि कोटिशः .. 48 ..
16.58.m: Then that king, the younger brother of Dhanada, became free from fever. / In this manner there are millions of other deeds of his,

16.58.s:
ajāpālasya deveśi sūryavattviṭkirīṭinaḥ ..
tenaiṣā''rādhitā devī ajāpālena dhīmatā ..
sarvarogapraśamanī sarvo padravanāśinī .. 49 ..
16.58.d:
अजापालस्य देवेशि सूर्यवत्त्विट्किरीटिनः ..
तेनैषा'ऽराधिता देवी अजापालेन धीमता ..
सर्वरोगप्रशमनी सर्वो पद्रवनाशिनी .. 49 ..
16.58.m: of Ajāpāla, O goddess, whose diadem shone like the sun. / By that wise Ajāpāla this goddess was propitiated— / she who pacifies all sickness and destroys all afflictions.

16.58.s:
pūjayettāṃ vidhānena bhogepsuryadi mānavaḥ ..
gaṃdhairdhūpairalaṃkārairvastrairanyaiśca bhaktitaḥ .. 7.1.58.50 ..
16.58.d:
पूजयेत्तां विधानेन भोगेप्सुर्यदि मानवः ..
गंधैर्धूपैरलंकारैर्वस्त्रैरन्यैश्च भक्तितः .. 7.1.58.50 ..
16.58.m: If a mortal desires enjoyments, he should worship her according to rule / with perfumes, incenses, ornaments, garments, and other offerings, in devotion.

16.58.s:
iti te kathitaṃ sarvamajādevyāḥ samudbhavam ..
sarvaduḥkhopaśamanaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam .. 51 ..
16.58.d:
इति ते कथितं सर्वमजादेव्याः समुद्भवम् ..
सर्वदुःखोपशमनं सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 51 ..
16.58.m: Thus has the entire origin of the goddess Ajā been told to you, / which pacifies all sorrows and destroys all sins.

16.58.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyā saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye'jāpāleśvarīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭapañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 58 ..
16.58.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहिताया सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्येऽजापालेश्वरीमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामाष्टपञ्चाशोऽध्यायः .. 58 ..
16.58.m: Thus ends the fifty-eighth chapter, entitled "Description of the Greatness of Ajāpāleśvarī," in the first [part], the Greatness of Prabhāsa Sacred Field, in the seventh [book], the Prabhāsa Section, of the venerable Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.59.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
atha vacmi tṛtīyāṃ te jñānaśaktiṃ śivātmikām ..
prabhāsakṣetramadhyasthāṃ dāridryaughavināśinīm .. 1 ..
16.59.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
अथ वच्मि तृतीयां ते ज्ञानशक्तिं शिवात्मिकाम् ..
प्रभासक्षेत्रमध्यस्थां दारिद्र्यौघविनाशिनीम् .. 1 ..
16.59.m: Īśvara said: / Now I shall tell you of the third power of knowledge, consisting of Śiva, / situated in the middle of Prabhāsa sacred field, destroying the flood of poverty,

16.59.s:
ajeti nāmnīṃ tāṃ devīṃ rāhvīśāddakṣiṇe sthitām ..
mama vaktrādviniṣkrāṃtā ṣaṣṭhādvai viṣṇupūjitāt .. 2 ..
16.59.d:
अजेति नाम्नीं तां देवीं राह्वीशाद्दक्षिणे स्थिताम् ..
मम वक्त्राद्विनिष्क्रांता षष्ठाद्वै विष्णुपूजितात् .. 2 ..
16.59.m: that goddess named Ajā, who is situated to the south of Rāhvīśa, / who issued forth from my sixth face that is worshipped by Viṣṇu.

16.59.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
paṃcavaktrāṇi deveśa prasiddhāni tava prabhau ..
ṣaṣṭhaṃ yadvadanaṃ deva tasya kiṃ nāma saṃsmṛtam ..
samutpannā kathaṃ tasmādajādevīti yā śrutā .. 3 ..
16.59.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
पंचवक्त्राणि देवेश प्रसिद्धानि तव प्रभौ ..
षष्ठं यद्वदनं देव तस्य किं नाम संस्मृतम् ..
समुत्पन्ना कथं तस्मादजादेवीति या श्रुता .. 3 ..
16.59.m: The goddess said: / Five faces are well known to belong to you, O lord of gods, O sovereign; / by what name is that face remembered which is the sixth, O god? / How was she who is renowned as Goddess Ajā born from it?

16.59.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā devi yadgopyaṃ svasuteṣvapi ..
tatte'haṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi aprasiddhāgamoditam .. 4 ..
16.59.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
साधु पृष्टं त्वया देवि यद्गोप्यं स्वसुतेष्वपि ..
तत्तेऽहं संप्रवक्ष्यामि अप्रसिद्धागमोदितम् .. 4 ..
16.59.m: Īśvara said: / Well asked by you, O goddess! That which is secret even to one's own sons, / that I shall declare to you as spoken in the esoteric scriptures.

16.59.s:
vaktrāṇi mama deveśi saptāsanpūrvameva hi ..
sadyojātādipaṃcaiva ṣaṣṭhaṃ smṛtamajeti ca .. 5 ..
16.59.d:
वक्त्राणि मम देवेशि सप्तासन्पूर्वमेव हि ..
सद्योजातादिपंचैव षष्ठं स्मृतमजेति च .. 5 ..
16.59.m: Originally indeed, O queen of gods, my faces were seven: / the five beginning with Sadyojāta, and the sixth is remembered as Aja,

16.59.s:
saptamaṃ picunāmeti saptaivaṃ vadanāni me ..
tebhyo'jaṃ brahmaṇe dattaṃ picuvaktraṃ tu viṣṇave .. 6 ..
16.59.d:
सप्तमं पिचुनामेति सप्तैवं वदनानि मे ..
तेभ्योऽजं ब्रह्मणे दत्तं पिचुवक्त्रं तु विष्णवे .. 6 ..
16.59.m: and the seventh by the name Picu; thus were my seven faces. / Out of them, Aja was given to Brahmā, and the Picu face to Viṣṇu.

16.59.s:
tasmādahaṃ mahādevi paṃcavaktro'dhunā'bhavam ..
ajastu brahmā sañjajñe picurviṣṇurajāyata .. 7 ..
16.59.d:
तस्मादहं महादेवि पंचवक्त्रोऽधुनाऽभवम् ..
अजस्तु ब्रह्मा सञ्जज्ञे पिचुर्विष्णुरजायत .. 7 ..
16.59.m: Therefore, O great goddess, I have now become five-faced. / Aja was born as Brahmā, and Picu was born as Viṣṇu.

16.59.s:
ajavaktrānmahādevi ajā jātā mahāprabhā ..
andhāsuraraṇe ghore mama krodhena bhāmini .. 8 ..
16.59.d:
अजवक्त्रान्महादेवि अजा जाता महाप्रभा ..
अन्धासुररणे घोरे मम क्रोधेन भामिनि .. 8 ..
16.59.m: From the Aja face, O great goddess, Ajā of great splendour was born / during the terrible battle with the demon Andhaka, through my wrath, O passionate lady.

16.59.s:
khaḍgacarmadharādevī surūpā siṃhavāhinī ..
marddayantī mahādaityāndevīkoṭisamanvitā .. 9 ..
16.59.d:
खड्गचर्मधरादेवी सुरूपा सिंहवाहिनी ..
मर्द्दयन्ती महादैत्यान्देवीकोटिसमन्विता .. 9 ..
16.59.m: Bearing a sword and shield, beautiful, mounted upon a lion, / crushing the great daityas, accompanied by ten million goddesses,

16.59.s:
tasyā bhayena ye daityā vidrutā dakṣiṇārṇavam ..
pṛṣṭhato'nuyayau tānvai sā devī siṃhavāhinī .. 7.1.59.10 ..
16.59.d:
तस्या भयेन ये दैत्या विद्रुता दक्षिणार्णवम् ..
पृष्ठतोऽनुययौ तान्वै सा देवी सिंहवाहिनी .. 7.1.59.10 ..
16.59.m: that lion-mounted goddess pursued from behind those daityas / who, out of fear of her, fled towards the southern ocean.

16.59.s:
itastataste dhāvanto māryamāṇāśca tadgaṇaiḥ ..
prabhāsa kṣetrasaṃprāptā naśyamānā mahārṇavam .. 11 ..
16.59.d:
इतस्ततस्ते धावन्तो मार्यमाणाश्च तद्गणैः ..
प्रभास क्षेत्रसंप्राप्ता नश्यमाना महार्णवम् .. 11 ..
16.59.m: Running hither and thither and being slain by her hordes, / fleeing to the great ocean, they reached Prabhāsa sacred field.

16.59.s:
kecittatra hatā daityāḥ kecitpātālamāyayuḥ ..
niḥśeṣānnihatāndṛṣṭvā sā devī siṃhavāhinī .. 12 ..
16.59.d:
केचित्तत्र हता दैत्याः केचित्पातालमाययुः ..
निःशेषान्निहतान्दृष्ट्वा सा देवी सिंहवाहिनी .. 12 ..
16.59.m: Some daityas were killed there, and some went to Pātāla. / Seeing them completely destroyed, that lion-mounted goddess,

16.59.s:
kṣetraṃ pavitramājñāya tatra sthāne sthitā śubhā ..
someśādīśakoṇasthā saurīśāduttare sthitā .. 13 ..
16.59.d:
क्षेत्रं पवित्रमाज्ञाय तत्र स्थाने स्थिता शुभा ..
सोमेशादीशकोणस्था सौरीशादुत्तरे स्थिता .. 13 ..
16.59.m: recognizing the sacred field to be pure, the auspicious one remained in that place, / situated in the northeast direction from Someśa, and situated to the north of Saurīśa.

16.59.s:
yastāṃ tatra sthitāṃ paśyedyoṣidvātha naro'pi vā ..
sa bhūyātsattvasaubhāgyaiḥ saptajanmāni saṃyutaḥ ..14..
16.59.d:
यस्तां तत्र स्थितां पश्येद्योषिद्वाथ नरोऽपि वा ..
स भूयात्सत्त्वसौभाग्यैः सप्तजन्मानि संयुतः ..14..
16.59.m: Whosoever, woman or man, beholds her situated there / shall be endowed with vitality and good fortune for seven births.

16.59.s:
gītavādyādikaṃ nṛtyaṃ yastatra kurute naraḥ ..
tasyānvaye na daurbhāgyaṃ bhūyāttasyāḥ prasādataḥ.. ..15..
16.59.d:
गीतवाद्यादिकं नृत्यं यस्तत्र कुरुते नरः ..
तस्यान्वये न दौर्भाग्यं भूयात्तस्याः प्रसादतः.. ..15..
16.59.m: The person who performs songs, instrumental music, dances, and so forth there / will have no misfortune in their lineage, by her grace.

16.59.s:
ghṛtena dīpakaṃ tatra yā nārī saṃprayacchati..
raktavartyā mahādevi yāvaṃtastatra taṃtavaḥ ..
tāvajjanmāṃtarāṇyeva sā saubhāgyamavāpnuyāt..16..
16.59.d:
घृतेन दीपकं तत्र या नारी संप्रयच्छति..
रक्तवर्त्या महादेवि यावंतस्तत्र तंतवः ..
तावज्जन्मांतराण्येव सा सौभाग्यमवाप्नुयात्..16..
16.59.m: O Great Goddess, as many threads as there are in the red wick / of the lamp with ghee that a woman offers there, / for that many future lifetimes she will obtain good fortune.

16.59.s:
yaścaitattu paṭhennityaṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ viśeṣataḥ ..
śṛṇuyādvā'pi yo bhaktyā sa kāmānakhilāllam̐bhet .. 17 ..
16.59.d:
यश्चैतत्तु पठेन्नित्यं तृतीयायां विशेषतः ..
शृणुयाद्वाऽपि यो भक्त्या स कामानखिलाल्लम्̐भेत् .. 17 ..
16.59.m: And whoever recites this daily, especially on the third lunar day, / or hears it with devotion, will attain all desires.

16.59.s: iti saṃkṣepataḥ prokto rudraśaktitrayakramaḥ .. 18..
16.59.d: इति संक्षेपतः प्रोक्तो रुद्रशक्तित्रयक्रमः .. 18..
16.59.m: Thus the series of the three Śaktis of Rudra has been declared in brief.

16.59.s:
etāḥ śaktīḥ pūjayitvā someśaṃ pūjayettataḥ ..
samyagyātrāphalāpekṣī ekāṃ vā varadāmatha .. 19 ..
16.59.d:
एताः शक्तीः पूजयित्वा सोमेशं पूजयेत्ततः ..
सम्यग्यात्राफलापेक्षी एकां वा वरदामथ .. 19 ..
16.59.m: Having worshipped these Śaktis, one who seeks the full fruit of the pilgrimage / should then worship Someśa, or else worship the one boon-granting [goddess].

16.59.s:
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye'jādevīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 59 ..
iti rudraśaktitrayasaṃketaḥ .. .. ..
16.59.d:
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्येऽजादेवीमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकोनषष्टितमोऽध्यायः .. 59 ..
इति रुद्रशक्तित्रयसंकेतः .. .. ..
16.59.m:
Thus ends the fifty-ninth chapter, titled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Ajādevī', in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.
Thus ends the instruction on the triad of Rudra's Śaktis.

16.60.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
prabhāsakṣetradūtīnāṃ tritayaṃ varavarṇini ..
atha te saṃpravakṣyāmi śṛṇu hyekamanāḥ priye .. 1 ..
16.60.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
प्रभासक्षेत्रदूतीनां त्रितयं वरवर्णिनि ..
अथ ते संप्रवक्ष्यामि शृणु ह्येकमनाः प्रिये .. 1 ..
16.60.m: Īśvara said: / O fair-complexioned one, I shall now declare to you / the triad of female messengers of the Prabhāsakṣetra; listen with single-minded focus, my dear.

16.60.s:
prathamā maṃgalā devī viśālākṣī dvitīyikā ..
tathā catvaradevī tu tṛtīyā parikīrtitā .. 2 ..
16.60.d:
प्रथमा मंगला देवी विशालाक्षी द्वितीयिका ..
तथा चत्वरदेवी तु तृतीया परिकीर्तिता .. 2 ..
16.60.m: The first is the goddess Maṅgalā, and the second is Viśālākṣī; / likewise, the goddess Catvarapriyā is proclaimed to be the third.

16.60.s:
yathānukramataḥ pūjyāḥ śaktayastā varānane ..
prabhāsakṣetrayātrāyāḥ phalaprepsurnaro yadi .. 3 ..
16.60.d:
यथानुक्रमतः पूज्याः शक्तयस्ता वरानने ..
प्रभासक्षेत्रयात्रायाः फलप्रेप्सुर्नरो यदि .. 3 ..
16.60.m: These Śaktis should be worshipped in their proper order, O lovely-faced one, / if a person desires to obtain the fruit of the pilgrimage to Prabhāsakṣetra.

16.60.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
kasminsthāne sthitā deva dūtyastāḥ kṣetrarakṣikāḥ ..
kasya tāḥ kathamārādhyāḥ kathaṃ pūjyā jagatpate ..4.. ..
16.60.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
कस्मिन्स्थाने स्थिता देव दूत्यस्ताः क्षेत्ररक्षिकाः ..
कस्य ताः कथमाराध्याः कथं पूज्या जगत्पते ..4.. ..
16.60.m: The Devī said: / In what place are those messengers who guard the sacred field situated, O God? / To whom do they belong, how are they to be propitiated, and how worshipped, O Lord of the universe?

16.60.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
brāhmī tu maṃgalā proktā viśālākṣī tu vaiṣṇavī ..
raudrīśaktiḥ samākhyātā devī sā catvarapriyā .. 5 ..
16.60.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ब्राह्मी तु मंगला प्रोक्ता विशालाक्षी तु वैष्णवी ..
रौद्रीशक्तिः समाख्याता देवी सा चत्वरप्रिया .. 5 ..
16.60.m: Īśvara said: / Maṅgalā is proclaimed to be Brāhmī, and Viśālākṣī is Vaiṣṇavī; / that goddess fond of crossroads is declared to be the Raudrī Śakti.

16.60.s:
maṃgalā prathamaṃ pūjyā ajādevyuttare sthitā ..
rāhvīśāddakṣiṇebhāge nātidūre varānane .. 6 ..
16.60.d:
मंगला प्रथमं पूज्या अजादेव्युत्तरे स्थिता ..
राह्वीशाद्दक्षिणेभागे नातिदूरे वरानने .. 6 ..
16.60.m: Maṅgalā, situated to the north of Ajādevī, is to be worshipped first; / she is on the southern side of Rāhvīśa, not very far away, O fair-faced one.

16.60.s:
someśvarapratiṣṭhāpya prārabdhe yajñakarmaṇi ..
somena tatra devānāmāgatā sā didṛkṣayā .. 7 ..
16.60.d:
सोमेश्वरप्रतिष्ठाप्य प्रारब्धे यज्ञकर्मणि ..
सोमेन तत्र देवानामागता सा दिदृक्षया .. 7 ..
16.60.m: When Someśvara had been consecrated and the sacrificial rite begun / by Soma, she came there eager to see the gods.

16.60.s:
brahmādīnāṃ ca sā yasmānmāṃgalyaṃ kṛtavatyume ..
tasmātsā maṃgalā proktā sarvamāṃgalyadāyinī .. 8 ..
16.60.d:
ब्रह्मादीनां च सा यस्मान्मांगल्यं कृतवत्युमे ..
तस्मात्सा मंगला प्रोक्ता सर्वमांगल्यदायिनी .. 8 ..
16.60.m: And because she brought auspiciousness to Brahmā and the others, O Umā, / therefore she is proclaimed Maṅgalā, the giver of all auspiciousness.

16.60.s:
tṛtīyāyāṃ tu yā nārī naro vā pūjayiṣyati ..
tasyā'maṃgalyaduḥkhāni nāśaṃ yāsyaṃti kṛtsnaśaḥ .. 9 ..
16.60.d:
तृतीयायां तु या नारी नरो वा पूजयिष्यति ..
तस्याऽमंगल्यदुःखानि नाशं यास्यंति कृत्स्नशः .. 9 ..
16.60.m: Whatever woman or man worships her on the third lunar day, / all their inauspicious misfortunes will go to destruction.

16.60.s:
dampatībhojanaṃ tatra phaladānaṃ sakañcukam ..
praśastaṃ pṛṣadājyasya prāśanaṃ pāpanāśanam .. 7.1.60.10 ..
16.60.d:
दम्पतीभोजनं तत्र फलदानं सकञ्चुकम् ..
प्रशस्तं पृषदाज्यस्य प्राशनं पापनाशनम् .. 7.1.60.10 ..
16.60.m: Feeding a married couple, gifting fruit along with a bodice, / and sipping ghee mixed with curd—which destroys sin—are commended there.

16.60.s:
iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ mahābhāgyaṃ mahodayam ..
maṃgalāyāśca māhātmyaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam .. 11 ..
16.60.d:
इति संक्षेपतः प्रोक्तं महाभाग्यं महोदयम् ..
मंगलायाश्च माहात्म्यं सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 11 ..
16.60.m: Thus has been declared in brief the great glory, conferring great prosperity, / and the māhātmya of Maṅgalā, which destroys all sins.

16.60.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye maṅgalāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 60 ..
16.60.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये मङ्गलामाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षष्टितमोऽध्यायः .. 60 ..
16.60.m: Thus ends the sixtieth chapter, titled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Maṅgalā', in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.61.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevīṃ kṣetradūtīṃ tu vaiṣṇavīm ..
śrīdaityasūdanāddevi pūrvabhāge vyavasthitām ..1..
16.61.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवीं क्षेत्रदूतीं तु वैष्णवीम् ..
श्रीदैत्यसूदनाद्देवि पूर्वभागे व्यवस्थिताम् ..1..
16.61.m: Īśvara said: / Next, O goddess, one should go to the Vaiṣṇavī messenger of the sacred field, the great goddess / situated on the eastern side of the illustrious Daityasūdana,

16.61.s:
yogeśvaryāstathaiśānyāṃ dhanuṣāṃ saptake sthitām ..
mahādaurbhāgyadagdhānāṃ sthitāṃ bheṣajarūpiṇīm .. 2..
16.61.d:
योगेश्वर्यास्तथैशान्यां धनुषां सप्तके स्थिताम् ..
महादौर्भाग्यदग्धानां स्थितां भेषजरूपिणीम् .. 2..
16.61.m: standing seven bow-lengths to the north-east of Yogeśvarī, / standing as medicine for those consumed by great misfortune.

16.61.s:
cākṣuṣasyāṃtare devi yadā daityā balotkaṭāḥ ..
hanyamānā viṣṇunā'tha dakṣiṇāṃ diśamāviśan .. 3 ..
16.61.d:
चाक्षुषस्यांतरे देवि यदा दैत्या बलोत्कटाः ..
हन्यमाना विष्णुनाऽथ दक्षिणां दिशमाविशन् .. 3 ..
16.61.m: O goddess, during the Cākṣuṣa Manvantara, when the Daityas of terrible might, / being struck down by Viṣṇu, entered the southern quarter,

16.61.s:
tatra varṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ daityāścakrurmahāhavam ..
viṣṇunā saha deveśi divyāstraiśca pṛthagvidhaiḥ .. 4 ..
16.61.d:
तत्र वर्षशतं साग्रं दैत्याश्चक्रुर्महाहवम् ..
विष्णुना सह देवेशि दिव्यास्त्रैश्च पृथग्विधैः .. 4 ..
16.61.m: there the Daityas waged a great battle for more than a hundred years / with Viṣṇu, O ruler of the gods, using various types of divine weapons.

16.61.s:
duḥkhavadhyāṃstato jñātvā viṣṇuḥ kamalalocanaḥ ..
sasmāra bhairavīṃ śaktiṃ mahāmāyāṃ mahāprabhām ..5..
16.61.d:
दुःखवध्यांस्ततो ज्ञात्वा विष्णुः कमललोचनः ..
सस्मार भैरवीं शक्तिं महामायां महाप्रभाम् ..5..
16.61.m: Knowing that they were difficult to slay, lotus-eyed Viṣṇu / remembered the terrible Śakti, the great illusive power of great radiance.

16.61.s:
sā smṛtā kṣaṇamātreṇa viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā..
tatrāgatā mahādevī ānaṃdasphuritekṣaṇā .. 6 ..
16.61.d:
सा स्मृता क्षणमात्रेण विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना..
तत्रागता महादेवी आनंदस्फुरितेक्षणा .. 6 ..
16.61.m: The moment she was remembered by the powerful Viṣṇu, / the great goddess arrived there, her eyes trembling with delight.

16.61.s:
viśāle tu kṛte devyā locane viṣṇudarśanāt ..
viśālākṣī tato jātā tatrasthā daityanāśinī ..7..
16.61.d:
विशाले तु कृते देव्या लोचने विष्णुदर्शनात् ..
विशालाक्षी ततो जाता तत्रस्था दैत्यनाशिनी ..7..
16.61.m: Since the goddess made her eyes wide upon seeing Viṣṇu, / she became Viśālākṣī, stationed there as the destroyer of the Daityas.

16.61.s:
asminkalpesamākhyātā lalitomā varānane ..
umādvayaṃ samākhyātaṃ someśe daityasūdane .. 8 ..
16.61.d:
अस्मिन्कल्पेसमाख्याता ललितोमा वरानने ..
उमाद्वयं समाख्यातं सोमेशे दैत्यसूदने .. 8 ..
16.61.m: In this kalpa she is known as Lalitā and Umā, O fair-faced one; / two forms of Umā are declared, at Someśa and at Daityasūdana.

16.61.s:
pūrvaṃ someśvare paśyetpaścācchrīdaityasūdane ..
umā dvayaṃ pūjayitvā tīrthayātrāphalaṃ labhet ..9..
16.61.d:
पूर्वं सोमेश्वरे पश्येत्पश्चाच्छ्रीदैत्यसूदने ..
उमा द्वयं पूजयित्वा तीर्थयात्राफलं लभेत् ..9..
16.61.m: One should first visit her at Someśvara, and afterwards at the illustrious Daityasūdana; / having worshipped the two forms of Umā, one obtains the fruit of pilgrimage to the sacred ford.

16.61.s:
māghe māsi tṛtīyāyāṃ vidhinā yo'rcayettu tām..
na saṃtativihīnaḥ syāttasyakoṭyanvaye naraḥ ..7.1.61.10..
16.61.d:
माघे मासि तृतीयायां विधिना योऽर्चयेत्तु ताम्..
न संततिविहीनः स्यात्तस्यकोट्यन्वये नरः ..7.1.61.10..
16.61.m: The man who worships her according to the rules on the third lunar day in the month of Māgha / will never be without offspring in ten million generations of his family.

16.61.s:
yo nityamīkṣate tatra bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ ..
ārogyasukhasaubhāgyasaṃyukto'sau bhavecciram .. 11 ..
16.61.d:
यो नित्यमीक्षते तत्र भक्त्या परमया युतः ..
आरोग्यसुखसौभाग्यसंयुक्तोऽसौ भवेच्चिरम् .. 11 ..
16.61.m: Whoever constantly looks upon her there endowed with supreme devotion / will long be endowed with health, happiness, and good fortune.

16.61.s:
iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ māhātmyaṃ lalitodbhavam..
śrutaṃ yatpāpanāśāya jāyate dharmavṛddhaye .. 12 ..
16.61.d:
इति संक्षेपतः प्रोक्तं माहात्म्यं ललितोद्भवम्..
श्रुतं यत्पापनाशाय जायते धर्मवृद्धये .. 12 ..
16.61.m: Thus has been proclaimed in brief the māhātmya originating from Lalitā, / which, when heard, leads to the destruction of sin and the increase of righteousness.

16.61.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsa kṣetramāhātmye lalitomāviśālākṣī māhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 61 ..
16.61.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां सहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभास क्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये ललितोमाविशालाक्षी माहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकषष्टितमोऽध्यायः .. 61 ..
16.61.m: Thus ends the sixty-first chapter, titled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Lalitā-Umā-Viśālākṣī', in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.62.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi tṛtīyāṃ catvarapriyām ..
lalitāpūrvadigbhāge daśadhanvaṃtare sthitām .. 1 ..
16.62.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि तृतीयां चत्वरप्रियाम् ..
ललितापूर्वदिग्भागे दशधन्वंतरे स्थिताम् .. 1 ..
16.62.m: Īśvara said: / Next, O great goddess, one should go to the third, Catvarapriyā, / situated ten bow-lengths to the east of Lalitā,

16.62.s:
kṣetradūtīṃ mahāraudrīṃ rudraśaktiṃ mahāprabhām ..
kṣetrarakṣāvidhau tatra mayā muktāṃ tu madhyataḥ .. 2 ..
16.62.d:
क्षेत्रदूतीं महारौद्रीं रुद्रशक्तिं महाप्रभाम् ..
क्षेत्ररक्षाविधौ तत्र मया मुक्तां तु मध्यतः .. 2 ..
16.62.m: the messenger of the sacred field, the terribly fierce Śakti of Rudra, endowed with great splendor, / dispatched by me into the midst of the sacred field for the sake of its protection.

16.62.s:
koṭibhūtasamāyuktā mahākāyā mahāprabhā ..
jīrṇe gṛhe tathodyāne prāsādāṭṭālake pathi .. 3 ..
16.62.d:
कोटिभूतसमायुक्ता महाकाया महाप्रभा ..
जीर्णे गृहे तथोद्याने प्रासादाट्टालके पथि .. 3 ..
16.62.m: Joined by ten million spirits, having a huge body, possessing great splendor, / in dilapidated houses, in gardens, in temples, watchtowers, and roads,

16.62.s:
catvareṣu ca sarveṣu kṣetra madhyasthitā satī ..
rātrau paryaṭate devī bhūtānāṃ koṭibhirvṛtā .. 4 ..
16.62.d:
चत्वरेषु च सर्वेषु क्षेत्र मध्यस्थिता सती ..
रात्रौ पर्यटते देवी भूतानां कोटिभिर्वृता .. 4 ..
16.62.m: and at all crossroads, residing in the middle of the sacred field, the faithful goddess / wanders at night surrounded by ten million spirits.

16.62.s:
mahānavamyāṃ yastatra nārī vātha naropi vā ..
nānāpūjopacāraiśca pūjayedvidhivacchubhām .. 5 ..
16.62.d:
महानवम्यां यस्तत्र नारी वाथ नरोपि वा ..
नानापूजोपचारैश्च पूजयेद्विधिवच्छुभाम् .. 5 ..
16.62.m: Whatever woman or man there on the Great Ninth lunar day / worships the auspicious goddess according to the rules with various ritual offerings,

16.62.s:
tasya tuṣṭā'khilānkāmānsādevī saṃpradāsyati ..
daṃpatyorbhojanaṃ tatra deyaṃ yātrāphalepsubhiḥ ..9..
iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ māhā tmyaṃ pāpanāśanam ..
kṣetradūtyāstṛtīyāyāḥ śrutamaiśvaryakārakam .. 7 ..
16.62.d:
तस्य तुष्टाऽखिलान्कामान्सादेवी संप्रदास्यति ..
दंपत्योर्भोजनं तत्र देयं यात्राफलेप्सुभिः ..9..
इति संक्षेपतः प्रोक्तं माहा त्म्यं पापनाशनम् ..
क्षेत्रदूत्यास्तृतीयायाः श्रुतमैश्वर्यकारकम् .. 7 ..
16.62.m:
the pleased goddess will grant all of their desires. / A meal should be given there to a married couple by those who wish for the fruit of the pilgrimage.
Thus has been proclaimed in brief the sin-destroying māhātmya / of the third messenger of the sacred field, which produces sovereignty when heard.

16.62.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye catvarādevīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dviṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 62 ..
16.62.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये चत्वरादेवीमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम द्विषष्टितमोऽध्यायः .. 62 ..
16.62.m: Thus ends the sixty-second chapter, titled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Catvarādevī', in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.63.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi bhairaveśvaramuttamam ..
yogeśvaryā dakṣiṇato nātidūre vyavasthitam .. 1 ..
16.63.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि भैरवेश्वरमुत्तमम् ..
योगेश्वर्या दक्षिणतो नातिदूरे व्यवस्थितम् .. 1 ..
16.63.m: Īśvara said: / Next, O great goddess, one should go to the supreme Bhairaveśvara, / situated not far to the south of Yogeśvarī.

16.63.s:
sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ dibyaiśvaryapradāyakam..
purā daityavināśārthaṃ yadā devī kṛtodyamā .. .. 2 ..
16.63.d:
सर्वपापप्रशमनं दिब्यैश्वर्यप्रदायकम्..
पुरा दैत्यविनाशार्थं यदा देवी कृतोद्यमा .. .. 2 ..
16.63.m:
It mitigates all sins and bestows divine sovereign power.
Formerly, when the Goddess made an effort to destroy the demons,

16.63.s:
tadā bhairavamāhūya dūtatve niyuyoja ha ..
śivadūtī tadā khyātā paścādyogeśvarīti ca .. 3 ..
16.63.d:
तदा भैरवमाहूय दूतत्वे नियुयोज ह ..
शिवदूती तदा ख्याता पश्चाद्योगेश्वरीति च .. 3 ..
16.63.m:
then, having summoned Bhairava, she dispatched him as a messenger.
She was then known as Śivadūtī, and later as Yogeśvarī.

16.63.s:
bhairavo yatra vai devyā dūtatve viniyojitaḥ ..
tena liṃgaṃ samākhyātaṃ bhairaveśvaranāmakam .. 4 ..
16.63.d:
भैरवो यत्र वै देव्या दूतत्वे विनियोजितः ..
तेन लिंगं समाख्यातं भैरवेश्वरनामकम् .. 4 ..
16.63.m:
Because Bhairava was appointed to messendership by the Goddess there,
the liṅga is called by the name Bhairaveśvara.

16.63.s:
pūjitaṃ devadaityaiśca bhairaveṇa pratiṣṭhitam ..
yastatpūjayate bhaktyā kārtikyāṃ vidhinā naraḥ ..
niraṃtaraṃ vā ṣaṇmāsaṃ so'bhīṣṭaṃ labhate phalam .. 5 ..
16.63.d:
पूजितं देवदैत्यैश्च भैरवेण प्रतिष्ठितम् ..
यस्तत्पूजयते भक्त्या कार्तिक्यां विधिना नरः ..
निरंतरं वा षण्मासं सोऽभीष्टं लभते फलम् .. 5 ..
16.63.m:
It was worshipped by gods and demons, and established by Bhairava.
The man who worships it with devotion according to rule on the full moon of Kārttika,
or continuously for six months, attains his desired fruit.

16.63.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye bhairaveśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma triṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāya .. 63 .. .. ..
16.63.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये भैरवेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम त्रिषष्टितमोऽध्याय .. 63 .. .. ..
16.63.m: Thus ends the sixty-third chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of Bhairaveśvara,' in the first [sub-section], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.64.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tasyaiva pūrvadigbhāge dhanuṣāṃ paṃcake sthitam ..
lakṣmīśvareti vikhyātaṃ dāridryaughavināśanam .. 1 ..
16.64.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तस्यैव पूर्वदिग्भागे धनुषां पंचके स्थितम् ..
लक्ष्मीश्वरेति विख्यातं दारिद्र्यौघविनाशनम् .. 1 ..
16.64.m:
Īśvara said:
In the eastern direction from that very [place], situated at a distance of five bows,
is the one known as Lakṣmīśvara, which destroys the flood of poverty,

16.64.s:
yatra devyā samānītā lakṣmīrdetyānnihatya ca ..
tena lakṣmīśvaraṃ nāma svayaṃ devyā pratiṣṭhitam .. 2 ..
16.64.d:
यत्र देव्या समानीता लक्ष्मीर्देत्यान्निहत्य च ..
तेन लक्ष्मीश्वरं नाम स्वयं देव्या प्रतिष्ठितम् .. 2 ..
16.64.m:
where Lakṣmī was brought by the Goddess after slaying the demons.
Therefore, it was named Lakṣmīśvara and established by the Goddess herself.

16.64.s:
yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā śrīpaṃcamyāṃ vidhānataḥ ..
na vimukto bhavellakṣmyā yāvanmanvataraṃ priye ..3..
16.64.d:
यस्तं पूजयते भक्त्या श्रीपंचम्यां विधानतः ..
न विमुक्तो भवेल्लक्ष्म्या यावन्मन्वतरं प्रिये ..3..
16.64.m:
He who worships it with devotion according to the prescribed rule on the Śrīpañcamī
is not separated from Lakṣmī for a manvantara, O beloved.

16.64.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye lakṣmīśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catuḥṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 64 ....
16.64.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीति साहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये लक्ष्मीश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम चतुःषष्टितमोऽध्यायः .. 64 ....
16.64.m: Thus ends the sixty-fourth chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of Lakṣmīśvara,' in the first [sub-section], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.65.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi liṃgaṃ vai vāḍaveśvaram ..
lakṣmīśāduttare bhāge viśālākṣyāśca dakṣiṇe .. 1 ..
16.65.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि लिंगं वै वाडवेश्वरम् ..
लक्ष्मीशादुत्तरे भागे विशालाक्ष्याश्च दक्षिणे .. 1 ..
16.65.m:
Īśvara said:
Then one should go, O great goddess, to the liṅga indeed called Vāḍaveśvara,
to the north of Lakṣmīśa and to the south of Viśālākṣī,

16.65.s:
sthitaṃ mahāprabhāvaṃ hi vāḍavena pratiṣṭhitam..
kṛtasmaro yadā dagdhaḥ parvato vāḍavāgninā .. 2 ..
16.65.d:
स्थितं महाप्रभावं हि वाडवेन प्रतिष्ठितम्..
कृतस्मरो यदा दग्धः पर्वतो वाडवाग्निना .. 2 ..
16.65.m:
which is situated there, possessed of great power, established by Vāḍava.
When the Kṛtasmara mountain was burnt by the submarine fire,

16.65.s:
samīkṛtyākhilaṃ sthānaṃ tena liṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ..
pūjayettaṃ vidhānena daśa saṃsnāpya śaṃkaram .. 3 ..
16.65.d:
समीकृत्याखिलं स्थानं तेन लिंगं प्रतिष्ठितम् ..
पूजयेत्तं विधानेन दश संस्नाप्य शंकरम् .. 3 ..
16.65.m:
having leveled the entire place, he established that liṅga.
One should worship that Śaṃkara according to rule after bathing him ten times.

16.65.s:
dadhi dadyācca vai tatra brāhmaṇe vedapārage.
so'gnilokamavāpnoti samyagyātrāphalaṃ labhet .. 4 ..
16.65.d:
दधि दद्याच्च वै तत्र ब्राह्मणे वेदपारगे.
सोऽग्निलोकमवाप्नोति सम्यग्यात्राफलं लभेत् .. 4 ..
16.65.m:
And one should give curds there to a brahmin who has mastered the Vedas.
He attains the world of Agni and receives the full fruit of the pilgrimage.

16.65.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye vāḍaveśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ..65 ..
16.65.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये वाडवेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम पञ्चषष्टितमोऽध्यायः ..65 ..
16.65.m: Thus ends the sixty-fifth chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of Vāḍaveśvara,' in the first [sub-section], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.66.s:
.. .. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahāliṃgamarghyeśvaramiti śrutam ..
uttare tu viśālākṣyā nātidūre vyavasthitam .. 1 ..
16.66.d:
.. .. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महालिंगमर्घ्येश्वरमिति श्रुतम् ..
उत्तरे तु विशालाक्ष्या नातिदूरे व्यवस्थितम् .. 1 ..
16.66.m:
Īśvara said:
Then one should go to the great liṅga known as Arghyeśvara,
situated to the north of Viśālākṣī, not very far away,

16.66.s:
liṃgaṃ mahāprabhāvaṃ hi suragandharvapūjitam ..
yadā devī samāyātā vaḍavānaladhāriṇī .. 2 ..
16.66.d:
लिंगं महाप्रभावं हि सुरगन्धर्वपूजितम् ..
यदा देवी समायाता वडवानलधारिणी .. 2 ..
16.66.m:
a liṅga of great power, worshipped by gods and gandharvas.
When the Goddess carrying the submarine fire arrived,

16.66.s:
prabhāsakṣetramāsādya dṛṣṭvā tatra mahodadhim ..
arghyaṃ dattavatī tatra vidhinā tanmahodadheḥ .. 3 ..
16.66.d:
प्रभासक्षेत्रमासाद्य दृष्ट्वा तत्र महोदधिम् ..
अर्घ्यं दत्तवती तत्र विधिना तन्महोदधेः .. 3 ..
16.66.m:
having reached the sacred field of Prabhāsa and seeing the great ocean there,
she offered an arghya offering to that great ocean according to rule.

16.66.s:
pratiṣṭhāpya mahalliṃgaṃ saṃpūjya vidhinā tataḥ ..
praviveśātha deveśi snānārthaṃ ca mahodadhau .. 4 ..
16.66.d:
प्रतिष्ठाप्य महल्लिंगं संपूज्य विधिना ततः ..
प्रविवेशाथ देवेशि स्नानार्थं च महोदधौ .. 4 ..
16.66.m:
Then, having established the great liṅga and worshipped it according to rule,
she entered into the great ocean for a ritual ablution, O ruler of gods.

16.66.s:
yasmādarghyaṃ purā dattvā paścādīśaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ ..
tenārghyeśeti vikhyātaṃ liṃgaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam .. 5 ..
16.66.d:
यस्मादर्घ्यं पुरा दत्त्वा पश्चादीशः प्रतिष्ठितः ..
तेनार्घ्येशेति विख्यातं लिंगं पापप्रणाशनम् .. 5 ..
16.66.m:
Because an arghya was offered first and the Lord was established afterwards,
therefore the liṅga which destroys sin is known as Arghyeśa.

16.66.s:
paṃcāmṛtena saṃsnāpya vidhinā yastamarcayet ..
saptajanmāni deveśi sa vidyāmadhigacchati ..
samyakchāstrapravaktā ca sarvasaṃdehavittamaḥ .. 6 ..
16.66.d:
पंचामृतेन संस्नाप्य विधिना यस्तमर्चयेत् ..
सप्तजन्मानि देवेशि स विद्यामधिगच्छति ..
सम्यक्छास्त्रप्रवक्ता च सर्वसंदेहवित्तमः .. 6 ..
16.66.m:
He who bathes it with the five nectars and worships it according to rule,
he attains learning for seven births, O ruler of gods,
and becomes a proper expositor of the scriptures and the best knower of all doubts.

16.66.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye'rghyeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 66 ..
16.66.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्येऽर्घ्येश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षट्षष्टितमोऽध्यायः .. 66 ..
16.66.m: Thus ends the sixty-sixth chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of Arghyeśvara,' in the first [sub-section], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.67.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gachenmahāliṃgaṃ kāmeśvaramiti śrutam ..
kāmenārādhitaṃ pūrvaṃ daityasūdanapaścime .. 1 ..
16.67.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गछेन्महालिंगं कामेश्वरमिति श्रुतम् ..
कामेनाराधितं पूर्वं दैत्यसूदनपश्चिमे .. 1 ..
16.67.m:
Īśvara said:
Then one should go to the great liṅga known as Kāmeśvara,
previously worshipped by Kāma to the west of Daityasūdana.

16.67.s:
dhanuṣāṃ saptake tatra sthitaṃ devi mahāprabham ..
nirdagdhastu yadā kāma stṛtīyenāgninā mama .. 2 ..
16.67.d:
धनुषां सप्तके तत्र स्थितं देवि महाप्रभम् ..
निर्दग्धस्तु यदा काम स्तृतीयेनाग्निना मम .. 2 ..
16.67.m:
Situated there at a distance of seven bows, O goddess, it has great splendour.
When Kāma was burnt by my third fire,

16.67.s:
tadā varṣasahasraṃ tu samārādhya maheśvaram ..
prapede kāmanāsargaṃ yatrānaṃgaḥ purā kila .. 3 ..
16.67.d:
तदा वर्षसहस्रं तु समाराध्य महेश्वरम् ..
प्रपेदे कामनासर्गं यत्रानंगः पुरा किल .. 3 ..
16.67.m:
then, having propitiated Maheśvara for a thousand years,
the bodiless [Kāma] indeed formerly attained the realm of desire there.

16.67.s:
tena kāmeśvaraṃnāma khyātaṃ liṃgaṃ dharātale ..
sarvapāpaharaṃ devi sarvakāmaphalapradam .. 4 ..
16.67.d:
तेन कामेश्वरंनाम ख्यातं लिंगं धरातले ..
सर्वपापहरं देवि सर्वकामफलप्रदम् .. 4 ..
16.67.m:
Therefore the liṅga became known as Kāmeśvara upon the earth;
it removes all sins, O goddess, and bestows the fruits of all desires.

16.67.s:
trayodaśyāṃ vidhānena śuklāyāṃ māsi mādhave ..
saṃpūjya taṃ vidhānena sa strīṇāṃ kāmavadbhavet.. 5 ..
16.67.d:
त्रयोदश्यां विधानेन शुक्लायां मासि माधवे ..
संपूज्य तं विधानेन स स्त्रीणां कामवद्भवेत्.. 5 ..
16.67.m:
Having worshipped it according to rule on the thirteenth lunar day of the bright fortnight in the month of Mādhava,
he becomes like Kāma to women.

16.67.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasyā saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kāmeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ..67..
16.67.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्या संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये कामेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम सप्तषष्टितमोऽध्यायः ..67..
16.67.m: Thus ends the sixty-seventh chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of Kāmeśvara,' in the first [sub-section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.68.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
iti proktāni te devi vaktraliṃgāni paṃca vai ..
atha te saṃpravakṣyāmi yatra gauryāstapo vanam..
sthānaṃ mahāprabhāvaṃ hi surasiddhaniṣevitam.. 1 ..
16.68.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
इति प्रोक्तानि ते देवि वक्त्रलिंगानि पंच वै ..
अथ ते संप्रवक्ष्यामि यत्र गौर्यास्तपो वनम्..
स्थानं महाप्रभावं हि सुरसिद्धनिषेवितम्.. 1 ..
16.68.m:
Īśvara said:
Thus have the five face-liṅgas been declared to you, O goddess.
Now I shall tell you where the penance-forest of Gaurī is,
a place of great power, frequented by gods and siddhas,

16.68.s:
someśātpūrvadigbhāge ṣaṣṭidhanvaṃtare sthitam ..
yatra devyā tapastaptaṃ satyā vai pūrvajanmani .. .. 2 ..
16.68.d:
सोमेशात्पूर्वदिग्भागे षष्टिधन्वंतरे स्थितम् ..
यत्र देव्या तपस्तप्तं सत्या वै पूर्वजन्मनि .. .. 2 ..
16.68.m:
situated to the east of Someśa at a distance of sixty bows,
where austerity was performed by the goddess Satī in a previous birth.

16.68.s:
kṛtvā ca praṇayātkopaṃ mayā sārddhaṃ varānane ..
prabhāsakṣetramāsādya saṃsthitā sā tapasvinī .. 3 ..
16.68.d:
कृत्वा च प्रणयात्कोपं मया सार्द्धं वरानने ..
प्रभासक्षेत्रमासाद्य संस्थिता सा तपस्विनी .. 3 ..
16.68.m:
Having become angry out of love with me, O fair-faced one,
she, becoming an ascetic woman, reached the sacred field of Prabhāsa and stayed there.

16.68.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
kimarthaṃ sā parityajya satī tvāṃ tapasi sthitā ..
kasminsthāne sthitā devī etanme vistarādvada .. 4 ..
16.68.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
किमर्थं सा परित्यज्य सती त्वां तपसि स्थिता ..
कस्मिन्स्थाने स्थिता देवी एतन्मे विस्तराद्वद .. 4 ..
16.68.m:
The Goddess said:
Why did Satī abandon you and dedicate herself to austerity?
In which place did the goddess stay? Tell me this in detail.

16.68.s:
.. īcara.uvāca .. ..
purā''sīstvaṃ mahādevi śyāmavarṇā manasvinī ..
nāmārthaṃ ca mayā proktā kālīti rahasi sthitā .. 5 ..
16.68.d:
.. ईचर.उवाच .. ..
पुरा'ऽसीस्त्वं महादेवि श्यामवर्णा मनस्विनी ..
नामार्थं च मया प्रोक्ता कालीति रहसि स्थिता .. 5 ..
16.68.m:
Īśvara said:
Formerly, O great goddess, you were dark-complexioned and proud-minded.
And as a name, you were addressed by me as 'Kālī' while in secret.

16.68.s:
sā śrutvā vismayaṃ vākyaṃ bhṛśaṃ roṣaparāyaṇā ..
abravītparuṣaṃ vākyaṃ bhṛkuṭī kuṭilānanā..6..
16.68.d:
सा श्रुत्वा विस्मयं वाक्यं भृशं रोषपरायणा ..
अब्रवीत्परुषं वाक्यं भृकुटी कुटिलानना..6..
16.68.m:
Hearing that word in astonishment, extremely overcome with anger,
with a face crooked with knitted brows, she spoke harsh words:

16.68.s:
yasmātkālītyahaṃ proktā tvayā śaṃbho'tiviplavāt..
tasmādyāsyāmi gaurīti bhaviṣyāmi ca yatra hi..7..
16.68.d:
यस्मात्कालीत्यहं प्रोक्ता त्वया शंभोऽतिविप्लवात्..
तस्माद्यास्यामि गौरीति भविष्यामि च यत्र हि..7..
16.68.m:
‘Because I was called “Kālī” by you, O Śambhu, out of great transgression,
therefore I shall go and become Gaurī where [I can].’

16.68.s:
evamuktvā mahābhāgā sakhīgaṇasamāvṛtā..
gatvā prabhāsakṣetraṃ sā pratiṣṭhāpya maheśvaram..
gaurīśvareti vikhyātaṃ pūjayaṃtī vidhānataḥ..8..
16.68.d:
एवमुक्त्वा महाभागा सखीगणसमावृता..
गत्वा प्रभासक्षेत्रं सा प्रतिष्ठाप्य महेश्वरम्..
गौरीश्वरेति विख्यातं पूजयंती विधानतः..8..
16.68.m:
Having spoken thus, the fortunate one, surrounded by a host of female friends,
went to the sacred field of Prabhāsa and, having installed Maheśvara
known as Gaurīśvara, worshipped him according to rule.

16.68.s:
tato liṃgasamīpasthā ekapāde sthitā satī ..
liṃgamārādhayaṃtī sā cakāra sumahattapaḥ .. 9 ..
16.68.d:
ततो लिंगसमीपस्था एकपादे स्थिता सती ..
लिंगमाराधयंती सा चकार सुमहत्तपः .. 9 ..
16.68.m:
Then Satī, standing near the liṅga on one foot
and worshipping the liṅga, performed very severe austerity.

16.68.s:
paṃcāgnisādhikā devī grīṣma jāpyaparāyaṇā ..
varṣāsvākāśaśayanā hemaṃte salilāśayā .. 7.1.68.10 ..
16.68.d:
पंचाग्निसाधिका देवी ग्रीष्म जाप्यपरायणा ..
वर्षास्वाकाशशयना हेमंते सलिलाशया .. 7.1.68.10 ..
16.68.m:
Practicing the austerity of the five fires in summer, devoted to recitation,
sleeping in the open air during the rains, and dwelling in water during winter,

16.68.s:
yathā yathā tapo vṛddhiṃ yāti tasyā mahāprabhā ..
tathātathā śarīrasya gauratvaṃ pratipadyate .. 11 ..
16.68.d:
यथा यथा तपो वृद्धिं याति तस्या महाप्रभा ..
तथातथा शरीरस्य गौरत्वं प्रतिपद्यते .. 11 ..
16.68.m:
in proportion as the austerity of that illustrious one increased,
in that same measure her body attained fair complexion.

16.68.s:
kālena mahatā gaurī sarvāṃgeṇātha sā'bhavat ..
tato vihasya bhagavānuvāca śaśiśekharaḥ .. 12 ..
16.68.d:
कालेन महता गौरी सर्वांगेणाथ साऽभवत् ..
ततो विहस्य भगवानुवाच शशिशेखरः .. 12 ..
16.68.m: In the course of great time, she became fair-complexioned in every limb. / Then the Lord who wears the crescent moon smiled and spoke:

16.68.s:
gaurīti ca muhurvākyamuttiṣṭha vraja mandiram ..
varaṃ varaya kalyāṇi yatte manasi varttate .. 13 ..
16.68.d:
गौरीति च मुहुर्वाक्यमुत्तिष्ठ व्रज मन्दिरम् ..
वरं वरय कल्याणि यत्ते मनसि वर्त्तते .. 13 ..
16.68.m: Saying repeatedly, ‘Gaurī! Arise, go to your abode! / Choose a boon, O auspicious lady, whatever is in your heart!’

16.68.s:
gauryuvāca .. ..
yo māmatra sthitāṃ paśyennārī vā puruṣo'tha vā ..
sa bhūyātsutasaubhāgyaiḥ saptajanmāni saṃyutaḥ .. .. 14 ..
16.68.d:
गौर्युवाच .. ..
यो मामत्र स्थितां पश्येन्नारी वा पुरुषोऽथ वा ..
स भूयात्सुतसौभाग्यैः सप्तजन्मानि संयुतः .. .. 14 ..
16.68.m: Gaurī said: / ‘Whatever woman or man should see me standing here, / let that person be endowed with sons and good fortune for seven lives.

16.68.s:
gītavādyādikaṃ nṛtyaṃ yaḥ kuryātpurato mama ..
tasyānvaye na daurbhāgyaṃ bhūyāttava prasādataḥ .. 15 ..
16.68.d:
गीतवाद्यादिकं नृत्यं यः कुर्यात्पुरतो मम ..
तस्यान्वये न दौर्भाग्यं भूयात्तव प्रसादतः .. 15 ..
16.68.m: Whoever performs singing, instrumental music, dance, and the like before me, / in their lineage let there be no misfortune, through your grace.

16.68.s:
mayā pratiṣṭhitaṃ liṃgaṃ pūrvamabhyarcya māṃ tataḥ..
pūjayiṣyati yo bhaktyā sa yāsyati paraṃ padam .. 16 ..
16.68.d:
मया प्रतिष्ठितं लिंगं पूर्वमभ्यर्च्य मां ततः..
पूजयिष्यति यो भक्त्या स यास्यति परं पदम् .. 16 ..
16.68.m: The liṅga installed by me—having first worshipped me and then it, / whoever worships it with devotion shall go to the supreme abode.

16.68.s:
gaurīśvareti vikhyātaṃ nāma tasya bhavetprabho ..
tathetyahaṃ pratijñāya tatra sthāne sthito 'bhavam .. 17 ..
16.68.d:
गौरीश्वरेति विख्यातं नाम तस्य भवेत्प्रभो ..
तथेत्यहं प्रतिज्ञाय तत्र स्थाने स्थितो ऽभवम् .. 17 ..
16.68.m: Its name, O Lord, shall become renowned as Gaurīśvara.’ / Having promised, ‘So be it,’ I took up residence in that place,

16.68.s:
devyā saha mahādevi prahṛṣṭenāṃtarātmanā ..
adyāpi ayane prāpte uttare dakṣiṇe'pi vā .. 18 ..
16.68.d:
देव्या सह महादेवि प्रहृष्टेनांतरात्मना ..
अद्यापि अयने प्राप्ते उत्तरे दक्षिणेऽपि वा .. 18 ..
16.68.m: along with the goddess, O Great Goddess, with a delighted inner soul. / Even today, when the northern or southern solstice arrives,

16.68.s:
gaurīṃsthānaṃ samabhyeti tatra deva guṇairyutaḥ..
tasminnahani yastatra viśiṣṭāni phalāni ca ..
saṃprayacchati viprebhyastasya putrā bhavaṃti ca .. 19 ..
16.68.d:
गौरींस्थानं समभ्येति तत्र देव गुणैर्युतः..
तस्मिन्नहनि यस्तत्र विशिष्टानि फलानि च ..
संप्रयच्छति विप्रेभ्यस्तस्य पुत्रा भवंति च .. 19 ..
16.68.m: the deity, endowed with virtues, comes to the abode of Gaurī there. / On that day, whoever offers excellent fruits there / to brahmins, sons will be born to him.

16.68.s:
putrahīnā tu yā nārī nālikeraṃ prayacchati ..
putraṃ sā labhate śīghraṃ sabalaṃ lakṣaṇānvitam .. 7.1.68.20 ..
16.68.d:
पुत्रहीना तु या नारी नालिकेरं प्रयच्छति ..
पुत्रं सा लभते शीघ्रं सबलं लक्षणान्वितम् .. 7.1.68.20 ..
16.68.m: A sonless woman who offers a coconut / quickly obtains a strong son endowed with auspicious marks.

16.68.s:
ghṛtena dīpakaṃ tatra yā nārī saṃprayacchati ..
raktavarttyā mahādevi yāvattasyaiva taṃtava .. .. 21 ..
16.68.d:
घृतेन दीपकं तत्र या नारी संप्रयच्छति ..
रक्तवर्त्त्या महादेवि यावत्तस्यैव तंतव .. .. 21 ..
16.68.m: The woman who offers a lamp with ghee there, / with a red wick, O Great Goddess, for as many threads as it has,

16.68.s: tāvajjanmāṃtarāṇyeva sā saubhāgyamavāpnuyāt .. 22 ..
16.68.d: तावज्जन्मांतराण्येव सा सौभाग्यमवाप्नुयात् .. 22 ..
16.68.m: for that many future births she will obtain good fortune.

16.68.s:
yā nṛtyaṃ kurute tatra bhaktyā paramayā yutā ..
ārogyasukhasaubhāgyaiḥ saṃyuktā sā bhavecciram .. 23 ..
16.68.d:
या नृत्यं कुरुते तत्र भक्त्या परमया युता ..
आरोग्यसुखसौभाग्यैः संयुक्ता सा भवेच्चिरम् .. 23 ..
16.68.m: She who dances there endowed with supreme devotion / shall long remain endowed with health, happiness, and good fortune.

16.68.s:
tatrāṃte sumahatkuḍaṃ tīrthaṃ svacchodapūritam ..
yaḥ snānamācarettatra mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ .. 24 ..
16.68.d:
तत्रांते सुमहत्कुडं तीर्थं स्वच्छोदपूरितम् ..
यः स्नानमाचरेत्तत्र मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः .. 24 ..
16.68.m: At the edge of that place is a very large pool, a sacred ford filled with pure water; / whoever performs a ritual ablution there is freed from all sins.

16.68.s:
yaḥ śrāddhaṃ kurute tatra pitṝnuddiśya bhaktitaḥ ..
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ pitṛbhiḥ saha puṇyabhāk .. 25 ..
16.68.d:
यः श्राद्धं कुरुते तत्र पितॄनुद्दिश्य भक्तितः ..
स याति परमं स्थानं पितृभिः सह पुण्यभाक् .. 25 ..
16.68.m: Whoever performs a śrāddha there dedicated to the ancestors with devotion / goes to the supreme abode along with the ancestors, sharing in merit.

16.68.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena śrāddhaṃ tatra samācaret ..
gītavādyādibhirnṛtyai rātrau kurvīta jāgaram .. 26..
16.68.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन श्राद्धं तत्र समाचरेत् ..
गीतवाद्यादिभिर्नृत्यै रात्रौ कुर्वीत जागरम् .. 26..
16.68.m: Therefore, by every effort one should perform a śrāddha there; / with songs, musical instruments, and dances, one should keep vigil at night.

16.68.s:
daṃpatyoḥ paridhānaṃ ca tatra deyaṃ sadakṣiṇam ..
yaścaitatpaṭhate nityaṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ viśeṣataḥ ..
pārvatyāḥ purato devi sa saubhāgyamavāpnuyāt ]. 27 ..
16.68.d:
दंपत्योः परिधानं च तत्र देयं सदक्षिणम् ..
यश्चैतत्पठते नित्यं तृतीयायां विशेषतः ..
पार्वत्याः पुरतो देवि स सौभाग्यमवाप्नुयात् ]. 27 ..
16.68.m: Clothing along with a priestly gift should be given there to a married couple. / And whoever constantly recites this, especially on the third lunar day, / in front of Pārvatī, O goddess, will obtain good fortune.

16.68.s:
śṛṇuyādvā'pi yo bhaktyā samyagbhaktiparāyaṇaḥ ..
so'pi saubhāgyamāpnoti yāvajjīvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ .. 28 ..
16.68.d:
शृणुयाद्वाऽपि यो भक्त्या सम्यग्भक्तिपरायणः ..
सोऽपि सौभाग्यमाप्नोति यावज्जीवं न संशयः .. 28 ..
16.68.m: Or whoever hears it with devotion, completely dedicated to devotion, / he too obtains good fortune as long as he lives, there is no doubt.

16.68.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye gaurītapovanamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. .. 68 ..
16.68.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये गौरीतपोवनमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामाष्टषष्टितमोऽध्यायः .. .. 68 ..
16.68.m: Thus ends the sixty-eighth chapter, named ‘Description of the Māhātmya of the Penance Grove of Gaurī,’ in the first [sub-section], Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.69.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
gaurīśvareti vikhyātaṃ yattvayā liṃgamuttamam ..
kutra tiṣṭhati talliṃgaṃ pūjitaṃ yatphalaṃ labhet .. 1 ..
16.69.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
गौरीश्वरेति विख्यातं यत्त्वया लिंगमुत्तमम् ..
कुत्र तिष्ठति तल्लिंगं पूजितं यत्फलं लभेत् .. 1 ..
16.69.m: The goddess said: / ‘The excellent liṅga celebrated as Gaurīśvara which was mentioned by you, / where does that liṅga stand, and what fruit does one obtain when it is worshipped?’

16.69.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi māhātmyaṃ pāpanārānam ..
gaurīśvarasya devasya sarvakāmapradasya vai .. 2 ..
16.69.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि माहात्म्यं पापनारानम् ..
गौरीश्वरस्य देवस्य सर्वकामप्रदस्य वै .. 2 ..
16.69.m: Īśvara said: / ‘Listen, O goddess, I shall proclaim the sin-destroying māhātmya / of the deity Gaurīśvara, who indeed grants all desires.

16.69.s:
idaṃ tapovanaṃ devi khyātaṃ gauryā mahāprabham ..
dhanuṣāṃ pacapaṃcāśatsamaṃtātparimaṃḍalam ..3..
16.69.d:
इदं तपोवनं देवि ख्यातं गौर्या महाप्रभम् ..
धनुषां पचपंचाशत्समंतात्परिमंडलम् ..3..
16.69.m: This penance grove, O goddess, renowned for Gaurī, is exceedingly splendid, / fifty-five bow-lengths in circumference all around.

16.69.s:
tatra madhye sthitā devī ekapādā taponvitā ..
tasyā uttarato devi kiṃcidīśānasaṃsthitam.. ..4 ..
16.69.d:
तत्र मध्ये स्थिता देवी एकपादा तपोन्विता ..
तस्या उत्तरतो देवि किंचिदीशानसंस्थितम्.. ..4 ..
16.69.m: In its center stands the goddess on one foot, engaged in austerity. / To the north of her, O goddess, situated slightly to the northeast,

16.69.s:
dhanuṣāṃ caturaṃte ca liṃgaṃ pāpabhayāpaham ..
yastatpūjayate bhaktyā liṃgaṃ bhaktiyuto naraḥ ..
kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ viśeṣeṇa sa muktaḥ pātakairbhavet .. 5 ..
16.69.d:
धनुषां चतुरंते च लिंगं पापभयापहम् ..
यस्तत्पूजयते भक्त्या लिंगं भक्तियुतो नरः ..
कृष्णाष्टम्यां विशेषेण स मुक्तः पातकैर्भवेत् .. 5 ..
