16.69.m: at a distance of four bow-lengths, is the liṅga that dispels the fear of sin. / The devoted man who worships that liṅga with devotion, / especially on the eighth day of the dark fortnight, will be freed from sins.

16.69.s:
godānaṃ cātra śaṃsaṃti suvarṇaṃ dvijapuṃgave ..
annadānaṃ viśeṣeṇa sarvapāpapraśāṃtaye .. 6 ..
16.69.d:
गोदानं चात्र शंसंति सुवर्णं द्विजपुंगवे ..
अन्नदानं विशेषेण सर्वपापप्रशांतये .. 6 ..
16.69.m: They praise the gift of a cow here, and gold to an eminent twice-born; / especially the gift of food, for the pacification of all sins.

16.69.s:
goghno vā brahmahā vā'pi tathā duṣkṛtakarmakṛt ..
sarva pāpaiḥ pramucyeta tasya liṃgasya darśanāt .. 7 ..
16.69.d:
गोघ्नो वा ब्रह्महा वाऽपि तथा दुष्कृतकर्मकृत् ..
सर्व पापैः प्रमुच्येत तस्य लिंगस्य दर्शनात् .. 7 ..
16.69.m: Whether a slayer of a cow, a slayer of a brahmin, or a committer of wicked deeds, / he is freed from all sins by the darśana of that liṅga.’

16.69.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsa kṣetramāhātmye gaurīśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 69 ..
16.69.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभास क्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये गौरीश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकोनसप्ततितमोऽध्यायः .. 69 ..
16.69.m: Thus ends the sixty-ninth chapter, named ‘Description of the Māhātmya of Gaurīśvara,’ in the first [sub-section], Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.70.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi varuṇeśvaramuttamam ..
gaurītapovanāgneyyāṃ dhanuṣāṃ viṃśatau sthitam ..
liṃgaṃ mahāprabhāvaṃ hi varuṇena pratiṣṭhitam .. 1 ..
16.70.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि वरुणेश्वरमुत्तमम् ..
गौरीतपोवनाग्नेय्यां धनुषां विंशतौ स्थितम् ..
लिंगं महाप्रभावं हि वरुणेन प्रतिष्ठितम् .. 1 ..
16.70.m: Īśvara said: / ‘Then one should go, O Great Goddess, to the excellent Varuṇeśvara, / situated twenty bow-lengths southeast of Gaurī’s penance grove, / a liṅga of great power indeed, installed by Varuṇa.

16.70.s:
pūrvaṃ pīto yadā devi samudraḥ kumbhajanmanā ..
tadā kopena santapto varuṇaḥ saritāṃ patiḥ .. 2 ..
16.70.d:
पूर्वं पीतो यदा देवि समुद्रः कुम्भजन्मना ..
तदा कोपेन सन्तप्तो वरुणः सरितां पतिः .. 2 ..
16.70.m: Formerly, O goddess, when the ocean was drunk by the pot-born [Agastya], / then Varuṇa, the lord of rivers, was afflicted with wrath.

16.70.s:
kāmikaṃ tu samājñāya kṣetraṃ prābhāsikaṃ tadā ..
tatrātapaddevi tapaḥ sa vai paramaduścaram .. 3 ..
16.70.d:
कामिकं तु समाज्ञाय क्षेत्रं प्राभासिकं तदा ..
तत्रातपद्देवि तपः स वै परमदुश्चरम् .. 3 ..
16.70.m: Recognizing the sacred field of Prabhāsa as fulfilling all desires, / he then performed most difficult austerity there, O goddess.

16.70.s:
pratiṣṭhāpya mahāliṃgaṃ saṃpūjayati bhaktitaḥ ..
varṣāṇāmayutaṃ sāgraṃ pūjito vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ .. 4 ..
16.70.d:
प्रतिष्ठाप्य महालिंगं संपूजयति भक्तितः ..
वर्षाणामयुतं साग्रं पूजितो वृषभध्वजः .. 4 ..
16.70.m: Having installed the great liṅga, he worshipped it with devotion; / for more than ten thousand years the bull-bannered [Śiva] was worshipped.

16.70.s:
tataḥ prasanno deveśi nijagaṃgājalena tu ..
pūrayāmāsa taṃ riktaṃ samudraṃ yādasāṃpatim .. 5 ..
16.70.d:
ततः प्रसन्नो देवेशि निजगंगाजलेन तु ..
पूरयामास तं रिक्तं समुद्रं यादसांपतिम् .. 5 ..
16.70.m: Then, being pleased, O ruler of gods, with the waters of his own Gaṅgā, / he filled that empty ocean, the lord of aquatic creatures.

16.70.s:
chaṃdayāmāsa taṃ liṃgaṃ varadānairanekadhā ..
tatprabhṛtyeva te sarve samudrāḥ paripūritāḥ .. 6 ..
16.70.d:
छंदयामास तं लिंगं वरदानैरनेकधा ..
तत्प्रभृत्येव ते सर्वे समुद्राः परिपूरिताः .. 6 ..
16.70.m: He gratified that liṅga with many boons; / from that time onward, all those oceans were completely filled.
From that time forward, that liṅga came to be known by the name Varuṇeśvara.

16.70.s:
ko hyartho bahubhirliṃgairdṛṣṭairvā surasundari ..
varuṇeśena dṛṣṭena sarvatīrthaphalaṃ labhet .. 8 ..
16.70.d:
को ह्यर्थो बहुभिर्लिंगैर्दृष्टैर्वा सुरसुन्दरि ..
वरुणेशेन दृष्टेन सर्वतीर्थफलं लभेत् .. 8 ..
16.70.m: For what need is there of many liṅgas seen, O beautiful lady among the gods? / When Varuṇeśa is seen, one obtains the fruit of all sacred fords.

16.70.s:
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ taddadhnā snāpayedyadi ..
sa brāhmaṇaścaturvedo jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 9 ..
16.70.d:
अष्टम्यां च चतुर्दश्यां तद्दध्ना स्नापयेद्यदि ..
स ब्राह्मणश्चतुर्वेदो जायते नात्र संशयः .. 9 ..
16.70.m: If on the eighth or fourteenth [lunar day] one bathes it with curd, / he is born as a brahmin knowing the four Vedas, there is no doubt here.

16.70.s:
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāścānye varānane ..
mūkāṃdhabadhirā bālāḥ striyaścaiva napuṃsakāḥ .. 7.1.70.10 ..
16.70.d:
ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया वैश्याः शूद्राश्चान्ये वरानने ..
मूकांधबधिरा बालाः स्त्रियश्चैव नपुंसकाः .. 7.1.70.10 ..
16.70.m: Brahmins, kṣatriyas, vaiśyas, śūdras, and others, O lovely-faced one— / the mute, the blind, the deaf, children, women, and eunuchs—

16.70.s:
dṛṣṭvā gacchaṃti te devi svargaṃ dharmaparāyaṇāḥ ..
snānaṃ jāpyaṃ baliṃ homaṃ pūjāṃ stotraṃ ca nartanam ..
tasminsthāne tu yaḥ kuryāttatsarvaṃ cākṣayaṃ bhavet .. 11 ..
16.70.d:
दृष्ट्वा गच्छंति ते देवि स्वर्गं धर्मपरायणाः ..
स्नानं जाप्यं बलिं होमं पूजां स्तोत्रं च नर्तनम् ..
तस्मिन्स्थाने तु यः कुर्यात्तत्सर्वं चाक्षयं भवेत् .. 11 ..
16.70.m: having seen it, devoted to righteousness, they go to heaven, O goddess. / Bathing, chanting, sacrificial offering, oblations into fire, worship, praise, and dancing / that one performs in that place—all that becomes imperishable.

16.70.s:
haimaṃ padmaṃ mauktikaṃ ca dānaṃ tatraiva dāpayet ..
samyagyātrāphalāpekṣī svargāpekṣī tathā naraḥ .. 12 ..
16.70.d:
हैमं पद्मं मौक्तिकं च दानं तत्रैव दापयेत् ..
सम्यग्यात्राफलापेक्षी स्वर्गापेक्षी तथा नरः .. 12 ..
16.70.m: One should offer a golden lotus and a pearl as gifts in that very place, / a person desiring the full fruit of pilgrimage as well as heaven.’

16.70.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye varuṇeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. .. 70 ..
16.70.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये वरुणेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम सप्ततितमोऽध्यायः .. .. 70 ..
16.70.m: Thus ends the seventieth chapter, named ‘Description of the Māhātmya of Varuṇeśvara,’ in the first [sub-section], Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.71.s:
tato gacchenmahādevi liṃgaṃ tatraiva saṃsthitam ..
dakṣiṇe varuṇeśasya dhanuṣāṃ tritaye sthitam ..1..
16.71.d:
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि लिंगं तत्रैव संस्थितम् ..
दक्षिणे वरुणेशस्य धनुषां त्रितये स्थितम् ..1..
16.71.m: Then, O great goddess, one should go to the liṅga situated right there, / situated three bow-lengths to the south of Varuṇeśa.

16.71.s:
bhāryayā varuṇasyaiva uṣā nāmnyā varānane ..
kṛtvā tapo mahāghoraṃ bhartṛduḥkhaparītayā .. 2 ..
16.71.d:
भार्यया वरुणस्यैव उषा नाम्न्या वरानने ..
कृत्वा तपो महाघोरं भर्तृदुःखपरीतया .. 2 ..
16.71.m: By the wife of Varuṇa named Uṣā, O fair-faced one, / having performed very terrible austerity when overcome with sorrow for her husband,

16.71.s:
sthāpitaṃ tu mahalliṃgaṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakam..
uṣeśvareti vikhyātaṃ sarvasiddhiprapūjitam ..3..
16.71.d:
स्थापितं तु महल्लिंगं सर्वसिद्धिप्रदायकम्..
उषेश्वरेति विख्यातं सर्वसिद्धिप्रपूजितम् ..3..
16.71.m: the great liṅga was established, which grants all perfections, / renowned as Uṣeśvara and worshipped by all the perfected ones.

16.71.s:
yastatpūjayate bhaktyā liṃgaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam ..
mahāpāpaughayukto'pi sa gacchetparamāṃ gatim ..4..
16.71.d:
यस्तत्पूजयते भक्त्या लिंगं पापप्रणाशनम् ..
महापापौघयुक्तोऽपि स गच्छेत्परमां गतिम् ..4..
16.71.m: He who worships with devotion that liṅga which destroys sin, / even though laden with a multitude of great sins, goes to the supreme state.
It yields the fruit of good fortune for women, and destroys grief and misfortune.

16.71.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya uṣeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 71 ..
16.71.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्य उषेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामैकसप्ततितमोऽध्यायः .. 71 ..
16.71.m: Thus ends the seventy-first chapter, named 'The Description of the Māhātmya of Uṣeśvara,' in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa containing eighty-one thousand verses.

16.72.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tatraiva saṃsthitaṃ paśyedvighneśaṃ jalavāsasam ..
sarvavighnavināśāya sarvakāryaprasiddhaye .. 1 ..
16.72.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तत्रैव संस्थितं पश्येद्विघ्नेशं जलवाससम् ..
सर्वविघ्नविनाशाय सर्वकार्यप्रसिद्धये .. 1 ..
16.72.m: Īśvara said: / Right there one should behold the Lord of Obstacles named Jalavāsas, / for the destruction of all obstacles and for the success of all undertakings.

16.72.s:
varuṇena mahādevi taponirvighnahetave ..
pūjito jalajairbhaktyā jalavāsāstataḥ smṛtaḥ .. 2 ..
16.72.d:
वरुणेन महादेवि तपोनिर्विघ्नहेतवे ..
पूजितो जलजैर्भक्त्या जलवासास्ततः स्मृतः .. 2 ..
16.72.m: By Varuṇa, O great goddess, for the sake of freedom from obstacles in his austerity, / he was worshipped with water-born flowers in devotion; therefore he is remembered as Jalavāsas.

16.72.s:
caturthyāṃ tarpayedbhaktyā gandhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ sa modakaiḥ ..
yathābhaktyanusāreṇa tasya tuṣyedgaṇādhipaḥ .. 3 ..
16.72.d:
चतुर्थ्यां तर्पयेद्भक्त्या गन्धैः पुष्पैः स मोदकैः ..
यथाभक्त्यनुसारेण तस्य तुष्येद्गणाधिपः .. 3 ..
16.72.m: On the fourth lunar day, one should propitiate him with devotion, using perfumes, flowers, and modakas; / according to one's devotion, the Lord of Gaṇas is pleased with him.

16.72.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye jalavāsagaṇapatimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvisaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 72 ..
16.72.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये जलवासगणपतिमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम द्विसप्ततितमोऽध्यायः .. 72 ..
16.72.m: Thus ends the seventy-second chapter, named 'The Description of the Māhātmya of Jalavāsa-Gaṇapati,' in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa containing eighty-one thousand verses.

16.73.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi kumāreśvaramuttamam ..
liṃgaṃ mahāprabhāvaṃ hi mahāpātakanāśanam .. 1 ..
16.73.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि कुमारेश्वरमुत्तमम् ..
लिंगं महाप्रभावं हि महापातकनाशनम् .. 1 ..
16.73.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to the excellent Kumāreśvara, / a liṅga of great power indeed, the destroyer of great sins.

16.73.s:
dhanuṣāṃ triṃśatā devi varuṇānnaiṛte sthitam ..
gaurītapovanāddevi dakṣiṇa sthānasaṃsthitam .. 2 ..
16.73.d:
धनुषां त्रिंशता देवि वरुणान्नैऋते स्थितम् ..
गौरीतपोवनाद्देवि दक्षिण स्थानसंस्थितम् .. 2 ..
16.73.m: It is situated thirty bow-lengths to the southwest of Varuṇa, O goddess, / located in a spot to the south of Gaurī's penance-grove, O goddess.

16.73.s:
ṣaṇmukhena mahādevi tatra kṛtvā mahattapaḥ ..
pratiṣṭhitaṃ mahāliṃgaṃ kumāreśastato'bhavat .. 3 ..
16.73.d:
षण्मुखेन महादेवि तत्र कृत्वा महत्तपः ..
प्रतिष्ठितं महालिंगं कुमारेशस्ततोऽभवत् .. 3 ..
16.73.m: By the Six-faced One, O great goddess, having performed great austerity there, / the great liṅga was installed; hence it became Kumāreśa.

16.73.s:
yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā māsamekaṃ nirantaram ..
ṣaṇmāsasyārcanenaiva yatpuṇyamupajāyate .. 4 ..
16.73.d:
यस्तं पूजयते भक्त्या मासमेकं निरन्तरम् ..
षण्मासस्यार्चनेनैव यत्पुण्यमुपजायते .. 4 ..
16.73.m: He who worships it with devotion continuously for one month— / whatever religious merit arises from worshipping for six months,

16.73.s:
tatpuṇyaṃ sakalaṃ tasya kumāreśārcanātsakṛt ..
labhate divasaikena vidhinā yadi pūjayet .. 5 ..
16.73.d:
तत्पुण्यं सकलं तस्य कुमारेशार्चनात्सकृत् ..
लभते दिवसैकेन विधिना यदि पूजयेत् .. 5 ..
16.73.m: all that merit he obtains from a single worship of Kumāreśa / in one day, if he worships according to rule.

16.73.s:
kāmaṃ krodhaṃ tathā lobhaṃ rāgaṃ tyaktvā tu matsaram ..
brahmacārī yatirbhūtvā sakṛdapyenamarcayet .. 6 ..
16.73.d:
कामं क्रोधं तथा लोभं रागं त्यक्त्वा तु मत्सरम् ..
ब्रह्मचारी यतिर्भूत्वा सकृदप्येनमर्चयेत् .. 6 ..
16.73.m: Abandoning desire, anger, greed, attachment, and malice, / becoming a celibate student or ascetic, he should worship it even once.

16.73.s: evaṃ saṃpūjite devi samyagyātrā phalaṃ labhet .. 7 ..
16.73.d: एवं संपूजिते देवि सम्यग्यात्रा फलं लभेत् .. 7 ..
16.73.m: When it is worshipped thus, O goddess, he obtains the full fruit of the pilgrimage.

16.73.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kumāreśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma trisaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 73 ..
16.73.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये कुमारेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम त्रिसप्ततितमोऽध्यायः .. 73 ..
16.73.m: Thus ends the seventy-third chapter, named 'The Description of the Māhātmya of Kumāreśvara,' in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa containing eighty-one thousand verses.

16.74.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi śākalyeśvaramuttamam ..
daityasūdanavāyavye dhanuṣāṃ triṃśatā sthitam .. 1 ..
16.74.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि शाकल्येश्वरमुत्तमम् ..
दैत्यसूदनवायव्ये धनुषां त्रिंशता स्थितम् .. 1 ..
16.74.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to the excellent Śākalyeśvara, / situated thirty bow-lengths to the northwest of Daityasūdana.

16.74.s:
śākalyena mahādevi pūjitaṃ sarvakāmadam..
śākalyonāma rājarṣiryatra taptvā mahattapaḥ ..2..
16.74.d:
शाकल्येन महादेवि पूजितं सर्वकामदम्..
शाकल्योनाम राजर्षिर्यत्र तप्त्वा महत्तपः ..2..
16.74.m: It was worshipped by Śākalya, O great goddess, granting all desires; / where the royal sage named Śākalya, having performed great austerity,

16.74.s:
samārādhya mahādevaṃ pratyakṣīkṛtavānbhavam ..
liṃge'vatārayāmāsa prasannaṃ taṃ maheśvaram .. 3 ..
16.74.d:
समाराध्य महादेवं प्रत्यक्षीकृतवान्भवम् ..
लिंगेऽवतारयामास प्रसन्नं तं महेश्वरम् .. 3 ..
16.74.m: and having propitiated Mahādeva, brought Bhava before his eyes; / he caused that pleased Maheśvara to descend into the liṅga.

16.74.s:
tasmindṛṣṭe varārohe saptajanmakṛtaṃ nṛṇām ..
pāpaṃ praṇaśyate śīghraṃ tamaḥ sūryodaye yathā .. 4 ..
16.74.d:
तस्मिन्दृष्टे वरारोहे सप्तजन्मकृतं नृणाम् ..
पापं प्रणश्यते शीघ्रं तमः सूर्योदये यथा .. 4 ..
16.74.m: When it is seen, O fair-hipped one, the sin committed by men during seven births / quickly perishes, like darkness at the rising of the sun.

16.74.s:
tatrāṣṭamyāṃ caturddaśyāṃ snāpayetpayasā śivam ..
pūjayecca vidhānena gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt .. 5 ..
16.74.d:
तत्राष्टम्यां चतुर्द्दश्यां स्नापयेत्पयसा शिवम् ..
पूजयेच्च विधानेन गन्धपुष्पादिभिः क्रमात् .. 5 ..
16.74.m: There, on the eighth and fourteenth lunar days, one should bathe Śiva with milk, / and worship him according to rule with perfumes, flowers, and other offerings in due order.

16.74.s:
hiraṇyaṃ tatra dātavyaṃ samyagyātrāphalepsubhiḥ ..
catvāri tasya nāmāni kathyamānāni me śṛṇu .. 6 ..
16.74.d:
हिरण्यं तत्र दातव्यं सम्यग्यात्राफलेप्सुभिः ..
चत्वारि तस्य नामानि कथ्यमानानि मे शृणु .. 6 ..
16.74.m: Gold should be given there by those desiring the full fruit of the pilgrimage. / Hear from me its four names as they are being told:

16.74.s:
ādau kṛtayuge devi kīrtito bhairaveśvaraḥ ..
tataḥ sāvarṇimanunā samyagārādhitaḥ priye .. 7 ..
16.74.d:
आदौ कृतयुगे देवि कीर्तितो भैरवेश्वरः ..
ततः सावर्णिमनुना सम्यगाराधितः प्रिये .. 7 ..
16.74.m: First, in the Kṛta age, O goddess, it was celebrated as Bhairaveśvara. / Then it was properly worshipped by the Manu Sāvarṇi, O dear one;

16.74.s:
sāvarṇikeśvaraṃ nāma tretāyāṃ tasya saṃjñitam ..
tatastu dvāpare devi gālavena mahātmanā ..
samyagārādhitastatra liṃgarūpīvṛṣadhvajaḥ .. 8 ..
16.74.d:
सावर्णिकेश्वरं नाम त्रेतायां तस्य संज्ञितम् ..
ततस्तु द्वापरे देवि गालवेन महात्मना ..
सम्यगाराधितस्तत्र लिंगरूपीवृषध्वजः .. 8 ..
16.74.m: in the Tretā age, it was designated by the name Sāvarṇikeśvara. / Then, in the Dvāpara age, O goddess, by the noble Gālava / the Bull-bannered One was worshipped properly there in the form of a liṅga.

16.74.s:
tṛtīyaṃ tasya devasya gālaveśvarasaṃjñitam ..
kalau yuge tu saṃprāpte śākalyonāma vai muniḥ .. 9 ..
16.74.d:
तृतीयं तस्य देवस्य गालवेश्वरसंज्ञितम् ..
कलौ युगे तु संप्राप्ते शाकल्योनाम वै मुनिः .. 9 ..
16.74.m: The third [name] of that god was designated as Gālaveśvara. / But when the Kali age arrived, indeed a sage named Śākalya [came],

16.74.s:
yatra siddhimanuprāpta aiśvaryaṃ cāṇimādikam..
śākalyeśvaranāmeti tataḥ khyātaṃ turīyakam .. 7.1.74.10 ..
16.74.d:
यत्र सिद्धिमनुप्राप्त ऐश्वर्यं चाणिमादिकम्..
शाकल्येश्वरनामेति ततः ख्यातं तुरीयकम् .. 7.1.74.10 ..
16.74.m: wherein he attained perfection and sovereignty, such as the power of atomicity; / hence its fourth [name] became known by the name Śākalyeśvara.

16.74.s:
evaṃ cāturyugaṃ nāma tasya liṃgasya kīrtitam ..
pāpaghnaṃ puṇyadaṃ nṝṇāṃ kīrttitaṃ sarvakāmadam .. 11 ..
16.74.d:
एवं चातुर्युगं नाम तस्य लिंगस्य कीर्तितम् ..
पापघ्नं पुण्यदं नॄणां कीर्त्तितं सर्वकामदम् .. 11 ..
16.74.m: Thus the name in the four ages of that liṅga has been proclaimed; / it destroys sin, grants religious merit to men, and is proclaimed to bestow all desires.

16.74.s: tasyaiva devadevasya kṣetrotpattiṃ śṛṇu priye .. 12 ..
16.74.d: तस्यैव देवदेवस्य क्षेत्रोत्पत्तिं शृणु प्रिये .. 12 ..
16.74.m: Hear, O beloved, the origin of the field of that very god of gods.

16.74.s:
aṣṭādaśadhanurdevi samaṃtātparimaṇḍalam ..
mahāpāpaharaṃ devi tatra kṣetranivāsinām.. 13 ..
16.74.d:
अष्टादशधनुर्देवि समंतात्परिमण्डलम् ..
महापापहरं देवि तत्र क्षेत्रनिवासिनाम्.. 13 ..
16.74.m: Its circumference is eighteen bow-lengths all around, O goddess; / it removes great sins, O goddess, for those who dwell in that field.

16.74.s:
kṛmikīṭapataṃgānāṃ tiraścāmapi mokṣadam ..
yatra kūpāditoyeṣu jalaṃ sārasvataṃ smṛtam .. 14 ..
16.74.d:
कृमिकीटपतंगानां तिरश्चामपि मोक्षदम् ..
यत्र कूपादितोयेषु जलं सारस्वतं स्मृतम् .. 14 ..
16.74.m: It grants liberation even to worms, insects, winged creatures, and animals. / The water in the wells and other [reservoirs] there is considered sārasvata.

16.74.s:
yatra tatra naraḥ snātvā svargaloke mahīyate ..
aśvamedhasahasrasya vājapeyaśatasya ca .. 15 ..
16.74.d:
यत्र तत्र नरः स्नात्वा स्वर्गलोके महीयते ..
अश्वमेधसहस्रस्य वाजपेयशतस्य च .. 15 ..
16.74.m: Bathing wherever he may there, a man is glorified in the heavenly world. / The fruit of a thousand horse-sacrifices and a hundred Vājapeya sacrifices—

16.74.s:
tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti tasya liṃgasya darśanāt ..
somaparvaṇi saṃprāpte yastatra śucirātmavān .. 16 ..
16.74.d:
तत्फलं समवाप्नोति तस्य लिंगस्य दर्शनात् ..
सोमपर्वणि संप्राप्ते यस्तत्र शुचिरात्मवान् .. 16 ..
16.74.m: that fruit he fully obtains from the darśana of that liṅga. / When the lunar festival arrives, he who is pure and self-controlled there,

16.74.s:
aghoraṃ ca japetsamyagājyahomasamanvitam ..
talliṃgasya samīpastho yāvanmāsāvadhiḥ priye .. 17 ..
16.74.d:
अघोरं च जपेत्सम्यगाज्यहोमसमन्वितम् ..
तल्लिंगस्य समीपस्थो यावन्मासावधिः प्रिये .. 17 ..
16.74.m: and properly recites the Aghora [mantra] accompanied by burnt offerings of clarified butter, / remaining near that liṅga until the period of a month is fulfilled, O dear one,

16.74.s:
mahāpātakayukto'pi yukto vā'pyupapātakaiḥ ..
sa sarvāṃ labhate siddhimuttamāṃ varavarṇini .. 18 ..
16.74.d:
महापातकयुक्तोऽपि युक्तो वाऽप्युपपातकैः ..
स सर्वां लभते सिद्धिमुत्तमां वरवर्णिनि .. 18 ..
16.74.m: even though possessed of great sins or tainted with secondary sins, / he attains all supreme perfection, O woman of excellent complexion.

16.74.s:
kāmikaṃ tatsmṛtaṃ liṃgaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam ..
aghora vaktraṃ devasya tatrasthaṃ bhairavaṃ mahat.. 19 ..
16.74.d:
कामिकं तत्स्मृतं लिंगं सर्वकामफलप्रदम् ..
अघोर वक्त्रं देवस्य तत्रस्थं भैरवं महत्.. 19 ..
16.74.m: That liṅga is remembered as fulfilling desires, granting the fruit of all wishes; / the face of the god situated there is the great Aghora, the terrifying one.

16.74.s:
bhairaveśvaranāmeti pūrvaṃ khyātamabhūdbhuvi ..
asminyuge tu saṃprāpte śākalyeśvaranāmakam ..7.1.74.20..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye śākalyeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catuḥsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. .. 74 .. .. dha ..
16.74.d:
भैरवेश्वरनामेति पूर्वं ख्यातमभूद्भुवि ..
अस्मिन्युगे तु संप्राप्ते शाकल्येश्वरनामकम् ..7.1.74.20..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये शाकल्येश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम चतुःसप्ततितमोऽध्यायः .. .. 74 .. .. ध ..
16.74.m: Formerly on earth it was known by the name Bhairaveśvara; / but when this age arrived, it became named Śākalyeśvara. / Thus ends the seventy-fourth chapter, named 'The Description of the Māhātmya of Śākalyeśvara,' in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa containing eighty-one thousand verses.
